items.documentation: Deletes local files when file sync stops.

enums.name: ActionType
enums.documentation: Describes the outcome of a game action, such as winning, losing, or drawing.

items.name: Nothing
items.documentation: No specific game action occurred.

items.name: Pause
items.documentation: The game or round was paused.

items.name: Lose
items.documentation: The player lost the game or round.

items.name: Draw
items.documentation: The game or round ended in a draw with no winner.

items.name: Win
items.documentation: The player won the game or round.

enums.name: ActivePayerStatus
enums.documentation: Describes a player's payer status bucket for the current experience.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Never
items.documentation: The player has not made a qualifying purchase in the experience.

items.name: Lapsed
items.documentation: The player has previously spent in the experience but is not currently an active payer.

items.name: Casual50Percent
items.documentation: The player is in the casual payer bucket for the experience.

items.name: Intermediate35Percent
items.documentation: The player is in the intermediate payer bucket for the experience.

items.name: Top15Percent
items.documentation: The player is in the top payer bucket for the experience.

enums.name: ActuatorRelativeTo
enums.documentation: Determines the coordinate frame in which a mover constraint's directional properties are expressed.

items.name: Attachment0
items.documentation: The directional property is interpreted in the local coordinate frame of Attachment0, rotating with its parent part.

items.name: Attachment1
items.documentation: The directional property is interpreted in the local coordinate frame of Attachment1, rotating with its parent part.

items.name: World
items.documentation: The directional property is interpreted in world-space coordinates, remaining constant regardless of part orientation.

enums.name: ActuatorType
enums.documentation: The active physics component of the constraint.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The motor and servo components are both disabled.

items.name: Motor
items.documentation: The motor component is enabled. Motor properties are active and the actuator will apply continuous force.

items.name: Servo
items.documentation: The servo component is enabled. Servo properties are active and the actuator will apply force to approach the servo's target.

enums.name: AdAvailabilityResult
enums.documentation: Indicates whether an ad is available or the reason it cannot be shown.

items.name: IsAvailable
items.documentation: An ad is available to show the user.

items.name: DeviceIneligible
items.documentation: The device is ineligible to receive ads.

items.name: ExperienceIneligible
items.documentation: The experience is ineligible to receive ads. Check if its eligibility has been revoked.

items.name: InternalError
items.documentation: An unspecified internal error occurred. Try fetching the ad again.

items.name: NoFill
items.documentation: There are no ads available to fill your ad request. You might have hit the ad frequency limit.

items.name: PlayerIneligible
items.documentation: The user is ineligible to receive ads during this session. The user might be under 13 or located in a blocked region.

items.name: PublisherIneligible
items.documentation: The publisher is ineligible to receive ads because they have not met the publisher eligibility requirements.

enums.name: AdFormat
enums.documentation: Specifies the format of an ad used with AdService methods.

items.name: RewardedVideo
items.documentation: A full-screen video ad that plays to completion and rewards the viewer, used as the adFormat argument for AdService methods.

enums.name: AdornCullingMode
enums.documentation: Culling method used for adornments.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Automatically culls adornment based on distance.

items.name: Never
items.documentation: Never culls adornment. Adornment is always visible.

enums.name: AdornShading
enums.documentation: Determines the shading material and render pass used to draw a handle adornment.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Draws the adornment unlit and occluded by scene geometry like an ordinary world object.

items.name: Shaded
items.documentation: Draws the adornment lit by scene lighting and occluded by scene geometry.

items.name: XRay
items.documentation: Draws the adornment unlit and visible through geometry that would otherwise occlude it.

items.name: XRayShaded
items.documentation: Draws the adornment lit by scene lighting and visible through geometry that would otherwise occlude it.

items.name: AlwaysOnTop
items.documentation: Draws the adornment unlit on top of all other geometry with no depth testing.

enums.name: AdShape
enums.documentation: Describes the form factor of an ad in an AdGui. There is currently only one available size.

items.name: HorizontalRectangle
items.documentation: The ad has an aspect ratio of 16:9 and a minimum size of 8 by 4.5 studs.

enums.name: AdTeleportMethod
enums.documentation: Describes the method by which a player teleports during an immersive ad portal flow.

items.name: Undefined
items.documentation: Default uninitialized sentinel value indicating that no teleport method has been determined yet.

items.name: PortalForward
items.documentation: The player teleported forward to the advertiser's destination experience by walking into an AdPortal.

items.name: InGameMenuBackButton
items.documentation: The player initiated a return teleport to the publisher's experience by pressing the back button in the in-game menu.

items.name: UIBackButton
items.documentation: The player initiated a return teleport to the publisher's experience by pressing a back button rendered in the ad destination's UI overlay.

enums.name: AdUIEventType
enums.documentation: Describes the type of user-interaction or system event that occurred on the immersive ad UI overlay of an AdGui.

items.name: AdLabelClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the "Sponsored" label on the ad overlay, which opens the ad disclosure prompt showing advertiser and payer information.

items.name: VolumeButtonClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the volume toggle button on the ad overlay, which mutes or unmutes the video ad audio.

items.name: FullscreenButtonClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the fullscreen toggle button, which smoothly zooms the camera to a centered view of the ad surface and enables audio.

items.name: PlayButtonClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the play button on the ad overlay. If the ad is already in fullscreen, playback resumes; otherwise it enters fullscreen mode which also starts (or resumes) the video.

items.name: PauseButtonClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the pause button while a video ad is playing in fullscreen mode, which pauses video playback.

items.name: CloseButtonClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the close button on the fullscreen video ad view, which exits fullscreen mode and returns to the normal camera position.

items.name: WhyThisAdClicked
items.documentation: The player clicked the "Why this ad?" link, which displays the EUDSA (European Digital Services Act) disclosure prompt showing the advertiser and payer names for the current ad creative.

items.name: PlayEventTriggered
items.documentation: A system-initiated play/resume event that clears the force-pause state and resumes video playback if the stream is open.

items.name: PauseEventTriggered
items.documentation: A system-initiated pause event, used when the engine needs to force-pause the video (for example, when a dropdown menu opens over the ad). Prevents viewability-based auto-play from resuming playback until a corresponding system event clears that pause.

enums.name: AdUIType
enums.documentation: Describes the type of ad creative currently rendered by an AdGui.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The AdGui has no ad creative loaded and is not rendering ad content.

items.name: Image
items.documentation: The AdGui is rendering a static image ad creative.

items.name: Video
items.documentation: The AdGui is rendering a video ad creative.

enums.name: AdUnitStatus
enums.documentation: Exposes the status of an immersive ad.

items.name: Inactive
items.documentation: The ad unit isn't currently serving an ad and it may be configured incorrectly. An AdGui with this status will display its fallback image.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: The ad unit is currently serving an ad. Players will observe sponsored content in an AdGui and an AdPortal will teleport users that walk through.

enums.name: AgeCheckStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates whether a player has completed age verification.

items.name: Unchecked
items.documentation: The player has not yet completed age verification.

items.name: Checked
items.documentation: The player has successfully completed age verification.

enums.name: AlignType
enums.documentation: An enum that specifies how the constraint will attempt to align the body associated with the constraint.

items.name: PrimaryAxisParallel
items.documentation: Aligns the primary axis to be parallel to the axis given by Constraint.Attachment1.

items.name: PrimaryAxisPerpendicular
items.documentation: Aligns the primary axis to be perpendicular to the axis given by Constraint.Attachment1.

items.name: PrimaryAxisLookAt
items.documentation: Aligns the primary axis to look at the point given by Constraint.Attachment1 or the AlignOrientation.LookAtPosition.

items.name: AllAxes
items.documentation: Aligns all of the axes of Constraint.Attachment0 to the axes given by Constraint.Attachment1 or to the target orientation provided by AlignOrientation.PrimaryAxis and AlignOrientation.SecondaryAxis.

enums.name: AlphaMode
enums.documentation: Used by SurfaceAppearance.AlphaMode to determine how the alpha channel of the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap of a SurfaceAppearance is used.

items.name: Overlay
items.documentation: Overlays the ColorMap on top of the underlying part color based on the map's alpha channel.

items.name: Transparency
items.documentation: Uses the ColorMap alpha channel to control the transparency of the surface.

items.name: TintMask
items.documentation: Uses the ColorMap alpha channel to control the amount of SurfaceAppearance.Color tinting.

items.name: Opaque
items.documentation: Ignores the ColorMap alpha channel and assumes an opacity value of 1 everywhere.

enums.name: AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys
enums.documentation: Used to form a dictionary of custom fields to provide breakdowns in Roblox-provided charts.

items.name: CustomField01
items.documentation: The first custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in Roblox-provided analytics charts.

items.name: CustomField02
items.documentation: The second custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in Roblox-provided analytics charts.

items.name: CustomField03
items.documentation: The third custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in Roblox-provided analytics charts.

enums.name: AnalyticsEconomyAction
enums.documentation: Describes the type of economic transaction in AnalyticsService:FireInGameEconomyEvent().

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Default action. Used for an undefined Action.

items.name: Acquire
items.documentation: Indicates the acquisition of an in game resource. For example, a player acquires virtual currency by completing a specific in game task.

items.name: Spend
items.documentation: Indicates the spending or loss of an in game resource. For example, a player spends virtual currency to acquire a new item.

enums.name: AnalyticsEconomyFlowType
enums.documentation: Specifies the direction of currency flow in an economy event logged by AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent().

items.name: Sink
items.documentation: Currency is being removed from the player's account.

items.name: Source
items.documentation: Currency is being added to the player's account.

enums.name: AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType
enums.documentation: Categorizes the context of an in-experience economic transaction for use with AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent().

items.name: IAP
items.documentation: Represents a source of currency purchased via Robux, for example in-experience "gold" purchased for Robux.

items.name: Shop
items.documentation: Purchases within a shop, for example in-experience "coins" used to buy an item within the experience.

items.name: Gameplay
items.documentation: Currency earned or paid through gameplay, for example in-experience "gold" earned from winning a match.

items.name: ContextualPurchase
items.documentation: Purchase with direct context to a reward, for example in-experience "gold" used to purchase an extra life.

items.name: TimedReward
items.documentation: Time-based reward, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for logging in daily.

items.name: Onboarding
items.documentation: Transaction related to onboarding, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for completing the tutorial.

enums.name: AnalyticsLogLevel
enums.documentation: Specifies the severity level of an analytics log event passed to AnalyticsService:FireLogEvent().

items.name: Trace
items.documentation: Trace is the noisiest level, rarely (if ever) enabled for a production app.

items.name: Debug
items.documentation: Used for debugging.

items.name: Information
items.documentation: Used for general informational messages that highlight progress or state changes during normal operation.

items.name: Warning
items.documentation: Used for warning.

items.name: Error
items.documentation: When functionality is unavailable or expectations broken.

items.name: Fatal
items.documentation: The most critical level, Fatal events demand immediate attention.

enums.name: AnalyticsProgressionStatus
enums.documentation: This enum is used as an argument in AnalyticsService:FirePlayerProgressionEvent() to describe the status of progression.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Default status. Used for an undefined status.

items.name: Begin
items.documentation: Indicates the beginning of progression.

items.name: Complete
items.documentation: Indicates the progression completed.

items.name: Abandon
items.documentation: Indicates the progression abandoned.

items.name: Fail
items.documentation: Indicates the progression failed.

enums.name: AnalyticsProgressionType
enums.documentation: Specifies the player's progression status in a level-progression event logged by AnalyticsService:LogProgressionEvent().

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: A custom progression status for events outside the standard start/fail/complete lifecycle.

items.name: Start
items.documentation: The player started the level attempt.

items.name: Fail
items.documentation: The player failed the level attempt.

items.name: Complete
items.documentation: The player completed the level successfully.

enums.name: AnimationClipFromVideoStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates the current status or final outcome of a video-to-animation conversion started by AssetService:PromptImportAnimationClipFromVideoAsync().

items.name: Initializing
items.documentation: The video-to-animation job is being set up on the server.

items.name: Pending
items.documentation: The job has been queued on the server and is waiting for processing resources to become available.

items.name: Processing
items.documentation: The server is actively analyzing the video and extracting motion-capture data to generate the animation clip.

items.name: ErrorGeneric
items.documentation: The server-side video processing encountered an unspecified error.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The video was successfully converted into an AnimationClip, which is returned as the second element of the result tuple.

items.name: ErrorVideoTooLong
items.documentation: Processing failed because the uploaded video exceeds the maximum allowed duration (15 seconds).

items.name: ErrorNoPersonDetected
items.documentation: Processing failed because no person could be detected in the video; the video must show a person fully in frame, facing the camera.

items.name: ErrorVideoUnstable
items.documentation: Processing failed because the video is too shaky for reliable motion capture; a more stable recording is required.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: Processing could not be completed in time, typically due to high request volume on the video processing backend.

items.name: Cancelled
items.documentation: The player declined the consent prompt or provided no input, so the video upload was not started.

items.name: ErrorMultiplePeople
items.documentation: Processing failed because more than one person was detected in the video; the video must contain a single person fully in frame.

items.name: ErrorUploadingVideo
items.documentation: The client-side video upload failed before the video reached the processing backend.

enums.name: AnimationNodeBlendMode
enums.documentation: Specifies how an AnimationNodeType.OneShotNode combines its one-shot pose with its base pose.

items.name: Over
items.documentation: Composites the one-shot pose on top of the base pose, replacing it by the current blend weight.

items.name: Add
items.documentation: Adds the one-shot pose to the base pose as an additive layer scaled by the current blend weight.

items.name: Subtract
items.documentation: Subtracts the one-shot pose from the base pose scaled by the current blend weight.

enums.name: AnimationNodeType
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of an animation graph node, determining how it processes or combines animation data.

items.name: InvalidNode
items.documentation: The default unassigned type indicating a node has not been configured.

items.name: AddNode
items.documentation: An additive blend node that layers an additive pose on top of a base pose.

items.name: OverNode
items.documentation: A layering node that composites an overlay pose on top of a base pose using per-joint masking.

items.name: Blend1DNode
items.documentation: A blend node that interpolates between multiple inputs along a single numeric axis.

items.name: Blend2DNode
items.documentation: A blend node that interpolates between multiple inputs using a two-dimensional position.

items.name: ClipNode
items.documentation: A leaf node that plays back an animation clip asset.

items.name: GraphOutput
items.documentation: The terminal output node of an animation graph that receives the final pose.

items.name: MaskNode
items.documentation: A node that filters its input pose through a per-joint weight mask.

items.name: PrioritySelectNode
items.documentation: A state node that plays the highest-priority input whose trigger condition is true.

items.name: RandomSequenceNode
items.documentation: A sequence node that plays its inputs in a weighted random order.

items.name: SelectNode
items.documentation: A state node that plays whichever input is chosen by a string selection parameter.

items.name: SequenceNode
items.documentation: A node that plays its inputs one after another in order, optionally looping.

items.name: SpeedNode
items.documentation: A node that scales the playback speed of its input.

items.name: SubtractNode
items.documentation: A blend node that subtracts one pose from another to produce a difference pose.

items.name: OneShotNode
items.documentation: A layering node that plays a one-shot pose over a looping base pose on trigger, blending it in and back out.

items.name: StateMachineNode
items.documentation: A node that selects and transitions between animation states according to a state machine definition.

enums.name: AnimationPriority
enums.documentation: The AnimationPriority Enum determines how concurrently-playing AnimationTracks contribute to the final animation.

items.name: Idle
items.documentation: (6) - Recommended priority for character idle animations.

items.name: Movement
items.documentation: (5) - Recommended priority for walk, run, swim, climb, and other locomotion animations.

items.name: Action
items.documentation: (4) - Recommended priority for character actions that must override idle and locomotion animations.

items.name: Action2
items.documentation: (3) - Action2 will override Action.

items.name: Action3
items.documentation: (2) - Action3 will override Action2.

items.name: Action4
items.documentation: (1) - Action4 is the highest priority available, overriding all other priority values.

items.name: Core
items.documentation: (7) - Lowest priority, intended for use by Roblox default animations and catalog animation bundles.

enums.name: AnimationValueNodeType
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of an animation graph value node, determining how it computes the value it publishes.

items.name: Invalid
items.documentation: The default unassigned type indicating a value node has not been configured.

items.name: Expression
items.documentation: A value node that evaluates a Luau expression and publishes its result.

enums.name: AnimatorRetargetingMode
enums.documentation: Animation Retargeting setting.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Retargeting in default state, opt-in initially but subject to change.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Animation retargeting is off; animations play exactly as authored without adapting joint transforms to the character's body proportions.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Animation retargeting is always active; the Animator adapts animations to the character's body proportions regardless of the platform default.

enums.name: AntiAliasing
enums.documentation: Determines whether anti-aliasing is applied when drawing on the instance.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables anti-aliasing, resulting in hard edges.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables anti-aliasing, resulting in soft edges.

enums.name: AppLifecycleManagerState
enums.documentation: Describes the current lifecycle state of the Roblox application as reported by AppLifecycleObserverService:GetCurrentState().

items.name: Detached
items.documentation: The application has not yet started or is shutting down. This is the initial state before the lifecycle manager is created and the final state entered during application termination.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: The application is in the foreground and has input focus. This is the normal running state where the user is actively interacting with the experience.

items.name: Inactive
items.documentation: The application is visible but does not have input focus. On iOS this occurs during transitions such as incoming calls or notification center pull-down; on macOS it corresponds to the application resigning active status.

items.name: Hidden
items.documentation: The application is fully in the background and not visible to the user. On mobile platforms this corresponds to the app being backgrounded; on desktop it corresponds to the window being minimized or fully occluded.

enums.name: ApplyShadowMode
enums.documentation: Controls which part of a parent UI element a UIShadow applies its drop shadow to.

items.name: Shape
items.documentation: The shadow is applied to the parent element's frame.

items.name: Text
items.documentation: The shadow is applied to the parent element's text; no-op if the parent is not a text element.

enums.name: ApplyStrokeMode
enums.documentation: Used by UIStroke.ApplyStrokeMode to determine where to apply the stroke.

items.name: Contextual
items.documentation: The stroke is applied to the parent UI element's text.

items.name: Border
items.documentation: The stroke is applied to the parent UI element's border.

enums.name: AppUpdateStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates the result of an application update check performed by AppUpdateService.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The default state before any update check has been performed.

items.name: NotSupported
items.documentation: The platform does not support application updates.

items.name: Failed
items.documentation: The update check failed due to an error such as a network failure or missing initialization.

items.name: NotAvailable
items.documentation: No update is currently required; the client is already running the latest version for its channel.

items.name: Available
items.documentation: An update is available through a public channel or production deployment.

items.name: AvailableBoundChannel
items.documentation: An update is available because the user is explicitly bound to a private or public channel.

items.name: AvailableBetaProgram
items.documentation: An update is available because the user opted into a beta program backed by a channel.

enums.name: AspectType
enums.documentation: Used by UIAspectRatioConstraint.AspectType to control sizing behavior.

items.name: FitWithinMaxSize
items.documentation: The object will be the maximum size possible within its own AbsoluteSize.

items.name: ScaleWithParentSize
items.documentation: The object's maximum size will be the size of the parent while still maintaining the aspect ratio.

enums.name: AssetCreatorType
enums.documentation: Indicates whether an asset is owned by an individual user or a group.

items.name: User
items.documentation: The asset is owned by an individual user; the accompanying creator ID is a user ID.

items.name: Group
items.documentation: The asset is owned by a group; the accompanying creator ID is a group ID.

enums.name: AssetFetchStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the download state of an asset requested through ContentProvider.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The asset loaded successfully.

items.name: Failure
items.documentation: The asset failed to load successfully. Subsequent attempts are likely to fail; there may be something wrong with the Content string.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The engine has no information about this asset. The engine never tried to load it.

items.name: Loading
items.documentation: The engine is in the middle of trying to load this asset.

items.name: TimedOut
items.documentation: The engine tried to load this asset but timed out. Future attempts to load may succeed.

enums.name: AssetType
enums.documentation: This Enum can be used to match the AssetTypeId from MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync() to an asset type.

items.name: Image
items.documentation: The asset is an image.

items.name: TShirt
items.documentation: The asset is a classic t-shirt (a flat image applied to the avatar's torso).

items.name: Audio
items.documentation: The asset is an audio clip.

items.name: Mesh
items.documentation: The asset is a mesh.

items.name: Lua
items.documentation: The asset is Luau code, for example a ModuleScript.

items.name: Hat
items.documentation: The asset is a hat.

items.name: Place
items.documentation: The asset is a place.

items.name: Model
items.documentation: The asset is a model.

items.name: Shirt
items.documentation: The asset is a shirt.

items.name: Pants
items.documentation: The asset is a pants item.

items.name: Decal
items.documentation: The asset is a decal (image).

items.name: Head
items.documentation: The asset is a head.

items.name: Face
items.documentation: The asset is a face.

items.name: Gear
items.documentation: The asset is a gear item.

items.name: Badge
items.documentation: The asset is a badge.

items.name: Animation
items.documentation: The asset is an animation; also see the more specific animation type enums below.

items.name: Torso
items.documentation: The asset is a torso.

items.name: RightArm
items.documentation: The asset is a right arm.

items.name: LeftArm
items.documentation: The asset is a left arm.

items.name: LeftLeg
items.documentation: The asset is a left leg.

items.name: RightLeg
items.documentation: The asset is a right leg.

items.name: Package
items.documentation: The asset is a pack, for example an animation package.

items.name: GamePass
items.documentation: The asset is a GamePass.

items.name: Plugin
items.documentation: The asset is a plugin.

items.name: MeshPart
items.documentation: The asset is a mesh part.

items.name: HairAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a hair accessory.

items.name: FaceAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a face accessory.

items.name: NeckAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a neck accessory.

items.name: ShoulderAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a shoulder accessory.

items.name: FrontAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a front accessory.

items.name: BackAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a back accessory.

items.name: WaistAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a waist accessory.

items.name: ClimbAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a climb animation.

items.name: DeathAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a death animation.

items.name: FallAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a fall animation.

items.name: IdleAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is an idle animation.

items.name: JumpAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a jump animation.

items.name: RunAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a run animation.

items.name: SwimAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a swim animation.

items.name: WalkAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a walk animation.

items.name: PoseAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a pose animation.

items.name: EarAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is an ear accessory.

items.name: EyeAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is an eye accessory.

items.name: EmoteAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is an emote animation.

items.name: Video
items.documentation: The asset is a video.

items.name: TShirtAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a t-shirt.

items.name: ShirtAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a shirt.

items.name: PantsAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing pants.

items.name: JacketAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a jacket.

items.name: SweaterAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a sweater.

items.name: ShortsAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing shorts.

items.name: LeftShoeAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a left shoe.

items.name: RightShoeAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a right shoe.

items.name: DressSkirtAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered clothing accessory representing a dress or skirt.

items.name: FontFamily
items.documentation: The asset is a font family used for text rendering.

items.name: EyebrowAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered eyebrow accessory.

items.name: EyelashAccessory
items.documentation: The asset is a layered eyelash accessory.

items.name: MoodAnimation
items.documentation: The asset is a mood animation that defines a static facial expression for a character.

items.name: DynamicHead
items.documentation: The asset is a head with facial animation support.

items.name: FaceMakeup
items.documentation: The asset is face makeup applied to a character's head via texture transfer.

items.name: LipMakeup
items.documentation: The asset is lip makeup applied to a character's face via texture transfer.

items.name: EyeMakeup
items.documentation: The asset is eye makeup applied to a character's face via texture transfer.

items.name: AvatarBackground
items.documentation: The asset is an avatar background used as a scene backdrop in avatar previews.

items.name: TextDocument
items.documentation: The asset is a text document.

enums.name: AssetTypeVerification
enums.documentation: Determines the asset type verification mode.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Use the default behavior for asset type verification.

items.name: ClientOnly
items.documentation: Only verify asset types on the client. Asset type verification can not be turned off on the client.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: Always verify the asset types to be loaded and disallow loading models.

enums.name: AudioApiRollout
enums.documentation: Used to determine whether voice chat is represented and controlled by AudioDeviceInput objects.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Voice chat will use an internal voice chat implementation that is automatic and hidden.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Currently means the same thing as Disabled, but will be updated to mean Enabled in the future.

enums.name: AudioChannelLayout
enums.documentation: Describes the channel layout of an audio stream.

items.name: Mono
items.documentation: Monaural audio streams contain only one Center channel. !Diagram showing position of channels for Mono layout.

items.name: Stereo
items.documentation: Stereophonic audio streams consist of two channels: Left and Right. !Diagram showing position of channels for Stereo layout.

items.name: Quad
items.documentation: Quadrophonic audio streams consist of four channels: Left, Right, BackLeft, and BackRight. Quadrophonic streams can encode forward/backward spatial information that stereo streams might struggle with. !Diagram showing position of channels for Quad layout.

items.name: Surround_5
items.documentation: Surround sound audio streams consist of five channels: Left, Right, Center, BackLeft, and BackRight. Surround sound streams encode spatial information with better resolution front and center. !Diagram showing position of channels for Surround 5 layout.

items.name: Surround_5_1
items.documentation: 5.1 surround sound consists of six channels: Left, Right, Center, BackLeft, BackRight, and a Sub (subsonic) low‑frequency channel. 5.1 surround sound benefits from low frequencies being less directional in order to encode higher resolution spatial information versus simple 5‑channel surround sound. !Diagram showing position of channels for Surround 5.1 layout.

items.name: Surround_7_1
items.documentation: 7.1 surround sound consists of eight channels: Left, Right, Center, SurroundLeft, SurroundRight, BackLeft, BackRight, and a Sub (subsonic) low‑frequency channel. 7.1 surround sound is an improvement over 5.1 surround sound, offering better spatial resolution directly to the left and right as well. !Diagram showing position of channels for Surround 7.1 layout.

items.name: Surround_7_1_4
items.documentation: 7.1.4 surround sound consists of twelve channels: Left, Right, Center, SurroundLeft, SurroundRight, BackLeft, BackRight, Sub, TopLeft, TopRight, TopBackLeft, and TopBackRight. 7.1.4 is the only currently supported channel layout that encodes height information. !Diagram showing position of channels for Surround 7.1.4 layout.

enums.name: AudioFilterType
enums.documentation: Filter types used for AudioFilter instances.

items.name: Peak
items.documentation: Filter that boosts or reduces sound near a specified Frequency.

items.name: LowShelf
items.documentation: Filter that boosts or reduces sound below a specified Frequency.

items.name: HighShelf
items.documentation: Filter that boosts or reduces sound above a specified Frequency.

items.name: Lowpass12dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

items.name: Lowpass24dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

items.name: Lowpass48dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

items.name: Highpass12dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound below a specified Frequency, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

items.name: Highpass24dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound below a specified Frequency, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

items.name: Highpass48dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound below a specified Frequency, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

items.name: Bandpass
items.documentation: Filter that only allows sound near a specified Frequency to be heard.

items.name: Notch
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound near a specified Frequency.

items.name: Lowpass6dB
items.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -6dB/octave.

enums.name: AudioSampleFormat
enums.documentation: Describes the numeric format used to represent individual audio samples.

items.name: Int16
items.documentation: Samples are represented as 16-bit signed integers, ranging from -32768 to 32767.

items.name: Float32
items.documentation: Samples are represented as 32-bit floating-point numbers, typically ranging from -1.0 to 1.0.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No acoustic simulation occurs; only direction and distance are taken into account.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: The audio engine simulates transmission, diffraction, and reflections at a level of detail suitable to most devices.

items.name: RecentlyCreated

items.name: ShortestToLongest

items.name: LongestToShortest

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: A mid-sized buffer that balances frequency resolution and latency.

items.name: Large

items.name: XY
items.documentation: Automatically resize element along the X and Y axes to fit child contents.

enums.name: AvatarChatServiceFeature
enums.documentation: A bitmask enum whose items represent individual avatar chat capabilities for voice and video communication within an experience.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No avatar chat features are enabled. This is the default value of the bitmask before any capabilities are resolved.

items.name: UniverseAudio
items.documentation: Voice chat audio is enabled at the universe level. This is a server-side setting configured by the experience creator; it must be combined with AvatarChatServiceFeature.PlaceAudio for audio to be active in a given place.

items.name: UniverseVideo
items.documentation: Avatar video (camera-based facial animation) is enabled at the universe level. This is a server-side setting configured by the experience creator; it must be combined with AvatarChatServiceFeature.PlaceVideo for video to be active in a given place.

items.name: PlaceAudio
items.documentation: Voice chat audio is enabled for the current place. Both this flag and AvatarChatServiceFeature.UniverseAudio must be set for audio to be active in the place.

items.name: PlaceVideo
items.documentation: Avatar video (camera-based facial animation) is enabled for the current place. Both this flag and AvatarChatServiceFeature.UniverseVideo must be set for video to be active in the place.

items.name: UserAudioEligible
items.documentation: The user meets the requirements to use voice chat audio (age-verified, not banned, etc.). Eligibility is resolved per-player from backend permissions; it does not imply the user has opted in (see AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserAudio).

items.name: UserAudio
items.documentation: The user has opted in to voice chat audio. This flag is only meaningful when AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserAudioEligible is also set; together they indicate the user both can and has chosen to use voice.

items.name: UserVideoEligible
items.documentation: The user meets the requirements to use avatar video (camera-based facial animation). Eligibility is resolved per-player from backend permissions; it does not imply the user has opted in (see AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserVideo).

items.name: UserVideo
items.documentation: The user has opted in to avatar video (camera-based facial animation). This flag is only meaningful when AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserVideoEligible is also set; together they indicate the user both can and has chosen to use video.

items.name: UserBanned
items.documentation: The user is currently banned from avatar chat features. When this flag is present in the client features mask, voice and video capabilities are unavailable to the player regardless of other eligibility flags.

items.name: UserVerifiedForVoice
items.documentation: The user has completed voice verification.

items.name: PermissionDenied

items.name: Failed
items.documentation: Failure while trying to take the prompted action.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod
enums.documentation: Determines how AvatarAccessoryRules enforces accessory size limits when an accessory exceeds the configured bounds.

items.name: Scale
items.documentation: Scales down rigid accessories that exceed the configured bounds, or removes them if scaling would reduce them below minimum size thresholds.

items.name: Remove
items.documentation: Destroys any rigid accessory whose bounding box exceeds the configured bounds.

items.name: PreviewScale
items.documentation: Reports whether an accessory would be scaled or removed for exceeding the configured bounds without actually modifying it.

items.name: PreviewRemove
items.documentation: Reports whether an accessory would be removed for exceeding the configured bounds without actually destroying it.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsAccessoryMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether AvatarAccessoryRules enforces custom size limits on rigid accessories worn by player avatars.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: No custom size limits are applied to rigid accessories; the player's own accessory choices are displayed without modification.

items.name: CustomLimit
items.documentation: The experience enforces custom size limits on rigid accessories using the LimitBounds and LimitMethod properties of AvatarAccessoryRules.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsAnimationClipsMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether avatar animation clips are defined by the experience or if they are determined by AnimationPacksMode.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: The clips determined by the AnimationPacksMode are used, without experience-level overrides.

items.name: CustomClips
items.documentation: The experience overrides individual animation clips using the per-clip enabled and ID properties on AvatarAnimationRules (for example, CustomRunAnimationEnabled and CustomRunAnimationId). Only clips whose enabled flag is true are replaced.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode
enums.documentation: Determines which base animation pack is applied to avatar characters, controlling whether players use their own equipped animations or the experience forces a standard R15 or R6 animation set.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: The player's own equipped animation pack is used. The character's Animate script supplies the animations without experience-level overrides.

items.name: StandardR15
items.documentation: The experience forces the standard R15 animation pack on all characters, overriding player-equipped animations with a fixed set of R15 locomotion clips.

items.name: StandardR6
items.documentation: The experience forces the standard R6 animation pack on all (R15) characters, overriding player-equipped animations with a fixed set of R6-style locomotion clips plus additional R6-style emote and tool animations.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode
enums.documentation: Determines how the avatar's body-part appearance is sourced in an experience that uses AvatarBodyRules.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: Players keep their own avatar body parts; the experience does not override any body-part assets.

items.name: CustomParts
items.documentation: The experience overrides individual body parts (head, face, torso, arms, legs) using per-part asset IDs and enablement settings on AvatarBodyRules.

items.name: CustomBody
items.documentation: The experience replaces the avatar's entire body as a single unit, using CustomBodyType and CustomBodyBundleId.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsBuildMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether players can freely scale their avatar body or whether the experience enforces custom scale ranges.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: Players can scale their avatar body freely within the full platform-wide limits. This is the default value.

items.name: CustomBuild
items.documentation: The experience enforces creator-defined min/max ranges for avatar body scales (height, width, head, body type, and proportions), overriding the platform defaults.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsClothingMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether the experience applies a spatial bounding limit to layered clothing on player characters.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: No spatial limit is applied to layered clothing; the player's layered clothing accessories deform without a bounding constraint.

items.name: CustomLimit
items.documentation: Applies a custom spatial limit to layered clothing based on LimitBounds.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsCollisionMode
enums.documentation: Determines the collision geometry mode for avatars managed by AvatarCollisionRules.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Each body part uses its native collision geometry. The HumanoidRootPart, UpperTorso, and LowerTorso collide while other parts do not. This is the default value for CollisionMode.

items.name: SingleCollider
items.documentation: A single box-shaped collider part replaces all per-part collision. The collider is welded to the HumanoidRootPart and sized by SingleColliderSize (default 2, 3, 1). All other parts become non-collidable and massless.

items.name: Legacy
items.documentation: Collision geometry is determined by LegacyCollisionMode, which selects either inner-box colliders or R6-style colliders.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsCustomAccessoryMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether AvatarAccessoryRules replaces player accessories with experience-defined custom accessories.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: No custom accessory replacement is applied; the player's own accessory choices are displayed without modification.

items.name: CustomAccessories
items.documentation: The experience replaces player accessories with custom accessories defined by the per-slot properties on AvatarAccessoryRules.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsCustomBodyType
enums.documentation: Determines whether an experience's custom body override is identified by individual asset references or by a single bundle ID.

items.name: AvatarReference
items.documentation: The custom body is assembled from individual per-part asset references on AvatarBodyRules. This is the default value.

items.name: BundleId
items.documentation: The custom body is sourced from a single avatar bundle, identified by the CustomBodyBundleId property.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsCustomClothingMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether an experience overrides a player's classic 2D or layered 3D clothing with creator-specified assets or preserves the player's own clothing choices.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: Players keep their own clothing selections. The experience does not override clothing assets. This is the default value.

items.name: CustomClothing
items.documentation: The experience enforces creator-specified clothing assets from AvatarClothingRules, overriding each player's own equipped clothing.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsHitAndTouchDetectionMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether hit detection and spatial queries use the individual body parts or the single collider when AvatarCollisionRules.CollisionMode is AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.SingleCollider.

items.name: UseParts
items.documentation: Individual avatar body parts handle Touched events and spatial queries (CanTouch and CanQuery enabled on body parts) while the single collider part has CanTouch and CanQuery disabled. This is the default value for AvatarCollisionRules.HitAndTouchDetectionMode.

items.name: UseCollider
items.documentation: The single collider part handles Touched events and spatial queries (CanTouch and CanQuery enabled on the collider) while all individual body parts have CanTouch and CanQuery disabled.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsJumpMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether the avatar jump setting for an experience is configured using jump height (studs) or jump power (force).

items.name: JumpHeight
items.documentation: The avatar jump is configured using Humanoid.JumpHeight, which specifies the target jump height in studs. Corresponds to Humanoid.UseJumpPower being false.

items.name: JumpPower
items.documentation: The avatar jump is configured using Humanoid.JumpPower, which applies an upward force to the character. Corresponds to Humanoid.UseJumpPower being true.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsLegacyCollisionMode
enums.documentation: Determines which legacy collision geometry is applied to R15 avatars when AvatarSettingsCollisionMode is set to Legacy.

items.name: R6Colliders
items.documentation: Creates six invisible box collider parts welded to R15 limbs to approximate classic R6 collision geometry. The engine spawns six invisible Part instances (head, torso, left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg) parented to the character and welded to the corresponding R15 body parts. All original R15 mesh parts have their BasePart.CanCollide, BasePart.CanTouch, and BasePart.CanQuery disabled and are made massless; only the HumanoidRootPart retains mass so it remains the physics assembly root.

items.name: InnerBoxColliders
items.documentation: Overrides each R15 mesh part's collision physics with inner-box geometry derived from the standard R15 scaling model. The engine recalculates every MeshPart in the character with collision data from the default R15 model's bounding dimensions, producing tighter collision volumes that follow the avatar's proportions without adding extra parts. This is the default value of LegacyCollisionMode.

enums.name: AvatarSettingsScaleMode
enums.documentation: Determines whether the experience enforces a custom height range on player characters or allows players to spawn at their natural avatar height.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.documentation: Characters spawn at their natural avatar height without any experience-level height override. This is the default value.

items.name: CustomScale
items.documentation: The experience clamps the character's height to the range specified by CustomHeight, overriding the player's natural avatar height.

enums.name: AvatarUnificationMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether the R6 to R15 adapter is active, allowing R15 avatars to join R6 experiences.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Resolves to the engine's current built-in default for avatar unification, which currently behaves the same as Disabled.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables the R6-to-R15 adapter; R6 avatars in an R6 experience load using the standard R6 rig with no adapter parts applied.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables the R6-to-R15 adapter; R6 avatars joining an R6 experience receive invisible R15 adapter MeshParts welded to their R6-named joints, preserving R6 scale while enabling R15 features such as layered clothing and animatable heads.

items.name: Middle

items.name: Inset

items.name: Inner

items.name: Error

items.name: SpecialBreakpoint

items.name: UserBreakpoint
