items.name: RobloxButton
items.documentation: A black background with a grey border, and rounded corners.

items.name: RobloxRoundButton
items.documentation: A grey background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

items.name: RobloxRoundDefaultButton
items.documentation: A blue background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

items.name: RobloxRoundDropdownButton
items.documentation: A white background with a thin grey border, rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

enums.name: CageType
enums.documentation: Specifies which cage surface — inner or outer — to read or write on a BaseWrap object.

items.name: Inner
items.documentation: Selects the inner cage mesh, which defines the surface that conforms to the body or underlying layer beneath the accessory.

items.name: Outer
items.documentation: Selects the outer cage mesh, which defines the surface that the next clothing layer above this accessory conforms to.

enums.name: CameraMode
enums.documentation: Used to set Player.CameraMode to determine when first person and third person cameras should be used.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Third person camera which can be zoomed into first person.

items.name: LockFirstPerson
items.documentation: Exclusively first person camera.

enums.name: CameraNavigationModel
enums.documentation: Determines the camera navigation paradigm used in the Roblox Studio editor viewport.

items.name: Roblox
items.documentation: Classic Roblox Studio camera navigation model with linear zoom and focus-locked orbiting; the default value.

items.name: IndustryCompatible
items.documentation: Camera navigation model that follows industry-standard 3D application conventions, with non-linear zoom and simultaneous WASD-plus-orbit movement.

enums.name: CameraPanMode
enums.documentation: The CameraPanMode Enum represents the available pan modes for Camera:SetCameraPanMode().

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Enables swipe and pan on mobile devices, and disables edge bump camera controls. Default.

items.name: EdgeBump
items.documentation: Disables swipe to pan on mobile devices, and enables edge bump camera controls. It does not affect Windows or Mac users.

enums.name: CameraSpeedAdjustBinding
enums.documentation: Controls which input gesture adjusts the Studio camera's fly speed while navigating.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No input gesture is bound to camera speed adjustment; the scroll wheel always zooms.

items.name: RmbScroll
items.documentation: Scrolling while holding the right mouse button adjusts the camera fly speed instead of zooming.

items.name: AltScroll
items.documentation: Scrolling while holding Alt adjusts the camera fly speed instead of zooming.

enums.name: CameraType
enums.documentation: Describes the camera behavior mode if using the default PlayerScripts.

items.name: Fixed
items.documentation: Camera is stationary.

items.name: Attach
items.documentation: Camera moves with the subject at a fixed offset and will rotate as the subject rotates.

items.name: Watch
items.documentation: Camera is stationary but will rotate to keep the subject in the center of the screen.

items.name: Track
items.documentation: Camera moves with the subject but does not rotate automatically.

items.name: Follow
items.documentation: Camera moves with the subject and rotates to keep the subject in the center.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: No default behavior. Used when developers need to script custom behavior.

items.name: Orbital
items.documentation: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

enums.name: CaptureGalleryPermission
enums.documentation: Specifies the scope of permissions an experience requests for accessing the device's capture gallery.

items.name: ReadAndUpload
items.documentation: Requests permission to read captures from and upload captures to the device's gallery.

enums.name: CaptureType
enums.documentation: Indicates whether a capture is a screenshot or a video recording.

items.name: Screenshot
items.documentation: The capture is a screenshot image.

items.name: Video
items.documentation: The capture is a video recording.

enums.name: CatalogCategoryFilter
enums.documentation: Filters Avatar Shop catalog search results by a predefined category such as Featured, Premium, or Recommended.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No category filter is applied; returns items from all categories. This is the default value of CatalogSearchParams.CategoryFilter.

items.name: Featured
items.documentation: Returns only items editorially featured in the Avatar Shop catalog.

items.name: Collectibles
items.documentation: Deprecated. Previously filtered for collectible items; use SalesTypeFilter.Collectibles via CatalogSearchParams.SalesTypeFilter instead.

items.name: CommunityCreations
items.documentation: Returns only items created by community developers.

items.name: Premium
items.documentation: Returns only items available to Roblox Premium subscribers.

items.name: Recommended
items.documentation: Returns only items recommended by the catalog for the current user.

enums.name: CatalogSortAggregation
enums.documentation: Specifies the time window over which catalog items are aggregated when sorting CatalogSearchParams results.

items.name: Past12Hours
items.documentation: Aggregates catalog data from the past 12 hours when sorting search results.

items.name: PastDay
items.documentation: Aggregates catalog data from the past day when sorting search results.

items.name: Past3Days
items.documentation: Aggregates catalog data from the past 3 days when sorting search results.

items.name: PastWeek
items.documentation: Aggregates catalog data from the past week when sorting search results.

items.name: PastMonth
items.documentation: Aggregates catalog data from the past month when sorting search results.

items.name: AllTime
items.documentation: Aggregates catalog data across all time when sorting search results.

enums.name: CatalogSortType
enums.documentation: Specifies the sort order for catalog search results returned by AvatarEditorService:SearchCatalogAsync().

items.name: Relevance
items.documentation: Sorts catalog results by relevance to the search keyword or other query parameters.

items.name: PriceHighToLow
items.documentation: Sorts catalog results from the highest price to the lowest price.

items.name: PriceLowToHigh
items.documentation: Sorts catalog results from the lowest price to the highest price.

items.name: MostFavorited
items.documentation: Sorts catalog results by the number of times items have been favorited, with most-favorited items listed first.

items.name: RecentlyCreated
items.documentation: Sorts catalog results by creation date, with the most recently created items listed first.

items.name: Bestselling
items.documentation: Sorts catalog results by total sales, with best-selling items listed first.

enums.name: CellBlock
enums.documentation: Deprecated enum specifying the geometric block shape of a legacy voxel terrain cell, used with the removed Terrain:SetCell() method.

items.name: Solid
items.documentation: A legacy voxel cell that is completely filled, occupying the full cell volume.

items.name: VerticalWedge
items.documentation: A legacy voxel cell shaped as a vertical wedge, occupying half of a full cell's volume.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.documentation: A legacy voxel cell shaped as a corner wedge, occupying approximately one-third of a full cell's volume.

items.name: InverseCornerWedge
items.documentation: A legacy voxel cell shaped as an inverse corner wedge, occupying approximately two-thirds of a full cell's volume.

items.name: HorizontalWedge
items.documentation: A legacy voxel cell shaped as a horizontal wedge, occupying half of a full cell's volume.

enums.name: CellMaterial
enums.documentation: Material values for individual cells in the deprecated legacy voxel-based Terrain engine.

items.name: Empty
items.documentation: Represents an air (unfilled) cell in the legacy voxel terrain; converted to air in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Grass
items.documentation: A green grassy cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Grass in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Sand
items.documentation: A sandy cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Sand in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Brick
items.documentation: A red brick cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Brick in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Granite
items.documentation: A speckled stone cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Slate in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Asphalt
items.documentation: A dark paved road cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Asphalt in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Iron
items.documentation: A dark metallic cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Aluminum
items.documentation: A metallic silver cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Gold
items.documentation: A golden metallic cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: WoodPlank
items.documentation: A flat wooden plank cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.WoodPlanks in the modern terrain system.

items.name: WoodLog
items.documentation: A round wooden log cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.WoodPlanks in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Gravel
items.documentation: A loose-stone cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Asphalt in the modern terrain system.

items.name: CinderBlock
items.documentation: A rough masonry cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: MossyStone
items.documentation: A weathered stone cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Pavement in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Cement
items.documentation: A gray cement cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: RedPlastic
items.documentation: A red-tinted cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Sandstone in the modern terrain system.

items.name: BluePlastic
items.documentation: A blue-tinted cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Ice in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Water
items.documentation: A water-filled cell in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Water in the modern terrain system.

enums.name: CellOrientation
enums.documentation: Specifies the corner orientation of a legacy terrain cell, used with the deprecated Terrain:SetCell() method.

items.name: NegZ
items.documentation: Upper-left corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

items.name: X
items.documentation: Upper-right corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

items.name: Z
items.documentation: Lower-right corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

items.name: NegX
items.documentation: Lower-left corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

enums.name: CharacterControlMode
enums.documentation: Specifies which character controller implementation an experience uses.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses Roblox's default character controller selection.

items.name: Legacy
items.documentation: Uses the legacy character controller.

items.name: NoCharacterController
items.documentation: Does not load a character controller.

items.name: LuaCharacterController
items.documentation: Uses the Luau character controller.

enums.name: ChatCallbackType
enums.documentation: Identifies a hook point in the legacy Luau chat pipeline for use with Chat:RegisterChatCallback() and Chat:InvokeChatCallback().

items.name: OnCreatingChatWindow
items.documentation: Client-only callback invoked before the chat window is constructed, allowing custom settings to be supplied.

items.name: OnClientSendingMessage
items.documentation: Client-only callback reserved for when the client sends a message; not currently invoked.

items.name: OnClientFormattingMessage
items.documentation: Client-only callback invoked before a message is displayed, allowing its display data to be modified.

items.name: OnServerReceivingMessage
items.documentation: Server-only callback invoked when the server receives a message from a speaker, allowing the message to be modified or suppressed.

enums.name: ChatColor
enums.documentation: Describes the chat color.

items.name: Blue
items.documentation: The blue chat color; the default value passed to Chat() and ChatLocal().

items.name: Green
items.documentation: The green chat color, passed as the color argument to Chat() or ChatLocal().

items.name: Red
items.documentation: The red chat color, passed as the color argument to Chat() or ChatLocal().

items.name: White
items.documentation: The white chat color, passed as the color argument to Chat() or ChatLocal().

enums.name: ChatMode
enums.documentation: Describes the methods of communication available to a player.

items.name: Menu
items.documentation: The player is restricted to chatting via a menu of chat messages.

items.name: TextAndMenu
items.documentation: A player can chat via custom text messages and a menu of chat messages.

enums.name: ChatPrivacyMode
enums.documentation: Describes which other users a player is permitted to exchange in-game chat messages with.

items.name: AllUsers
items.documentation: A player can chat with all users in a game.

items.name: NoOne
items.documentation: A player cannot chat with any other users in a game.

items.name: Friends
items.documentation: A player can only chat with users in a game that are on their friends list.

enums.name: ChatRestrictionStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the chat restriction status that a third-party platform reports for a user.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The platform's chat restriction status for the user has not yet been determined; this is the default value for all ChatRestrictionStatus properties.

items.name: NotRestricted
items.documentation: The third-party platform has confirmed the user has no chat restrictions in effect.

items.name: Restricted
items.documentation: The third-party platform has reported the user is restricted from chat, typically due to parental controls or platform communication settings.

enums.name: ChatStyle
enums.documentation: The ChatStyle Enum is used to set the style of Chat used in a game via the Players:SetChatStyle() method.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Displays chats in the chat user interface at the top-left corner of the screen.

items.name: Bubble
items.documentation: Displays chats in a bubble above the sender's head.

items.name: ClassicAndBubble
items.documentation: Has the effects of Classic and Bubble combined.

enums.name: ChatVersion
enums.documentation: Determines whether TextChatService should be fully enabled or to allow the legacy system.

items.name: LegacyChatService
items.documentation: Enables the legacy chat system.

items.name: TextChatService
items.documentation: Enables TextChatService chat and prevents legacy chat system behavior.

enums.name: ClientAnimatorThrottlingMode
enums.documentation: An Enum describing various animation throttling modes on clients.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default animation throttling mode defined by Roblox.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables animation throttling.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables animation throttling.

enums.name: CloseReason
enums.documentation: Specifies the reason for the experience server shutdown.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The server shut down for an unknown reason.

items.name: RobloxMaintenance
items.documentation: The server shut down for maintenance.

items.name: DeveloperShutdown
items.documentation: The experience developer has shut down the server, or functions bound by BindToClose() have been called inside Studio.

items.name: DeveloperUpdate
items.documentation: The experience developer has migrated the server to a new place version.

items.name: ServerEmpty
items.documentation: The last player has left and the experience is empty.

items.name: OutOfMemory
items.documentation: The experience has hit the memory limit for the game server.

items.name: Moderation
items.documentation: The server was shut down because the experience or place was taken down for moderation.

enums.name: CollaboratorStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the current editing activity of a collaborator in a Team Create session.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The collaborator has no active editing context; this is the default status.

items.name: Editing3D
items.documentation: The collaborator is actively working in the 3D viewport.

items.name: Scripting
items.documentation: The collaborator is editing a script that is replicated to the server.

items.name: PrivateScripting
items.documentation: The collaborator is editing a script that is not replicated to the server (a local or module script not visible server-side).

enums.name: CollisionFidelity
enums.documentation: Determines behavior of the collision hitbox for MeshPart and PartOperation instances.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Collision model uses a voxel-based convex-hull decomposition that is relatively fast but may not be highly accurate, especially for holes, doorways, and cavities in general.

items.name: Hull
items.documentation: Collision model uses the convex hull of the visual mesh.

items.name: Box
items.documentation: Collision model uses a bounding box that encompasses the visual mesh.

items.name: PreciseConvexDecomposition
items.documentation: Collison model uses a convex-hull decomposition of the visual mesh which is computed by a variation of an algorithm called HACD. This option is the most accurate representation of collision geometry for complex objects with built-in tolerances to reduce the total number of convex-hulls by compromising on accuracy when justified.

items.name: Tunable
items.documentation: Collision model that supports precision tuning of convex decomposition fidelity.

enums.name: CommandPermission
enums.documentation: Specifies the minimum security permission level required to invoke a Studio command.

items.name: Plugin
items.documentation: The command is accessible to scripts running at the standard Plugin security level.

items.name: LocalUser
items.documentation: The command requires the LocalUser security level, granting access to IDE-only APIs.

enums.name: CompletionAcceptanceBehavior
enums.documentation: Controls how the Script Editor inserts or replaces text when an autocomplete suggestion is accepted with Enter or Tab.

items.name: Insert
items.documentation: Accepting a completion with either Enter or Tab inserts the suggestion without replacing existing text after the cursor.

items.name: Replace
items.documentation: Accepting a completion with either Enter or Tab replaces existing text after the cursor with the full suggestion text.

items.name: ReplaceOnEnterInsertOnTab
items.documentation: Pressing Enter replaces existing text after the cursor; pressing Tab inserts without replacing text after the cursor.

items.name: InsertOnEnterReplaceOnTab
items.documentation: Pressing Enter inserts without replacing text after the cursor; pressing Tab replaces text after the cursor. This is the default of Studio.AutocompleteAcceptanceBehavior.

enums.name: CompletionItemKind
enums.documentation: Indicates the category of a script editor autocomplete suggestion, controlling its icon and display in the completion list.

items.name: Text
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a plain text suggestion.

items.name: Method
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a method on a class or object.

items.name: Function
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a function.

items.name: Constructor
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a constructor.

items.name: Field
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a field within a record or struct.

items.name: Variable
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a variable binding.

items.name: Class
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a class or type definition.

items.name: Interface
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents an interface type.

items.name: Module
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a module.

items.name: Property
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a property on a class or object.

items.name: Unit
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a unit of measurement or a module-level value.

items.name: Enum
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents an enum type.

items.name: Keyword
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a language keyword.

items.name: Snippet
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents an insertable code snippet with tab stops.

items.name: Color
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a color value.

items.name: File
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a file reference.

items.name: Reference
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a reference to another symbol.

items.name: Folder
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a folder or directory.

items.name: EnumMember
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents an individual enum member value.

items.name: Constant
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a constant value.

items.name: Struct
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a struct or table type.

items.name: Event
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents an event.

items.name: Operator
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents an operator.

items.name: TypeParameter
items.documentation: Indicates the completion item represents a generic type parameter.

enums.name: CompletionItemTag
enums.documentation: Determines the tags for completion items in ScriptEditorService:RegisterAutocompleteCallback().

items.name: Deprecated
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion is deprecated, applying a penalty towards its score and crossing it out in the completion list.

items.name: IncorrectIndexType
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion is a member and being accessed with the wrong index type (e.g. using : to access a property), hiding it from the completion list.

items.name: PluginPermissions
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion requires Plugin security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

items.name: CommandLinePermissions
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion requires Command line security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

items.name: RobloxPermissions
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion requires core script security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

items.name: AddParens
items.documentation: Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

items.name: PutCursorInParens
items.documentation: Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor and move the cursor into the parentheses after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

items.name: TypeCorrect
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion is type correct in the current context, granting a bonus to its score.

items.name: ClientServerBoundaryViolation
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion is being accessed from the wrong side of the client/server boundary (e.g. Players.LocalPlayer in a server script), hiding it from the completion list.

items.name: Invalidated
items.documentation: Indicates that the completion is stale because the cursor has moved outside the item's valid replacement range, hiding it from the completion list.

items.name: PutCursorBeforeEnd
items.documentation: Instructs the editor to move the cursor to just before the nearest preceding end keyword after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

enums.name: CompositeValueCurveType
enums.documentation: Describes the type of value animated by a CompositeValueCurve.

items.name: ColorRGB
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "R", "G", and "B" to animate the corresponding components of the Color3 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: ColorHSV
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "H", "S", and "V" to animate hue, saturation, and value of a color that will be converted to RGB before returning a Color3 value from the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: NumberRange
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "Min" and "Max" to animate the corresponding components of the NumberRange value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: Rect
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "MinX", "MaxX", "MinY", and "MaxY" to animate the corresponding components of the Rect value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: UDim
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "Scale" and "Offset" to animate the corresponding components of the UDim value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: UDim2
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "ScaleX", "OffsetX", "ScaleY", and "OffsetY" to animate the corresponding components of the UDim2 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: Vector2
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "X" and "Y" to animate the corresponding components of the Vector2 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: Vector3
items.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "X", "Y", and "Z" to animate the corresponding components of the Vector3 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

enums.name: CompressionAlgorithm
enums.documentation: A compression algorithm to use in EncodingService methods.

items.name: Zstd
items.documentation: Used to perform compression using Zstandard compression, also known as zstd.

enums.name: ComputerCameraMovementMode
enums.documentation: The camera movement mode currently in-use by the client.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default camera movement mode is classic.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Follow
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Orbital
items.documentation: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

items.name: CameraToggle
items.documentation: The camera toggles between locked and free rotation with the right mouse button.

enums.name: ComputerMovementMode
enums.documentation: The computer movement type in-use by the client.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The movement mode has not been explicitly set and behaves identically to KeyboardMouse.

items.name: KeyboardMouse
items.documentation: The player moves their character using keyboard keys and steers the camera with the mouse.

items.name: ClickToMove
items.documentation: The player moves their character by clicking a destination in the game world; the character automatically navigates there and jumps over surmountable obstacles.

enums.name: ConfigSnapshotErrorState
enums.documentation: Describes the error state of a ConfigSnapshot object.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Indicates the snapshot loaded successfully with no error; this is the default state.

items.name: LoadFailed
items.documentation: Indicates the snapshot failed to load because the underlying config service was unavailable at construction time.

enums.name: ConnectionState
enums.documentation: Used to determine the connection state of the client to the game server.

items.name: Connected
items.documentation: The client is connected.

items.name: Disconnected
items.documentation: The client is disconnected.

enums.name: ContentSourceType
enums.documentation: The source type of a Content value.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Empty value with no source type. Does not reference any content or hold any non‑nil value.

items.name: Uri
items.documentation: An asset URI string value contained in Content.Uri.

items.name: Object
items.documentation: A non-nil Object reference contained in Content.Object.

items.name: Opaque
items.documentation: A non-nil Opaque reference contained in Content.Opaque.

enums.name: ContextActionPriority
enums.documentation: Describes the priority of a context action.

items.name: Low
items.documentation: The lowest named priority level (value 1000); an action at this level is invoked after High and Medium actions bound to the same input.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: The default priority level (value 2000); used automatically by ContextActionService:BindAction() and falls between High and Low in processing order.

items.name: High
items.documentation: The highest named priority level (value 3000); an action at this level is invoked before Medium and Low actions bound to the same input.

enums.name: ContextActionResult
enums.documentation: Describes whether a contextual action should sink or pass input events.

items.name: Sink
items.documentation: If functionToBind from ContextActionService:BindAction() returns ContextActionResult.Sink, the input event will stop at that function and no other bound actions under it will be processed. This is the default behavior if functionToBind does not return anything or yields in any way.

items.name: Pass
items.documentation: If functionToBind from ContextActionService:BindAction() returns ContextActionResult.Pass, the input event is considered to have not been handled by functionToBind and will continue being passed to actions bound to the same input type.

enums.name: ControlMode
enums.documentation: The ControlMode Enum sets how the player is controlled.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Allows the camera to be moved by clicking and dragging with the right mouse button.

items.name: MouseLockSwitch
items.documentation: Similar to classic, but allows the player to toggle mouse locking, causing the camera to rotate as the player moves the mouse (without holding down a button).

enums.name: CoreGuiType
enums.documentation: Represents all available CoreGui \"types\" such as the Backpack and text chat window.

items.name: PlayerList
items.documentation: Dynamically updated Players list, commonly used as a leaderboard.

items.name: Health
items.documentation: The character's Health bar.

items.name: Backpack
items.documentation: The character's Backpack which contains in‑experience tools.

items.name: Chat
items.documentation: The text chat window.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Refers to all available core UI.

items.name: EmotesMenu
items.documentation: Popup menu of character emotes.

items.name: SelfView
items.documentation: A player's perspective or view of their own character.

items.name: Captures
items.documentation: A "capture" button along the right side of the screen.

items.name: AvatarSwitcher
items.documentation: The Avatar Switcher allows users to change their platform avatar.

items.name: ExperienceShop
items.documentation: The in-experience shop overlay that lets players browse and purchase items without leaving the experience.

enums.name: CreateAssetResult
enums.documentation: Indicates the outcome of a call to AssetService:CreateAssetAsync() or AssetService:CreateAssetVersionAsync().

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The asset was created or updated successfully.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.documentation: The caller does not have permission to create or update an asset in the target inventory.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.documentation: The upload request to the Roblox asset service failed for a reason other than a permission error.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: An unexpected error occurred and the operation could not complete.

enums.name: CreateContentResult
enums.documentation: Indicates the result of a AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The content object was created and stored successfully.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.documentation: The user does not have the required permissions to perform this operation.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.documentation: Asset failed to upload.

items.name: StorageLimitExceeded
items.documentation: The storage budget limit for DataModel-scoped content was exceeded.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: An unknown error occurred.

enums.name: CreateOutfitFailure
enums.documentation: Indicates why a AvatarEditorService:PromptCreateOutfit() call failed.

items.name: InvalidName
items.documentation: The outfit name provided by the player was rejected as invalid.

items.name: OutfitLimitReached
items.documentation: The player has reached the maximum number of saved outfits.

items.name: Other
items.documentation: The outfit creation failed for an unspecified or unrecognized reason.

enums.name: CreatorType
enums.documentation: Indicates whether the currently running place is owned by an individual user or a group.

items.name: User
items.documentation: The place is owned by a single user.

items.name: Group
items.documentation: The place is owned by a group.

enums.name: CreatorTypeFilter
enums.documentation: Specifies which creator type to include when filtering catalog search results in CatalogSearchParams.

items.name: User
items.documentation: Limits catalog search results to items created by individual users.

items.name: Group
items.documentation: Limits catalog search results to items created by groups.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Includes items from all creator types; no filtering by creator is applied.

enums.name: CurrencyType
enums.documentation: The CurrencyType Enum is used with MarketplaceService to set the currency used.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Use the default currency (Robux), equivalent to not specifying a currency.

items.name: Robux
items.documentation: Use Robux.

items.name: Tix
items.documentation: Use Tickets.

enums.name: CustomCameraMode
enums.documentation: Changes the player's camera mode.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default camera mode is classic.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Follow
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

enums.name: DataStoreRequestType
enums.documentation: Indicates the type of data store request being made.

items.name: GetAsync

items.name: SetIncrementAsync

items.name: UpdateAsync
items.documentation: Refers to UpdateAsync().

items.name: GetSortedAsync
items.documentation: Refers to GetSortedAsync().

items.name: SetIncrementSortedAsync
items.documentation: Refers to SetAsync() IncrementAsync(), RemoveAsync(), and the write of UpdateAsync() while using an OrderedDataStore.

items.name: OnUpdate
items.documentation: Refers to OnUpdate().

items.name: ListAsync
items.documentation: Refers to ListKeysAsync() and ListVersionsAsync().

items.name: GetVersionAsync
items.documentation: Refers to GetVersionAsync().

items.name: RemoveVersionAsync
items.documentation: Refers to RemoveVersionAsync().

items.name: StandardRead
items.documentation: Refers to GetAsync(), GetVersionAsync(), GetVersionAtTimeAsync(), and the read of UpdateAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: StandardWrite
items.documentation: Refers to SetAsync(), IncrementAsync(), and the write of UpdateAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: StandardList
items.documentation: Refers to ListDataStoresAsync(), and ListKeysAsync() and ListVersionsAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: StandardRemove

items.name: OrderedRead

items.name: OrderedWrite

items.name: OrderedList

items.name: OrderedRemove
items.documentation: Refers to RemoveAsync() for OrderedDataStore.

enums.name: DebugBreakModeType
enums.documentation: Controls when the debugger pauses on exceptions.

items.name: Never
items.documentation: Never break on exceptions.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: Break on all exceptions.

items.name: Unhandled
items.documentation: Break only on unhandled exceptions.

enums.name: DebuggerEndReason
enums.documentation: Reason for the end of the debugger session.

items.name: ClientRequest
items.documentation: Client requested connection termination.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: Connection timed out.

items.name: InvalidHost
items.documentation: Invalid host:port combination.

items.name: Disconnected
items.documentation: Connection was lost.

items.name: ServerShutdown
items.documentation: Server terminated the connection because it shut down.

items.name: ServerProtocolMismatch
items.documentation: Server has wrong version of protocol.

items.name: ConfigurationFailed
items.documentation: Got a failure response when trying to configure the server.

items.name: RpcError
items.documentation: An error occurred in the RPC layer.

enums.name: DebuggerExceptionBreakMode
enums.documentation: Controls when the Luau debugger pauses script execution in response to a runtime exception.

items.name: Never
items.documentation: The debugger never pauses due to a runtime exception; execution continues normally regardless of whether the exception is caught or uncaught.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: The debugger pauses on every runtime exception, including those caught by pcall or xpcall.

items.name: Unhandled
items.documentation: The debugger pauses only on runtime exceptions that propagate without being caught by pcall or xpcall.

enums.name: DebuggerFrameType
enums.documentation: Call stack frame type.

items.name: C
items.documentation: Call stack frame belongs to a C (native) function.

items.name: Lua
items.documentation: Call stack frame belongs to a Luau function.

enums.name: DebuggerPauseReason
enums.documentation: Reason that the DataModel was paused.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Pausing for a reason not covered by other values.

items.name: Requested
items.documentation: Pause was requested by user.

items.name: Breakpoint
items.documentation: Pausing on a user breakpoint.

items.name: Exception
items.documentation: Pausing on error hit in the code.

items.name: SingleStep
items.documentation: Pausing on an internal breakpoint set by debugger command: e.g. step over, step into, step out of.

items.name: Entrypoint
items.documentation: Pausing at the entry on the script.

enums.name: DebuggerResumeType
enums.documentation: Specifies how the debugger should resume execution after a pause.

items.name: StepInto
items.documentation: Step into the next function call on the specified thread.

items.name: StepOut
items.documentation: Step out of the current function on the specified thread.

items.name: StepOver
items.documentation: Step over the current line on the specified thread.

items.name: Resume
items.documentation: Resume execution normally without stepping.

enums.name: DebuggerStatus
enums.documentation: Result of a debugger request.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: Request has completed successfully.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: Timed out while waiting for response.

items.name: ConnectionLost
items.documentation: Connection to the debugger was lost.

items.name: InvalidResponse
items.documentation: Failed to parse response.

items.name: InternalError
items.documentation: Exception encountered while processing response.

items.name: InvalidState
items.documentation: The request was not appropriate for the current debugger state.

items.name: RpcError
items.documentation: Response was an error.

items.name: InvalidArgument

items.name: ConnectionClosed
items.documentation: Connection closed while waiting for response.

enums.name: DefaultScriptSyncFileType
enums.documentation: Controls the file extension used when Studio's script sync feature saves script instances to the filesystem.

items.name: Lua

items.name: Luau
items.documentation: Script files are synced to the filesystem with a .luau extension.

enums.name: DevCameraOcclusionMode
enums.documentation: Determines how the default camera handles objects that are in-between the camera and the camera subject.

items.name: Zoom
items.documentation: The camera zooms in until there is nothing between it and its subject.

items.name: Invisicam
items.documentation: Any objects between the camera and its subject become translucent locally.

enums.name: DevComputerCameraMovementMode
enums.documentation: Overwrites the player's camera movement mode setting on a computer.

items.name: UserChoice
items.documentation: The camera will move based on the player's settings.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Follow
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Orbital
items.documentation: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

items.name: CameraToggle
items.documentation: The camera toggles between locked and free rotation with the right mouse button.

enums.name: DevComputerMovementMode
enums.documentation: Sets the movement mode of players who are playing on computers.

items.name: UserChoice
items.documentation: Allows players to choose their desired control scheme from the in-experience menu. This is the default movement mode.

items.name: KeyboardMouse
items.documentation: The player's character will be controlled using the keyboard and mouse.

items.name: ClickToMove
items.documentation: Players can only move through the experience by clicking a target location. The player's character will automatically jump when reaching a surmountable obstacle/gap while moving to the click destination.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: Disables all default controls and allows you to script your own control scheme.

enums.name: DeveloperMemoryTag
enums.documentation: A memory tracking category.

items.name: Internal
items.documentation: General data that doesn't have any categorization. This could be due to either internal reasons, or because it simply isn't being tracked categorically.

items.name: HttpCache

items.name: Instances
items.documentation: All the Instances present in memory.

items.name: Signals
items.documentation: Events, signals, connections, etc.

items.name: LuaHeap
items.documentation: All of the data in Luau, including everything happening in core scripts, built-in data types, etc.

items.name: Script
items.documentation: All memory being manipulated and referenced by scripts.

items.name: PhysicsCollision
items.documentation: Collision detection in the Workspace.

items.name: BaseParts
items.documentation: 3D parts used for simulation.

items.name: GraphicsSolidModels

items.name: GraphicsMeshParts

items.name: GraphicsParticles

items.name: GraphicsParts

items.name: GraphicsSpatialHash

items.name: GraphicsTerrain
items.documentation: Rendering of terrain geometry.

items.name: GraphicsTexture
items.documentation: Rendering of textures in the game world.

items.name: GraphicsTextureCharacter
items.documentation: Rendering of texture composition maps that are generated for Humanoids.

items.name: Sounds
items.documentation: Data of sounds in-game.

items.name: StreamingSounds
items.documentation: Playback of sounds in-game.

items.name: TerrainVoxels
items.documentation: Occupancy/Material data of the Terrain.

items.name: Gui
items.documentation: Gui element data and rendering.

items.name: Animation
items.documentation: Playback of Animations on Humanoids and AnimationControllers.

items.name: Navigation
items.documentation: Pathfinding for Humanoids via the PathfindingService.

items.name: GeometryCSG

items.name: GraphicsSlimModels
items.documentation: Rendering memory for SLIM (streamed level-of-detail instance mesh) model data.

enums.name: DeviceForm
enums.documentation: Describes the physical form factor of a device used during Studio device emulation.

items.name: Console
items.documentation: Represents a gaming console device, such as an Xbox or PlayStation.

items.name: Phone
items.documentation: Represents a mobile phone with a touchscreen.

items.name: Tablet
items.documentation: Represents a tablet with a touchscreen.

items.name: Desktop
items.documentation: Represents a desktop or laptop computer.

items.name: VR
items.documentation: Represents a virtual reality headset.

enums.name: DeviceLevel
enums.documentation: Classifies a device's hardware capability tier.

items.name: Low
items.documentation: Indicates a low-end device that benefits from reduced graphics or simulation quality.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: Indicates a mid-range device that may benefit from moderate reductions in resource-intensive features.

items.name: High
items.documentation: Indicates a high-end device capable of running resource-intensive features at full fidelity.

enums.name: DeviceSimulatorScalingMode
enums.documentation: Controls how the Device Simulator viewport scales the simulated device resolution within the Studio window.

items.name: ScaleToPhysicalSize
items.documentation: Scales the simulated viewport so that its pixels correspond to their physical size on the developer's monitor, computed from the screen DPI and an optional target DPI override.

items.name: ActualResolution
items.documentation: Renders the simulated viewport at a 1:1 pixel mapping with no scaling applied.

items.name: FitToWindow
items.documentation: Scales the simulated viewport uniformly to fill as much of the available Studio window as possible while preserving the device's aspect ratio.

enums.name: DeviceType
enums.documentation: Device category of the client.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The client is an unknown device.

items.name: Desktop
items.documentation: The client is a desktop device.

items.name: Tablet
items.documentation: The client is a tablet device.

items.name: Phone
items.documentation: The client is a phone device.

items.name: TV
items.documentation: The client is a TV device.

enums.name: DevTouchCameraMovementMode
enums.documentation: Overwrites the camera mode if the player is on a touch device.

items.name: UserChoice
items.documentation: The camera will move based on the player's settings.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Follow
items.documentation: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Orbital
items.documentation: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

enums.name: DevTouchMovementMode
enums.documentation: Overrides the movement mode of players who are playing on touch-enabled devices.

items.name: UserChoice
items.documentation: Allows players to choose their desired control scheme from the in-experience menu. This is the default movement mode.

items.name: ClickToMove
items.documentation: The player's character will attempt to move to a location in the world when the player taps a location.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: The player's character will not respond to default controls; any character movement must be defined in custom scripts.

items.name: DynamicThumbstick
items.documentation: The player's character is controlled with a virtual thumbstick that appears when they touch the lower portion of the screen. Jumping is controlled with a separate button.

enums.name: DialogBehaviorType
enums.documentation: Controls whether multiple people can use this dialog, or only one person at a time can use it.

items.name: SinglePlayer
items.documentation: Only one player can interact with this dialog at a time. The conversation between the player and dialog can be seen by all players.

items.name: MultiplePlayers
items.documentation: Multiple players can simultaneously interact with this dialog. The conversation between the player and the dialog cannot be seen by other players.

enums.name: DialogPurpose
enums.documentation: The DialogPurpose enum is used to set the icon of a Dialog.

items.name: Quest
items.documentation: Shows an exclamation point ('''!''').

items.name: Help
items.documentation: Shows a question mark ('''?''').

items.name: Shop
items.documentation: Shows a dollar sign ('''$''').

enums.name: DialogTone
enums.documentation: Sets the Dialog.Tone of a Dialog object, which influences how the dialog appears.

items.name: Neutral
items.documentation: Causes the dialog to have a blue bar on its left-hand side.

items.name: Friendly
items.documentation: Causes the dialog to have a green bar on its left-hand side.

items.name: Enemy
items.documentation: Causes the dialog to have a red bar on its left-hand side.

enums.name: DigitsRigDescriptionSide
enums.documentation: Specifies which hand side a DigitsRigDescription instance is assigned to.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The DigitsRigDescription has not been assigned to a hand side and is skipped by the animation system.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: The DigitsRigDescription is assigned to the left hand.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: The DigitsRigDescription is assigned to the right hand.

enums.name: DisplaySize
enums.documentation: This enum is used with GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize to indicate the internally-categorized rendering size of the viewport.

items.name: Small
items.documentation: Viewport is categorized as small. Applies to most tablet/mobile/handheld devices.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: Viewport is categorized as medium. Applies to most laptops and monitors.

items.name: Large
items.documentation: Viewport is categorized as large. Applies to most TVs or larger.

enums.name: DistanceAttenuationMode
enums.documentation: Determines how an AudioEmitter attenuates (fades out) as the distance between the AudioEmitter and an interacting AudioListener increases.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Uses the developer-supplied DistanceAttenuation curve for gain rolloff.

items.name: InverseTapered
items.documentation: Volume attenuates according to a hybrid model which follows the DistanceAttenuationMode.Inverse model when close to the lower bound of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds and the DistanceAttenuationMode.LinearSquared model when close to the upper bound of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds. This is done by taking the lesser of these two curves, such that the curve mostly follows an inverse relationship but tapers to silence at the maximum distance.

items.name: Linear
items.documentation: Volume attenuates between the bounds of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds with a linear relationship. This is done by computing (maxDistance - distance) / (maxDistance - minDistance), where distance is the Vector3.Magnitude between the AudioEmitter's position and the AudioListener's position.

items.name: LinearSquared
items.documentation: Volume attenuates between the bounds of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds with a linear-squared relationship. This is done by squaring the formula used to determine the volume when using DistanceAttenuationMode.Linear, which creates a parabolic curve with a steeper fade.

items.name: Inverse
items.documentation: Volume attenuates from the lower bound of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds in an inverse manner, mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world. This is done by computing (minDistance/distance), where distance is the Vector2.Magnitude between the AudioEmitter's position and the AudioListener's position.

enums.name: DomainType
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of domain that a User is scoped to.

items.name: EXPERIENCE
items.documentation: The user ID is scoped to a specific experience (universe).

items.name: OAUTH
items.documentation: The user ID is scoped to a specific OAuth application.

enums.name: DominantAxis
enums.documentation: Used by UIAspectRatioConstraint.DominantAxis for resizing the object to maintain the aspect ratio.

items.name: Width
items.documentation: The X axis.

items.name: Height
items.documentation: The Y axis.

enums.name: DraftStatusCode
enums.documentation: Describes the state of a script draft tracked by DraftsService.

items.name: OK
items.documentation: The draft is in sync with the server's base version and has no blocking conflicts.

items.name: DraftOutdated
items.documentation: The server version of the script has advanced beyond the base version used when the draft was created, so the draft must be updated before it can be committed.

items.name: ScriptRemoved
items.documentation: The script referenced by the draft no longer exists in the data model.

items.name: DraftCommitted
items.documentation: The draft was successfully committed to the server and removed from the local sandbox.

enums.name: DragDetectorDragStyle
enums.documentation: Used with DragDetector as the paradigm to generate proposed motion, given a stream of cursor rays.

items.name: TranslateLine
items.documentation: 1D motion along the detector's Axis, by default the world Y axis.

items.name: TranslatePlane
items.documentation: 2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the detector's Axis, by default the world XZ plane.

items.name: TranslatePlaneOrLine
items.documentation: 2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the detector's Axis and, when the modifier is active, 1D motion along the detector's Axis.

items.name: TranslateLineOrPlane
items.documentation: 1D motion along the detector's Axis and, when the modifier is active, 2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the detector's Axis.

items.name: TranslateViewPlane
items.documentation: 2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the camera's view. In this mode, the plane is constantly updated, even while dragging, and will always face the camera's current view.

items.name: RotateAxis
items.documentation: Rotation about the detector's Axis, by default the world Y axis.

items.name: RotateTrackball
items.documentation: Trackball rotation, further customized through the TrackballRadialPullFactor and TrackballRollFactor properties.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through SetDragStyleFunction().

items.name: BestForDevice
items.documentation: TranslatePlaneOrLine for mouse and gamepad; TranslatePlane for touch; 6DOF for VR.

enums.name: DragDetectorPermissionPolicy
enums.documentation: Used to control the permission level for which players can interact with a DragDetector.

items.name: Nobody
items.documentation: No players can interact with the DragDetector.

items.name: Everybody
items.documentation: All players can interact with the DragDetector.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: Invokes the function registered via DragDetector:SetPermissionPolicyFunction(), enabling/disabling the detector based on whether the function returns true or false.

enums.name: DragDetectorResponseStyle
enums.documentation: Describes how the clicked object will be treated once the desired motion has been calculated.

items.name: Geometric
items.documentation: For an Anchored object both inside the running experience and in Studio edit mode, the position/orientation of the object will be updated to exactly reflect the proposed motion. For an unanchored object, behavior is the same as for an anchored object; however, in a running experience, the object will be anchored at the start of the drag and restored to unanchored upon drag release.

items.name: Physical
items.documentation: An Anchored object will default to Geometric behavior as it is not affected by forces. An unanchored object will be moved by constraint forces that attempt to bring it to the desired position and/or orientation given by the proposed motion.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: The object will not move at all, but DragFrame will still be updated and you can respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

enums.name: DraggerCoordinateSpace
enums.documentation: Determines the coordinate space used when dragging objects in Studio.

items.name: Object
items.documentation: Dragging is performed relative to the object's local coordinate space.

items.name: World
items.documentation: Dragging is performed relative to the world coordinate space.

enums.name: DraggerMovementMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether DraggerService moves parts geometrically or with physics simulation during Studio drag operations.

items.name: Geometric
items.documentation: Parts are moved by directly updating their position and orientation, ignoring physics and constraints.

items.name: Physical
items.documentation: Parts are moved by applying physics impulses, so constraints and collisions are respected during the drag.

enums.name: EasingDirection
enums.documentation: Enum used with TweenInfo.new() to control the direction Tweens play in.

items.name: In
items.documentation: The easing style is applied in a forward direction.

items.name: Out
items.documentation: The easing style is applied in a reverse direction.

items.name: InOut
items.documentation: The easing style is applied forward for the first half and in reverse for the second half.

enums.name: EasingStyle
enums.documentation: Enum used with TweenInfo.new to control the motion of a Tween.

items.name: Linear
items.documentation: Moves at a constant speed.

items.name: Sine
items.documentation: Speed is determined by a sine wave for a gentle easing motion.

items.name: Back
items.documentation: Slightly overshoots the target, then backs into place.

items.name: Quad
items.documentation: Similar to Sine but with a slightly sharper curve based on quadratic interpolation.

items.name: Quart
items.documentation: Similar to Cubic but with an even sharper curve based on quartic interpolation.

items.name: Quint
items.documentation: Similar to Quart but with an even sharper curve based on quintic interpolation.

items.name: Bounce
items.documentation: Bounces backwards multiple times after reaching the target, before eventually settling.

items.name: Elastic
items.documentation: Moves as if attached to a rubber band, overshooting the target several times.

items.name: Exponential
items.documentation: The sharpest curve based on exponential interpolation.

items.name: Circular
items.documentation: Follows a circular arc, such that acceleration is more sudden and deceleration more gradual versus Quint or Exponential.

items.name: Cubic
items.documentation: Similar to Quad but with a slightly sharper curve based on cubic interpolation.

enums.name: ElasticBehavior
enums.documentation: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ElasticBehavior to control when elastic scrolling is active on touch‑enabled devices.

items.name: WhenScrollable
items.documentation: Scrolling is elastic when there is content to be scrolled to.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: Scrolling is always elastic, even when there isn't content available to scroll to.

items.name: Never
items.documentation: Scrolling is never elastic and the canvas will never scroll beyond its bounds.

enums.name: EmitterPositionType
enums.documentation: Defines where and how an AudioEmitter is positioned when sending out spatial audio.

items.name: Parent
items.documentation: Uses the parent Instance of the AudioEmitter.

items.name: Instance
items.documentation: Uses a specified Instance.

enums.name: EngagementLevel
enums.documentation: Describes how many days a player played the current experience in the last 7 days, represented as a bucket.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Inactive
items.documentation: The player did not play the experience in the last 7 days.

items.name: Low
items.documentation: The player played the experience on 1 of the last 7 days.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: The player played the experience on 2 or 3 of the last 7 days.

items.name: High
items.documentation: The player played the experience on 4 to 7 of the last 7 days.

enums.name: EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle
enums.documentation: Used to control the throttle rate of Roblox's physics engine.

items.name: DefaultAuto
items.documentation: Automatically adjusts throttle level based on performance.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: No throttling; every physics step runs.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: Maximum throttling; physics is effectively frozen.

items.name: Skip2
items.documentation: Runs 1 out of every 2 steps (50% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.

items.name: Skip4
items.documentation: Runs 1 out of every 4 steps (75% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.

items.name: Skip8
items.documentation: Runs 1 out of every 8 steps (87.5% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.

items.name: Skip16
items.documentation: Runs 1 out of every 16 steps (93.75% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.

enums.name: ExperienceActivationStatus
enums.documentation: Describes whether a player is new, active, lapsed, or reactivated in the current experience.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: New
items.documentation: The player first played the experience within the last 30 days.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: The player played the experience in the last 30 days and is not New or Reactivated.

items.name: Lapsed
items.documentation: The player has not played the experience in the last 30 days.

items.name: Reactivated
items.documentation: The player returned to the experience within the last 30 days after being Lapsed.

enums.name: ExperienceAuthScope
enums.documentation: Enumerates the authorization scopes an experience can request when prompting a creator for permission to access their assets.

items.name: DefaultScope
items.documentation: The base scope (value 0) representing no additional permissions; used internally when no specific asset authorization is required.

items.name: CreatorAssetsCreate
items.documentation: Requests read and write access to the creator's assets; maps to the asset:*:read,write authorization token scope.

enums.name: ExperienceEventStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the lifecycle state of a Roblox experience event as returned by SocialService.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: The event is currently published and available.

items.name: Cancelled
items.documentation: The event has been cancelled and will not occur.

items.name: Moderated
items.documentation: The event has been removed by moderation.

items.name: Unpublished
items.documentation: The event has been unpublished by the creator.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The event status could not be determined.

enums.name: ExplosionType
enums.documentation: Determines whether an Explosion creates craters when it detonates.

items.name: NoCraters
items.documentation: Explosion does not generate craters.

items.name: Craters
items.documentation: Explosion generates craters.

enums.name: ExternalEditorMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether Roblox Studio opens scripts in the operating system's default editor or in a user-selected external editor.

items.name: SystemDefault

enums.name: FilterErrorType
enums.documentation: Identifies the category of a parse or validation error produced by the Studio Explorer filter expression engine.

items.name: BackslashNotEscapingAnything
items.documentation: A backslash at the end of a quoted string has nothing after it to escape.

items.name: BadBespokeFilter
items.documentation: A recognized bespoke filter keyword (such as classname:) is missing its required value, or a query: expression contains an invalid query string.

items.name: BadName
items.documentation: An unexpected token was encountered where a name or identifier was expected.

items.name: IncompleteOr
items.documentation: Reserved error code for an incomplete or expression; currently not emitted by the filter engine.

items.name: IncompleteParenthesis
items.documentation: An opening parenthesis ( in the filter expression has no matching closing parenthesis ).

items.name: InvalidDoubleStar
items.documentation: A wildcard token directly follows a * wildcard in a dotted name path (for example, A.*..X), which is not allowed.

items.name: InvalidTilde
items.documentation: A lone ~ character was found that is not part of the ~= not-equal operator.

items.name: PropertyBadOperator
items.documentation: A comparison operator other than = or ~= was used with a property type that only supports equality comparisons.

items.name: PropertyDoesNotExist
items.documentation: The named property does not exist on any reflected class known to the filter engine.

items.name: PropertyInvalidField
items.documentation: A sub-field index (such as .W) was used with a vector or color property that does not have a field by that name.

items.name: PropertyInvalidValue
items.documentation: The value string provided for a property comparison cannot be parsed into the expected type for that property (for example, Locked=notabool).

items.name: PropertyUnsupportedFields
items.documentation: A sub-field index was used with a property type that does not support field access (for example, Locked.X=true).

items.name: PropertyUnsupportedProperty
items.documentation: The named property exists but its type is not supported by the filter engine (for example, complex datatypes such as CFrame or TweenInfo).

items.name: UnexpectedNameIndex
items.documentation: A . in a dotted name path is not followed by a valid name, number, or wildcard token.

items.name: UnexpectedToken
items.documentation: A token that cannot be a value (such as an operator) appears where a value is expected after a comparison operator.

items.name: UnfinishedBinaryOperator
items.documentation: An and or or binary operator appears with no right-hand operand.

items.name: UnfinishedQuote
items.documentation: A quoted string was opened but not closed before the end of the filter input.

items.name: UnknownBespokeFilter
items.documentation: A name:value token uses a keyword that is not a recognized bespoke filter type (for example, foo:Bar).

items.name: WildcardInProperty
items.documentation: A wildcard (* or **) appears in the property portion of a dotted expression where a concrete property name is required.

items.name: Experimental

enums.name: ForceLimitMode
enums.documentation: The ForceLimitMode enum determines how the maximum force for a constraint is specified and how that limit is enforced by the constraint.

items.name: PerAxis

items.name: Off

items.name: RobloxSquare

items.name: RobloxRound
items.documentation: Causes the frame to appear as a translucent dark gray rectangle with rounded edges. Like RobloxSquare, this has a padding of five pixels on all sides.

items.name: ChatGreen
items.documentation: Causes the frame to appear similar to a Dialog with its Tone property set to DialogTone.Friendly. Like ChatBlue and ChatRed, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on all sides.

items.name: ChatRed

items.name: DropShadow

enums.name: GradientTileMode
enums.documentation: Used alongside UIGradient.TileMode to set how the gradient repeats.

items.name: Clamp
items.documentation: Default mode where the color/transparency values at the start and end of the sequence extend infinitely, so the start values fill any area before the gradient and the end values fill any area after it.

items.name: Repeat
items.documentation: The gradient repeats by wrapping the color/transparency sequence tiles seamlessly from end back to start. This can produce a visible seam if the first and last color/transparency values in the sequence differ.

items.name: Mirror
items.documentation: The gradient reflects at each boundary so the color/transparency sequence ping-pongs. This produces a smooth repetition with no seam, since the direction reverses at each tile edge.

enums.name: GradientType
enums.documentation: Used alongside UIGradient.Type to set the shape of the gradient.

items.name: Linear
items.documentation: The color/transparency sequence transitions in a straight line across the element. The direction is controlled by Rotation and the position by Offset.

items.name: Radial
items.documentation: The color/transparency sequence radiates outward from the element's center, optionally shifted by Offset. The radius is defined by the average of the element's width and height divided by two, effectively (width+height)/4. Rotation has no effect on a radial gradient.

items.name: Conical
items.documentation: The color/transparency sequence sweeps clockwise around the center of the element, optionally shifted by Offset. Rotation controls the starting angle of the sweep.

items.name: Elliptical
items.documentation: The color/transparency sequence radiates outward from the element's center in an ellipse, optionally shifted by Offset. The ellipse's horizontal and vertical radii are half the element's width and height, respectively, so the ellipse fits the element's bounds. Rotation rotates the ellipse's axes.

items.name: OpenGL

enums.name: GraphicsOptimizationMode

items.name: Balanced

items.name: Quality

enums.name: GroupMembershipStatus

items.name: Joined
items.documentation: The player successfully joined the group during the prompt.

items.name: JoinRequestPending
items.documentation: The player submitted a request to join the group, or already had a pending join request prior to prompting.

items.name: AlreadyMember

items.name: Press

items.name: NonInteractable

enums.name: HandlesStyle

items.name: Resize
