items.name: Movement
items.documentation: Renders Handles as directional arrow shapes for translating an adornee along its face axes.

enums.name: HapticEffectType
enums.documentation: Enum used alongside HapticEffect.Type.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Allows for application of a custom haptic waveform through the HapticEffect:SetWaveformKeys() method.

items.name: UIHover
items.documentation: Useful for when a player browses over an object (often a UI object) without the intention of triggering its action; it can also alert the player that they have browsed over an interactable object. This effect type is subtle and does not disrupt the gameplay experience.

items.name: UIClick
items.documentation: Useful for when a player has selected an object (often a UI object) with the intention of triggering its action. This effect type is crisp and it provides immediate feedback without being overwhelming.

items.name: UINotification
items.documentation: Useful for when there is an inbound message that should draw the player's attention away from their current gameplay and prompt them that the notification requires immediate attention or action.

items.name: GameplayExplosion
items.documentation: Useful to signify a large-scale physics event that triggers impact across a large portion of a given scene. This effect is high intensity in order to represent the magnitude of the impact and it lingers for a longer period of time than GameplayCollision.

items.name: GameplayCollision
items.documentation: This effect is a large immediate rumble that dies down quickly, useful to signify a clear and purposeful impact between objects.

enums.name: HashAlgorithm
enums.documentation: A Cryptographic hash function to use in EncodingService methods.

items.name: Blake2b
items.documentation: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the BLAKE2b algorithm.

items.name: Blake3
items.documentation: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the BLAKE3 algorithm.

items.name: Md5
items.documentation: Used to compute a 128-bit (16-byte) hash digest using the MD5 algorithm.

items.name: Sha1
items.documentation: Used to compute a 160-bit (20-byte) hash digest using the SHA-1 algorithm.

items.name: Sha256
items.documentation: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the SHA256 algorithm.

enums.name: HighlightDepthMode
enums.documentation: Controls how the Highlight effect displays with respect to other objects in the world.

items.name: AlwaysOnTop
items.documentation: Allows the Highlight to display regardless if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object. This means the viewer is always able to see the highlight regardless of what is between the highlighted object and the camera.

items.name: Occluded
items.documentation: Hides the Highlight if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object. This means the viewer is only able to see the object if there are no obstructing objects between the highlighted object and the camera's view.

enums.name: HorizontalAlignment
enums.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.HorizontalAlignment to align the layout horizontally within its parent.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the X axis.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: Grid is aligned to the left edge of its parent.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: Grid is aligned to the right edge of its parent.

enums.name: HoverAnimateSpeed
enums.documentation: Specifies the animation speed of the hover highlight in Roblox Studio.

items.name: VerySlow
items.documentation: 2 seconds per cycle.

items.name: Slow
items.documentation: 1 second per cycle.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: 0.5 seconds per cycle.

items.name: Fast
items.documentation: 0.25 seconds per cycle.

items.name: VeryFast
items.documentation: 0.1 seconds per cycle.

enums.name: HttpCompression
enums.documentation: Specifies the compression algorithm applied to HTTP request body sent via HttpService.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No compression is applied to the request body. This is the default.

items.name: Gzip
items.documentation: The request body is compressed using the Gzip algorithm before being sent.

enums.name: HttpContentType
enums.documentation: Specifies the value of the HTTP Content-Type header which describes the HTTP request data type.

items.name: ApplicationJson
items.documentation: Represents the "application/json" Content-Type.

items.name: ApplicationXml
items.documentation: Represents the "application/xml" Content-Type.

items.name: ApplicationUrlEncoded
items.documentation: Represents the "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" Content-Type.

items.name: TextPlain
items.documentation: Represents the "text/plain" Content-Type.

items.name: TextXml
items.documentation: Represents the "text/xml" Content-Type.

enums.name: HttpError
enums.documentation: Enum representing errors that can occur when making HTTP requests, unrelated to HTTP status codes returned by the server.

items.name: OK
items.documentation: No error occurred; the request completed successfully. This value is unrelated to the HTTP 200 OK status code.

items.name: InvalidUrl
items.documentation: The request URL is malformed or otherwise invalid; depending on the platform, a bad URL might instead surface as HttpError.DnsResolve or HttpError.ConnectFail.

items.name: DnsResolve
items.documentation: The hostname in the request URL could not be resolved via DNS.

items.name: ConnectFail
items.documentation: The client failed to establish a TCP connection to the remote host.

items.name: OutOfMemory
items.documentation: The client ran out of memory while processing the HTTP request or response.

items.name: TimedOut
items.documentation: The request did not receive a response within the allowed time limit.

items.name: TooManyRedirects
items.documentation: The server returned more redirects than the client is configured to follow.

items.name: InvalidRedirect
items.documentation: The server returned a redirect response with an invalid or malformed Location header.

items.name: NetFail
items.documentation: A general network-level failure occurred that does not fall into a more specific error category.

items.name: Aborted
items.documentation: The HTTP request was aborted before it could complete.

items.name: SslConnectFail
items.documentation: The TLS/SSL handshake with the remote server failed during connection establishment.

items.name: SslVerificationFail
items.documentation: The server's TLS certificate could not be verified.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: An error occurred that does not map to any other HttpError value.

items.name: ConnectionClosed
items.documentation: The connection was closed by the remote end before the full response was received, typically indicating a server or network problem.

items.name: ServerProtocolError
items.documentation: An HTTP/2 protocol-level error was returned by the server.

items.name: CreatorEnvironmentsNotSupportedByService
items.documentation: The request was sent from a non-live environment (such as Studio) and the target service does not support creator environments.

items.name: InactivityTimeout
items.documentation: A streaming request timed out because no data was transferred during the inactivity window.

items.name: TooManyOutstandingRequests
items.documentation: The request was rejected because the client has exceeded its limit for concurrent or pending requests.

items.name: InvalidRangeResponse
items.documentation: The server returned an invalid response to a ranged HTTP request, such as responding with a full 200 status instead of the expected 206 Partial Content.

enums.name: HumanoidCollisionType
enums.documentation: The collision Humanoid uses.

items.name: OuterBox
items.documentation: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

items.name: InnerBox
items.documentation: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

enums.name: HumanoidDisplayDistanceType
enums.documentation: HumanoidDisplayDistanceType determines how Humanoid.HealthDisplayDistance, and Humanoid.NameDisplayDistance are used in determining whether a players's name and health are visible to other players.

items.name: Viewer
items.documentation: A player selecting Viewer on their Humanoid will see the Name and healthbar of other players if those other players are within the distance settings set in the Humanoid selecting Viewer (this can be thought of as the lowest priority, and will not be taken into account if other players are selecting 'Subject' or 'None').

items.name: Subject
items.documentation: A player selecting Subject on their Humanoid will allow other players to see their Name and healthbar if those other players are within the distance settings set in the Humanoid selecting Subject (this can be thought of as the second highest priority).

items.name: None
items.documentation: A player selecting None on their Humanoid will not have their Name and healthbar displayed to other players under any circumstance (this can be thought of as the highest priority).

enums.name: HumanoidHealthDisplayType
enums.documentation: Controls under what circumstances the Humanoid health bar is displayed.

items.name: DisplayWhenDamaged
items.documentation: The humanoid's health bar is only visible when the humanoid is not at full health (assuming MaxHealth is greater than zero).

items.name: AlwaysOn
items.documentation: The humanoid's health bar is always visible (assuming MaxHealth is greater than zero).

items.name: AlwaysOff
items.documentation: The humanoid's health bar is never visible.

enums.name: HumanoidRigType
enums.documentation: Describes whether or not a character is using an R15 rig or the legacy R6 rig.

items.name: R6
items.documentation: Indicates that a character is using the legacy R6 rig.

items.name: R15
items.documentation: Indicates that a character is using an R15 rig.

enums.name: HumanoidStateType

items.name: Running
items.documentation: Currently running while on the ground.

items.name: Jumping
items.documentation: The Humanoid just jumped. (Check Humanoid.Jump). This state lasts only briefly. This state normally transitions into either Landed, if on the ground, or Freefall, if still in the air.

items.name: Freefall
items.documentation: The Humanoid is currently freefalling (jumped from a height or fell off a ledge).

items.name: Landed
items.documentation: The Humanoid touched the ground after a Freefall. This state lasts only briefly.

items.name: Dead
items.documentation: The Humanoid died. Changing a Humanoid's state to this state will kill it.

items.name: FallingDown
items.documentation: The Humanoid has been tripped, and will attempt to get up in a few moments.

items.name: Ragdoll
items.documentation: (Deprecated) The Humanoid has been hit by a fast moving object (uncontrolled falling). _The Humanoid can recover from this._ This state has to be set and unset manually using Humanoid:ChangeState().

items.name: GettingUp
items.documentation: The Humanoid is getting back on their feet after FallingDown or Ragdoll.

items.name: Swimming
items.documentation: The Humanoid is currently swimming in Terrain water.

items.name: Flying
items.documentation: When set, the Humanoid won't be animated, as with the Humanoid.PlatformStand property. This state lasts as long as the player flies.

items.name: RunningNoPhysics
items.documentation: (Deprecated) Currently running and not near other physical objects.

items.name: StrafingNoPhysics
items.documentation: Not currently used with default Humanoid. Cannot be set with Humanoid:ChangeState().

items.name: Climbing
items.documentation: The Humanoid is climbing (e.g. up a TrussPart or ladder).

items.name: Seated
items.documentation: The Humanoid is currently sitting in a Seat or VehicleSeat. Check the Humanoid.Sit property.

items.name: PlatformStanding
items.documentation: The Humanoid is platformstanding. Check the Humanoid.PlatformStand property.

items.name: Physics
items.documentation: The Humanoid doesn't apply any force on its own and will not automatically transition to any other state. This state has to be set and unset manually using Humanoid:ChangeState().

items.name: None
items.documentation: Unusable placeholder in case an unknown state gets triggered internally.

enums.documentation: Describes the physics control states within the Humanoid.

enums.name: IKCollisionsMode
enums.documentation: Controls which parts in the workspace participate in collision resolution when WorldRoot:IKMoveTo() drives a part toward a target CFrame.

items.name: NoCollisions
items.documentation: Only the part and any parts directly joined to it via joints/constraints will be involved in the resolution; everything else in the workspace will be treated as though it doesn't exist.

items.name: OtherMechanismsAnchored
items.documentation: Only the part and any parts directly joined to it via joints/constraints will be moved during resolution, but they will collide with other objects in the workspace.

items.name: IncludeContactedMechanisms
items.documentation: The part, any parts directly joined to it via joints/constraints, and any parts which it comes into contact with during the solve will be moved during the resolution. That is, the moved parts will be allowed to "push" other unanchored parts in the workspace out of the way in order to get to the target position.

enums.name: IKControlConstraintSupport
enums.documentation: Values for Workspace.IKControlConstraintSupport. Sets the support for constraints for IKControls in your experience.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default option for IKControls. The default is currently set to Enabled.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables support for constraints for IKControls. When disabled, IKControls still work, but ignore physics constraints.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables support for constraints for IKControls.

enums.name: IKControlType
enums.documentation: Used on IKControl to specify their Type, to change their behavior.

items.name: Transform
items.documentation: It is a full 6-DoF constraint. Aligns the EndEffector CFrame to that of the Target. It is the default value.

items.name: Position
items.documentation: Aligns the EndEffector position to that of the Target .

items.name: Rotation
items.documentation: Aligns the EndEffector rotation to that of the Target.

items.name: LookAt
items.documentation: Moves and orients the whole chain to make the forward axis on the EndEffector point at a position in the world specified by Target.

enums.name: ImageAlphaType
enums.documentation: Enum for determining if the alpha or color is locked while combining two images.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default behavior in which neither color nor alpha values are locked.

items.name: LockCanvasAlpha
items.documentation: The alpha values of the image will not be modified.

items.name: LockCanvasColor
items.documentation: The color values of the image will not be modified.

enums.name: ImageCombineType
enums.documentation: Enum for determining how two images are combined together.

items.name: BlendSourceOver
items.documentation: Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination using source over alpha blending.

items.name: Overwrite
items.documentation: Overwrites all pixels in the destination image with pixels from the source image.

items.name: Add
items.documentation: Adds pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together. Source RGB values are scaled by the source alpha, while source alpha is added directly to destination alpha.

items.name: Multiply
items.documentation: Multiplies pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together. RGBA values are multiplied as values between 0 and 1. Values lower than 1 have a darkening effect on the image.

items.name: AlphaBlend
items.documentation: Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination based on the alpha of the source pixels. Unlike BlendSourceOver, the destination color in AlphaBlend affects the resulting color of the image, regardless of the destination color's alpha.

items.name: NormalMapBlend
items.documentation: Blends pixels from the source with the destination using alpha blending, then renormalizes the resulting RGB values as a tangent-space normal vector.

items.name: Subtract
items.documentation: Subtracts pixels of the source from pixels of the destination. Source RGB values are scaled by the source alpha, while source alpha is subtracted directly from destination alpha.

enums.name: InfoType
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of product information returned by MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync().

items.name: Asset
items.documentation: The product is an asset.

items.name: Product
items.documentation: Product such as a Developer Product.

items.name: GamePass
items.documentation: The product is a game pass.

items.name: Subscription
items.documentation: The product is a subscription.

items.name: Bundle
items.documentation: The product is a bundle.

enums.name: InitialDockState
enums.documentation: Describes the initial docking state of a DockWidgetPluginGui.

items.name: Top
items.documentation: The widget will appear docked above the game screen.

items.name: Bottom
items.documentation: The widget will appear docked below the game screen.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: The widget will appear docked to the left of the game screen.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: The widget will appear docked to the right of the game screen.

items.name: Float
items.documentation: The widget will not be docked to any side of the game screen, and instead can be freely dragged around.

enums.name: InOut
enums.documentation: The InOut Enum is used to set where the object is on the side of its parent.

items.name: Edge
items.documentation: The object is located along an edge of its parent.

items.name: Inset
items.documentation: The object's located is inset from its parent's location.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: The object's location is centered on it's parent.

enums.name: InputActionType
enums.documentation: This enum is used by InputAction.Type to determine which input data type the InputAction will receive.

items.name: Bool
items.documentation: The InputAction will receive boolean values from button inputs, for example true/false on press/release from inputs such as KeyCode.ButtonA or KeyCode.E. This setting also exposes the UIButton property on child InputBindings, allowing you to easily hook up press or release of a GuiButton for the action.

items.name: Direction1D
items.documentation: The InputAction will receive numerical values, generally from analog gamepad triggers such as KeyCode.ButtonL2 or KeyCode.ButtonR2. This setting also exposes the Up and Down properties on child InputBindings, allowing for boolean inputs or "1D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

items.name: Direction2D
items.documentation: The InputAction will receive Vector2 values, generally from thumbstick inputs such as KeyCode.Thumbstick1 and KeyCode.Thumbstick2. This setting also exposes the Up, Down, Left, and Right properties on child InputBindings, allowing for "2D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

items.name: Direction3D
items.documentation: The InputAction will receive Vector3 values from inputs assigned to the Up, Down, Left, Right, Forward, and/or Backward properties on child InputBindings, allowing for "3D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

items.name: ViewportPosition
items.documentation: The InputAction will receive Vector2 values representing the absolute pixel (X, Y) coordinates of a pointer input in the viewport.

enums.name: InputBindingType
enums.documentation: This enum is used by InputBinding.Type to determine whether the binding responds to hardware input or is driven programmatically.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: The InputBinding responds to physical input devices (keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch) based on its KeyCode or composite direction properties. This is the default.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: The InputBinding ignores hardware input and instead receives state updates exclusively through the InputBinding:Fire() method.

enums.name: InputSink
enums.documentation: Controls how a GuiObject or GuiButton absorbs pointer and activation input events relative to GUI elements beneath it.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The element does not sink any input events; pointer and activation events pass through to elements beneath it.

items.name: Activate
items.documentation: The element sinks activation input (button presses and taps) but allows hover, MouseEnter, and MouseLeave events to pass through to elements beneath it.

items.name: All
items.documentation: The element sinks all input events, preventing them from reaching any GUI element beneath it.

enums.name: InputType
enums.documentation: The InputType Enum controls the SurfaceInputs of Part.

items.name: NoInput
items.documentation: Behaves like a weld and does nothing.

items.name: Constant
items.documentation: Rotate at a constant velocity of BasePart ParamB.

items.name: Sin
items.documentation: Rotate at a velocity of: ParamA * math.sin(workspace.DistributedGameTime * ParamB), where BasePart ParamA determines the maximum speed at which the part spins, and BasePart ParamB determines how frequently it changes direction.

enums.name: InstanceFileSyncStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the file sync status of an Instance.

items.name: NotSynced
items.documentation: The Instance is not being synced or errored.

items.name: Errored
items.documentation: The Instance is a sync root that has errored and stopped syncing.

items.name: SyncedAsRoot
items.documentation: The Instance is being synced as the root of a sync tree.

items.name: SyncedAsDescendant
items.documentation: The Instance is being synced because it is a descendant of a sync root.

items.name: AncestorErrored
items.documentation: The Instance is not currently being synced because the root of its sync tree is Errored.

enums.name: IntermediateMeshGenerationResult
enums.documentation: Indicates the type of result delivered via the intermediate-result callback during an asynchronous mesh-generation operation.

items.name: HighQualityMesh
items.documentation: Signals that the intermediate mesh delivered to the callback is high-quality.

enums.name: InterpolationThrottlingMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether the engine reduces the physics interpolation update rate for distant assemblies when the client is under load. Used by the deprecated Workspace.InterpolationThrottling property.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The engine automatically throttles physics interpolation for distant assemblies when client frame time is high.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Physics interpolation throttling is unconditionally disabled; all assemblies interpolate at the full rate regardless of client load.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Physics interpolation throttling is unconditionally enabled; distant assemblies have their interpolation update rate reduced even when the client is not under load.

enums.name: InviteState
enums.documentation: Describes a player's call invite state.

items.name: Placed
items.documentation: Call invite was placed.

items.name: Accepted
items.documentation: Call invite was accepted.

items.name: Declined
items.documentation: Call invite was declined.

items.name: Missed
items.documentation: Call invite was missed.

enums.name: ItemLineAlignment
enums.documentation: Used for UIListLayout.ItemLineAlignment and UIFlexItem.ItemLineAlignment in a flex layout to define the cross-directional alignment of siblings or the parent within a line.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the layout's HorizontalAlignment or VerticalAlignment, depending on its FillDirection. If HorizontalFlex or VerticalFlex is enabled for the UIListLayout cross‑direction, Stretch will be used for that direction.

items.name: Start
items.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's top in a horizontal fill or the line's left in a vertical fill.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's center in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

items.name: End
items.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's bottom in a horizontal fill or the line's right in a vertical fill.

items.name: Stretch
items.documentation: Stretches the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to fill the entire cross‑direction of the line in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

enums.name: IXPLoadingStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the loading state of an IXP (in-experience experiment) layer fetch operation.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The default status when the IXP controller is first constructed or after layers have been cleared.

items.name: Pending
items.documentation: An HTTP request to fetch layer assignments has been sent and a response is awaited.

items.name: Initialized
items.documentation: The HTTP request completed successfully and layer variable values have been populated from the response.

items.name: ErrorInvalidUser
items.documentation: The fetch failed because the requested subject (user) was invalid at the time of the request.

items.name: ErrorConnection
items.documentation: The HTTP request to fetch layer assignments failed due to a connection error.

items.name: ErrorJsonParse
items.documentation: The HTTP request succeeded but the response body could not be parsed as valid JSON.

items.name: ErrorTimedOut
items.documentation: The HTTP request to fetch layer assignments timed out before a response was received.

enums.name: JoinSource
enums.documentation: Identifies the context in which a player joined an experience via a deeplink.

items.name: CreatedItemAttribution
items.documentation: The player joined by following an attribution link for an item created inside an experience.

enums.name: JointCreationMode
enums.documentation: The way joints are created between two surfaces.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Joints are created between any kind of surface. Functions identically to Surface.

items.name: Surface
items.documentation: Joints are created between any kind of surface. Functions identically to All.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Joints are never created, no matter what.

enums.name: KeyCodeStringFormat
enums.documentation: Determines the string format returned by UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode().

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Default behavior which returns the full key string, for example "LeftControl", "Backspace", or "Escape".

items.name: Abbreviated
items.documentation: Returns a shortened key string when available, for example "LCtrl", "Bksp", or "Esc".

enums.name: KeyInterpolationMode
enums.documentation: Describes the interpolation method between two keys.

items.name: Constant
items.documentation: The segment starting at this key will constantly evaluate to the value set at this key.

items.name: Linear
items.documentation: The segment starting at this key will evaluate using a linear interpolation at this key and the value at the next key.

items.name: Cubic
items.documentation: The segment starting at this key will evaluate using cubic interpolation of this key value using its right tangent and the next key value and its left tangent.

enums.name: LeftRight
enums.documentation: The LeftRight Enum is used to set where the object is on the side of its parent.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: The object is on the left side of its parent (X axis).

items.name: Center
items.documentation: The object is centered on the center of its parent (X axis), expanding equally to the left and right of the parent's center.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: The object is on the right side of its parent (X axis).

enums.name: LexemeType
enums.documentation: Identifies the category of a token produced when the Studio Explorer filter bar lexes a filter expression.

items.name: Eof
items.documentation: End-of-input token emitted when the lexer reaches the end of the filter string.

items.name: QuotedString
items.documentation: A string literal token delimited by single (') or double (") quotes, with backslash escape support.

items.name: Number
items.documentation: A numeric literal token representing an integer or decimal value used in a comparison.

items.name: And
items.documentation: The case-insensitive keyword and, used to combine filter conditions with logical AND.

items.name: Or
items.documentation: The case-insensitive keyword or, used to combine filter conditions with logical OR.

items.name: Equal
items.documentation: The equality comparison operator, matched as = or == in a filter expression.

items.name: TildeEqual
items.documentation: The not-equal comparison operator (~=).

items.name: GreaterThan
items.documentation: The greater-than comparison operator (>).

items.name: GreaterThanEqual
items.documentation: The greater-than-or-equal comparison operator (>=).

items.name: LessThan
items.documentation: The less-than comparison operator (<).

items.name: LessThanEqual
items.documentation: The less-than-or-equal comparison operator (<=).

items.name: Colon
items.documentation: The colon character (:), used as a separator in filter expressions such as ClassName:PropertyName.

items.name: Dot
items.documentation: The dot character (.), used to navigate nested property paths in a filter expression.

items.name: LeftParenthesis
items.documentation: The opening parenthesis character ((), used to begin a grouped subexpression in a filter.

items.name: RightParenthesis
items.documentation: The closing parenthesis character ()), used to end a grouped subexpression in a filter.

items.name: Star
items.documentation: The single wildcard character (*), used to match any single name segment in a filter path.

items.name: DoubleStar
items.documentation: The double wildcard token (**), which matches any number of path segments recursively across the instance hierarchy.

items.name: ReservedSpecial
items.documentation: A character that is syntactically recognized but has no defined meaning in the current filter grammar.

enums.documentation: Enum used by Lighting.LightingStyle to indicate the artistic intent behind lighting in the experience.

items.name: Realistic
items.documentation: The most advanced and realistic lighting and shadows Roblox can deliver.

items.name: Soft
items.documentation: A flat, retro-Roblox look with softer lights and shadows.

enums.name: Limb
enums.documentation: Describes which limb a particular Instance belongs to (assuming the Instance is part of a Humanoid).

items.name: Head
items.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Head.

items.name: Torso
items.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Torso. This includes UpperTorso and LowerTorso for R15 rigs.

items.name: LeftArm
items.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Left Arm. This includes UpperLeftArm, LowerLeftArm, and LeftHand for R15 rigs.

items.name: RightArm
items.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Right Arm. This includes UpperRightArm, LowerRightArm and RightHand for R15 rigs.

items.name: LeftLeg
items.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Left Leg. This includes UpperLeftLeg, LowerLeftLeg and LeftFoot for R15 rigs.

items.name: RightLeg
items.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Right Leg. This includes UpperRightLeg, LowerRightLeg, and RightFoot for R15 rigs.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: If a part is not a limb (e.g. running the Humanoid:GetLimb() function and passing it an accessory which is a sibling of the Humanoid will return this value).

items.name: None
items.documentation: No AudioListener will be created by default, but they can be created separately by scripts.

The wire's SourceInstance will be set to t

items.name: Camera
items.documentation: All of the following, resulting in the world being heard from the perspective (postition and orientation) of the camera. - An AudioListener will be created and parented to Workspace.CurrentCamera. - An AudioDeviceOutput will be created and parented to SoundService. - A Wire will be created and parented to the previously-created AudioListener. enums.name: ListenerPositionType

items.name: Parent
items.documentation: Uses the position and orientation of the AudioListener's parent Instance.

items.name: Instance
items.documentation: Uses the position and orientation of the Instance specified by AudioListener.PositionInstance.

enums.name: ListenerType
enums.documentation: Defines where and how the listener is positioned when picking up spatial audio.

items.name: Camera
items.documentation: Uses the world CFrame of workspace.CurrentCamera.

items.name: CFrame
items.documentation: Uses a specified world CFrame.

items.name: ObjectPosition
items.documentation: Uses the world position of an instance and the rotation of workspace.CurrentCamera.

items.name: ObjectCFrame
items.documentation: Uses the world CFrame from an instance.

enums.name: LoadCharacterLayeredClothing
enums.documentation: Indicates whether characters spawning into an experience will have layered clothing accessories equipped on them.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The behavior of the default setting is not constant. It can mean Disabled or Enabled depending on what the global back-end flag settings are currently.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: This means layered clothing will not be equipped on characters in the experience.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: This means layered clothing will be equipped on characters in the experience (Although MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories also need to be enabled for the experience).

enums.name: LoadDynamicHeads
enums.documentation: Specifies whether player characters load dynamic heads.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses Roblox's default dynamic-head loading behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables loading dynamic heads.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables loading dynamic heads.

enums.name: LocationType

items.name: Character
items.documentation: Use the player's character model world position as the heatmap location (default).

items.name: Camera
items.documentation: Use the current workspace camera's world position as the player's heatmap location.

items.name: ObjectPosition
items.documentation: Use the world position of a configured target object as the player's heatmap location.

items.name: NoCheck
items.documentation: Scripts are not type-checked.

items.name: Nonstrict
items.documentation: Scripts are type-checked in nonstrict mode.

items.name: Strict
items.documentation: Scripts are type-checked in strict mode.

items.name: Lip

items.name: Eye

enums.name: MarketplaceBulkPurchasePromptStatus

items.name: Completed
items.documentation: User confirmed the purchase and the transaction has been processed.

items.name: Aborted
items.documentation: User closed the prompt.

items.name: Error
items.documentation: User confirmed the purchase, but the transaction cannot be sent to the backend for processing.

enums.name: MarketplaceItemPurchaseStatus
enums.documentation: The status of the item purchase through MarketplaceService.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The item is purchased successfully.

items.name: SystemError
items.documentation: Unable to purchase item due to Roblox system error.

items.name: AlreadyOwned
items.documentation: Unable to purchase item because user already owns the item. Users can only own one copy of non-limited item.

items.name: InsufficientRobux
items.documentation: Unable to purchase item because of insufficient Robux.

items.name: QuantityLimitExceeded
items.documentation: User has reached the max quantity allowed per user set by the creator for limited items.

items.name: QuotaExceeded
items.documentation: The user has exceeded our purchase request limit.

items.name: NotForSale
items.documentation: Item is not for sale.

items.name: NotAvailableForPurchaser
items.documentation: This item is restricted to a group of users and the purchaser is not in this group.

items.name: PriceMismatch
items.documentation: The provided price does not match the item price. Most likely the price changed since displayed to the user.

items.name: SoldOut
items.documentation: The item is sold out.

items.name: PurchaserIsSeller
items.documentation: The purchaser is the same user as the seller, for a resale purchase.

items.name: InsufficientMembership
items.documentation: The user does not have sufficient premium membership to purchase this item.

items.name: PlaceInvalid
items.documentation: The item is not allowed to be sold in the place.

items.name: AvatarBundle
items.documentation: A curated collection of avatar items sold together as a single package in the Avatar Shop.

enums.documentation: The membership type of a Player.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The player does not have an active paid membership.

items.name: BuildersClub
items.documentation: Legacy Builders Club membership. No longer available for purchase; retained for compatibility. Active paid memberships use MembershipType.Premium.

items.name: TurboBuildersClub
items.documentation: Legacy Turbo Builders Club membership. No longer available for purchase; retained for compatibility. Active paid memberships use MembershipType.Premium.

items.name: OutrageousBuildersClub
items.documentation: Legacy Outrageous Builders Club membership. No longer available for purchase; retained for compatibility. Active paid memberships use MembershipType.Premium.

items.name: Premium
items.documentation: The player has an active Premium membership.

enums.name: MeshAttribute
enums.documentation: Identifies a mesh attribute when calling the batch methods on EditableMesh.

items.name: Vertex
items.documentation: The per-element vertex position attribute, storing a Vector3 point in object space for each vertex.

items.name: Normal
items.documentation: The per-element surface normal attribute, storing a Vector3 direction used for lighting calculations.

items.name: Color
items.documentation: The per-element color attribute, storing a Color3 value and a float alpha for each color entry.

items.name: UV
items.documentation: The per-element UV attribute, storing a Vector2 texture coordinate for each UV entry.

items.name: Face
items.documentation: The face attribute channel, identifying topology elements that connect vertex positions into triangles.

enums.name: MeshPartDetailLevel
enums.documentation: The level of detail of MeshParts displayed in Studio.

items.name: DistanceBased
items.documentation: Select level of detail based on distance (default behavior as in game).

items.name: Level00
items.documentation: Forces MeshParts to render at LOD index 0, the finest detail level.

items.name: Level01
items.documentation: Highest level of detail.

items.name: Level02
items.documentation: Second highest level of detail.

items.name: Level03
items.documentation: Third highest level of detail.

items.name: Level04
items.documentation: Lowest level of detail.

items.name: Level05
items.documentation: Forces MeshParts to render at LOD index 5.

items.name: Level06
items.documentation: Forces MeshParts to render at LOD index 6.

items.name: Level07
items.documentation: Forces MeshParts to render at LOD index 7.

items.name: Level08
items.documentation: Forces MeshParts to render at LOD index 8.

items.name: Level09
items.documentation: Forces MeshParts to render at LOD index 9, the coarsest available.

enums.name: MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories
enums.documentation: Controls the Workspace.MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories feature.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default option to control the Workspace.MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories feature. This currently has the same meaning as "Enabled".

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables the Workspace.MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories feature.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables the Workspace.MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories feature.

enums.name: MeshScaleUnit
enums.documentation: Specifies the real-world unit of length that a source 3D mesh file was authored in, used by the mesh importer to scale geometry to Roblox studs.

items.name: Stud
items.documentation: Treats the source mesh as authored in Roblox studs, applying no unit conversion on import.

items.name: Meter
items.documentation: Treats the source mesh as authored in meters and scales it to Roblox studs on import.

items.name: CM
items.documentation: Treats the source mesh as authored in centimeters and scales it to Roblox studs on import.

items.name: MM
items.documentation: Treats the source mesh as authored in millimeters and scales it to Roblox studs on import.

items.name: Foot
items.documentation: Treats the source mesh as authored in feet and scales it to Roblox studs on import.

items.name: Inch
items.documentation: Treats the source mesh as authored in inches and scales it to Roblox studs on import.

enums.name: MeshType
enums.documentation: The MeshType Enum is used to set what type of mesh the SpecialMesh is.

items.name: Head
items.documentation: The mesh is the default Humanoid head mesh.

items.name: Torso
items.documentation: The mesh is the default Humanoid torso mesh.

items.name: Wedge
items.documentation: The mesh is a wedge.

items.name: Sphere
items.documentation: The mesh is a sphere.

items.name: Cylinder
items.documentation: The mesh is a cylinder.

items.name: FileMesh
items.documentation: The mesh is determined by the Roblox mesh asset ID provided.

items.name: Brick
items.documentation: The mesh is a brick (just like the shape of a default BasePart).

items.name: Prism
items.documentation: The mesh is a prism.

items.name: Pyramid
items.documentation: The mesh is a pyramid.

items.name: ParallelRamp
items.documentation: The mesh is a parallel ramp.

items.name: RightAngleRamp
items.documentation: The mesh is a right angle ramp.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.documentation: The mesh is a corner wedge.

enums.name: MessageType
enums.documentation: Message category and severity level.

items.name: MessageOutput
items.documentation: The message is from the standard output channel.

items.name: MessageInfo
items.documentation: The message is from the information channel.

items.name: MessageWarning
items.documentation: The message is from the warning channel.

items.name: MessageError
items.documentation: The message is from the error channel.

enums.name: ModelLevelOfDetail
enums.documentation: Controls the level of detail for Models in experiences with instance streaming enabled.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Default behavior, currently equivalent to Disabled.

items.name: StreamingMesh
items.documentation: A lower resolution "imposter" mesh (colored, coarse mesh that wraps around all child parts of the model) renders outside the streaming radius. Does not support textures.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: A lower resolution mesh will not be displayed.

items.name: SLIM
items.documentation: A SLIM model (Scalable Lightweight Interactive Model) renders a composite of all child parts at progressively lower resolutions at distances based on the streaming radius. Greatly improves visual quality over StreamingMesh.

enums.name: ModelStreamingBehavior
enums.documentation: Controls how Models are sent to clients in experiences with instance streaming enabled.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: Legacy
items.documentation: Models are sent when their parent is sent, typically during player join. Models are never streamed out unless an ancestor of the model is streamed out.

items.name: Improved
items.documentation: Models are never sent during player join. See model streaming controls for detailed behavioral notes.

enums.name: ModelStreamingMode
enums.documentation: Controls stream in and out behavior of a model.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: Atomic
items.documentation: The Model and all of its descendants are streamed in/out together. For streaming in, this applies when any descendant BasePart is eligible for streaming in. For streaming out, this applies when all descendant BaseParts are eligible for streaming out.

items.name: Persistent
items.documentation: Persistent models are sent as a complete atomic unit soon after the player joins and before the Workspace.PersistentLoaded event fires. Persistent models and their descendants are never streamed out.

items.name: PersistentPerPlayer
items.documentation: Behaves as a persistent model for players that have been added using Model:AddPersistentPlayer(). For other players, behavior is the same as Atomic. You can revert a model from player persistence via Model:RemovePersistentPlayer().

items.name: Nonatomic
items.documentation: When a nonatomic model is streamed, descendants are also sent, except for part descendants. Nonatomic models that are not descendants of parts are sent during experience loading.

enums.name: ModerationStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates the moderation review state of an avatar outfit or asset.

items.name: ReviewedApproved
items.documentation: The content completed moderation review and was approved for use.

items.name: ReviewedRejected
items.documentation: The content completed moderation review and was rejected.

items.name: NotReviewed
items.documentation: The content has been submitted but moderation review is still pending.

items.name: NotApplicable
items.documentation: Moderation review is not applicable to this content.

items.name: Invalid
items.documentation: An unrecognized or error moderation status returned when the server response cannot be mapped to a known value.

enums.name: ModifierKey
enums.documentation: Identifies a keyboard modifier key for use with InputObject:IsModifierKeyDown().

items.name: Shift
items.documentation: The Shift key (left or right Shift key).

items.name: Ctrl
items.documentation: The Control key (left or right Ctrl key).

items.name: Alt
items.documentation: The Alt key (left or right Alt/Option key).

items.name: Meta
items.documentation: The Meta key (the Windows key on Windows, or the Command key on macOS).

enums.name: MouseBehavior
enums.documentation: Sets the user's mouse behavior.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The mouse moves freely around the user's screen.

items.name: LockCenter
items.documentation: The mouse is locked and cannot move from the center of the user's screen.

items.name: LockCurrentPosition
items.documentation: The mouse is locked and cannot move from its current position on the user's screen at the time of locking.

enums.name: MoveState
enums.documentation: Represents the state of a SkateboardPlatform.

items.name: Stopped
items.documentation: Skateboard is stopped (not moving).

items.name: Coasting
items.documentation: Skateboard is coasting (not actively speeding up / being pushed).

items.name: Pushing
items.documentation: Skateboard is being pushed (speeding up).

items.name: Stopping
items.documentation: Skateboard is stopping, but still moving.

items.name: AirFree
items.documentation: Skateboard is in the air.

enums.name: MuteState
enums.documentation: Describes whether a voice chat participant's microphone is actively transmitting audio.

items.name: Unmuted
items.documentation: The participant's microphone is active and transmitting audio.

items.name: Muted
items.documentation: The participant's microphone is muted and not transmitting audio.

enums.name: NameOcclusion
enums.documentation: The NameOcclusion Enum is used to set the Humanoid.NameOcclusion property.

items.name: NoOcclusion
items.documentation: Do not occlude (hide) any humanoid names.

items.name: EnemyOcclusion
items.documentation: Occlude (hide) all enemy humanoid names.

items.name: OccludeAll
items.documentation: Occlude (hide) all humanoid names.

enums.name: NegateOperationHiddenHistory
enums.documentation: Records the CSG combination operation — Union or Intersection — that previously merged multiple NegateOperation parts, allowing the engine to restore the correct result type when those parts are later separated.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Indicates no previous CSG combination operation is recorded for this NegateOperation part. This is the default value of PreviousOperation.

items.name: NegatedUnion
items.documentation: Indicates this NegateOperation was previously produced by a Union operation applied to multiple negated parts.

items.name: NegatedIntersection
items.documentation: Indicates this NegateOperation was previously produced by an Intersection operation applied to multiple negated parts.

enums.name: NetworkOwnership
enums.documentation: Defines how simulation authority is determined for the Network Ownership Unit/Mechanism this part is attached to.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Network ownership is determined automatically by the server.

items.name: Manual
items.documentation: Network ownership is set manually by the developer.

items.name: OnContact
items.documentation: The first player to touch a part is given ownership of that part for the server (network). Ownership will not change if another player touches that part unless network ownership has been released by the owner.

enums.name: NetworkStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the device's current network reachability state as reported by ConnectivityService.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The network connection state has not yet been determined or is unavailable on the current platform.

items.name: Connected
items.documentation: The device has an active network connection.

items.name: Disconnected
items.documentation: The device does not currently have a network connection.

enums.name: NoiseType
enums.documentation: Specifies the noise algorithm used by a Noise instance's NoiseType property.

items.name: SimplexGabor
items.documentation: Uses an OpenSimplex2 body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice with a Gabor sinusoidal kernel for anisotropic directional noise sampling.

enums.name: NormalId
enums.documentation: The NormalId Enum sets which side/face of a Part is used.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: The right face of a Part.

items.name: Top
items.documentation: The top face of a Part.

items.name: Back
items.documentation: The back face of a Part.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: The left face of a Part.

items.name: Bottom
items.documentation: The bottom face of a Part.

items.name: Front
items.documentation: The front face of a Part.

enums.name: OrientationAlignmentMode
enums.documentation: The OrientationAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachments used in an alignment.

items.name: OneAttachment
items.documentation: Use one attachment.

items.name: TwoAttachment
items.documentation: Use two attachments.

enums.name: OutfitSource
enums.documentation: Filters which outfits are returned by AvatarEditorService:GetOutfitsAsync() based on how they were obtained.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Return all outfits regardless of whether they were created or purchased.

items.name: Created
items.documentation: Return only outfits that the user created themselves (editable outfits).

items.name: Purchased
items.documentation: Return only outfits that the user purchased (non-editable outfits).

enums.name: OutfitType
enums.documentation: Categorizes a saved player outfit by its content type, used to filter or specify outfit type in AvatarEditorService methods.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Returns outfits of every type, with no filtering applied.

items.name: Avatar
items.documentation: A full-body avatar outfit.

items.name: DynamicHead
items.documentation: An outfit containing a dynamic head.

items.name: Shoes
items.documentation: An outfit consisting of a pair of shoes.

items.name: Makeup
items.documentation: An outfit consisting of makeup items applied to the avatar's face.

enums.name: OutputLayoutMode
enums.documentation: Specifies the orientation of the Output panel in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Horizontal
items.documentation: Docks the Output panel horizontally along the top or bottom edge of the Studio window.

items.name: Vertical
items.documentation: Docks the Output panel vertically along the left or right edge of the Studio window.

enums.name: OverrideMouseIconBehavior
enums.documentation: Overrides the behavior of the mouse icon to either force that it is always shown or force that it is always hidden.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The mouse icon behavior is not overridden - default behavior is used.

items.name: ForceShow
items.documentation: The mouse icon is forced to always remain shown/visible.

items.name: ForceHide
items.documentation: The mouse icon is forced to always remain hidden/invisible.

enums.name: PackagePermission
enums.documentation: Indicates the current user's or group roleset's permission to the package.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Permission data is not available for the current user or group roleset.

items.name: NoAccess
items.documentation: The current user or group roleset doesn't have access.

items.name: Revoked
items.documentation: The current user's or group roleset's permission is revoked.

items.name: UseView
items.documentation: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from Roblox.

items.name: Edit
items.documentation: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from Roblox and publish package changes to Roblox.

items.name: Own
items.documentation: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the page from Roblox, publish package changes to Roblox, and manage who has access to the package.

enums.name: ParticleEmitterShape
enums.documentation: Specifies the geometric shape from which a particle emitter emits particles.

items.name: Box
items.documentation: Emits particles from a box-shaped region.

items.name: Sphere
items.documentation: Emits particles from a sphere-shaped region.

items.name: Cylinder
items.documentation: Emits particles from a cylinder-shaped region.

items.name: Disc
items.documentation: Emits particles from a disc-shaped region.

enums.name: ParticleEmitterShapeInOut
enums.documentation: Controls the direction particles travel when emitted from a shaped ParticleEmitter.

items.name: Outward
items.documentation: Particles emit directed outward away from the emitter shape surface.

items.name: Inward
items.documentation: Particles emit directed inward toward the center of the emitter shape.

items.name: InAndOut
items.documentation: Particles emit in both outward and inward directions from the emitter shape surface, chosen randomly per particle.

enums.name: ParticleEmitterShapeStyle
enums.documentation: Controls whether a ParticleEmitter emits particles from the surface or the volume of its shape.

items.name: Volume
items.documentation: Particles emit from throughout the interior volume of the emitter shape.

items.name: Surface
items.documentation: Particles emit only from the outer surface of the emitter shape.

enums.name: ParticleFlipbookLayout
enums.documentation: Determines the layout of the flipbook texture.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Disable flipbook features and use the texture as a single static texture over the particle's lifetime.

items.name: Grid2x2
items.documentation: 2×2 frames for a 4-frame animation.

items.name: Grid4x4
items.documentation: 4×4 frames for a 16-frame animation.

items.name: Grid8x8
items.documentation: 8×8 frames for a 64-frame animation.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: A custom grid size defined by FlipbookSizeX and FlipbookSizeY.

enums.name: ParticleFlipbookMode
enums.documentation: Determines the type of the flipbook animation.

items.name: Loop
items.documentation: Continuously play through all frames, starting back at the first frame after playing the last.

items.name: OneShot
items.documentation: Play through the animation only once across the particle's lifetime. With this setting, the ParticleEmitter.FlipbookFramerate property doesn't apply; instead, the framerate is determined by the particle's ParticleEmitter.Lifetime divided evenly by the number of frames in the animation. OneShot animations are useful for clear non-repeating animations, such as an explosion that creates a puff of smoke and then fades out.

items.name: PingPong
items.documentation: Play from the first to the last frame, then in reverse from the last to the first, repeating throughout the ParticleEmitter.Lifetime of the particle.

items.name: Random
items.documentation: Play the frames in a random order, blending/crossfading from one frame to the next. This can be useful for organic particle textures at low framerates, such as stars slowly twinkling between subtly different shapes.

enums.name: ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible
enums.documentation: Indicates whether a ParticleEmitter's flipbook texture dimensions are compatible with the selected flipbook layout.

items.name: NotCompatible
items.documentation: The ParticleEmitter's flipbook texture dimensions are incompatible with the active flipbook layout (the texture must be 1024×1024); flipbook playback is suppressed.

items.name: Compatible
items.documentation: The ParticleEmitter's flipbook texture dimensions are confirmed compatible with the active flipbook layout; flipbook playback proceeds normally.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Compatibility has not yet been determined; this is the initial state before the engine resolves the flipbook texture dimensions.

enums.name: ParticleOrientation
enums.documentation: Specifies how a particle's rendered geometry is oriented.

items.name: FacingCamera
items.documentation: Orients particles as billboards that face the camera.

items.name: FacingCameraWorldUp
items.documentation: Orients particles toward the camera while keeping them upright on the world Y axis.

items.name: VelocityParallel
items.documentation: Orients particles parallel to their direction of movement.

items.name: VelocityPerpendicular
items.documentation: Orients particles perpendicular to their direction of movement.

enums.name: PartType

items.name: Block
items.documentation: A block shape.

items.name: Ball
items.documentation: A spherical shape.

items.name: Cylinder
items.documentation: A cylinder shape oriented along the X axis.

items.name: Wedge
items.documentation: A wedge shape with a slope on one side.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.documentation: A wedge shape with slopes on two sides.

enums.documentation: Controls the Part.Shape of an object.

enums.name: PathfindingUseImprovedSearch
enums.documentation: Controls whether PathfindingService uses an improved search algorithm.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default pathfinding behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Uses the legacy pathfinding search algorithm.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Uses the improved pathfinding search algorithm.

enums.name: PathStatus
enums.documentation: The success of a Path generated by PathfindingService.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: Path found successfully.

items.name: ClosestNoPath
items.documentation: Path doesn't exist, returns path to closest point.

items.name: ClosestOutOfRange
items.documentation: Goal is out of MaxDistance range, returns path to closest point you can reach within MaxDistance.

items.name: FailStartNotEmpty
items.documentation: Failed to compute path; the starting point is not empty.

items.name: FailFinishNotEmpty
items.documentation: Failed to compute path; the finish point is not empty.

items.name: NoPath
items.documentation: Path doesn't exist.

enums.name: PathWaypointAction
enums.documentation: Describes the action to take when a PathWaypoint is reached.

items.name: Walk
items.documentation: Walk action needed to reach the next waypoint.

items.name: Jump
items.documentation: Jump action needed to reach the next waypoint.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: A developer-defined custom action is needed to traverse a PathfindingLink to reach the next waypoint.

enums.name: PermissionLevelShown
enums.documentation: Used to set the highest permission level that APIs have to have in order to be shown in the Object Browser.

items.name: Game
items.documentation: Member must have no security permissions in order to be shown.

items.name: RobloxGame
items.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to RobloxPlaceSecurity to be shown.

items.name: RobloxScript
items.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to RobloxScriptSecurity to be shown.

items.name: Studio
items.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to LocalUserSecurity to be shown.

items.name: Roblox
items.documentation: Member is shown no matter what security it has.

enums.name: PhysicalConstraintType
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of physical joint created when importing a rigged asset.

items.name: AnimationConstraint
items.documentation: Import creates AnimationConstraint instances to connect the rig's bone joints.

items.name: Motor6D
items.documentation: Import creates Motor6D instances to connect the rig's bone joints.

enums.name: PhysicsSteppingMethod
enums.documentation: Controls how the physics engine advances simulation time for assemblies in a Workspace.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The current default is Adaptive.

items.name: Fixed
items.documentation: All simulated assemblies inside the workspace will advance forward at 240 Hz. This option is best for optimal stability and simulation accuracy.

items.name: Adaptive
items.documentation: The engine attempts to assign optimal simulation rates for individual assemblies of either 240 Hz, 120 Hz, or 60 Hz. This setting is optimized for performance.

enums.documentation: Host operating system of the client.

items.documentation: The client is running on an XBox 360 (console).

items.name: NX

items.name: Ouya
items.documentation: The client is running on an Ouya Operating System (Android-Based).

items.name: AndroidTV
items.documentation: The client is running on an Android TV.

items.name: Chromecast
items.documentation: The client is running on Chromecast.

items.name: Linux
items.documentation: The client is running on a Linux Operating System (desktop).

items.name: SteamOS

items.name: WebOS
items.documentation: The client is running on WebOS.

items.documentation: The client is running on DOS.
