enums.name: PlaybackState
enums.documentation: Describes the current state of a Tween in its Tween.PlaybackState property.

items.name: Begin
items.documentation: The tween has been created, but has yet to be played. After exiting this state, the tween never enters it again.

items.name: Delayed
items.documentation: The tween is waiting for the duration specified in its TweenInfo.DelayTime. After the delay elapses, the tween plays.

items.name: Playing
items.documentation: The tween is currently in progress.

items.name: Paused
items.documentation: The tween is paused in the middle of playing.

items.name: Completed
items.documentation: The tween completed successfully.

items.name: Cancelled
items.documentation: The tween was cancelled before completion.

enums.name: PlayerActions
enums.documentation: References a movement action taken by a player.

items.name: CharacterForward
items.documentation: The player moved forward.

items.name: CharacterBackward
items.documentation: The player moved backward.

items.name: CharacterLeft
items.documentation: The player moved left.

items.name: CharacterRight
items.documentation: The player moved right.

items.name: CharacterJump
items.documentation: The player jumped.

enums.name: PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior
enums.documentation: Controls destruction behavior when a player character is removed.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Automatic Destroy() calls on character replacement and player removal are disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: The engine automatically calls Destroy() on old characters when they are replaced (for example, on respawn) and on Player objects when players leave.

enums.name: PlayerChatType
enums.documentation: Determines the style of a chat message.

items.name: All
items.documentation: A global message that everyone can receive.

items.name: Team
items.documentation: A team message only players in the same team can receive.

items.name: Whisper
items.documentation: A whispered message only the person it's whispered to can receive.

enums.name: PlayerDeviceTrustDecision
enums.documentation: The decision that IntegrityService.EvaluatePlayerDeviceTrust returns for a player.

items.name: Accept
items.documentation: The player stays in the server.

items.name: Reject
items.documentation: The player is disconnected from the server and sees a rejection message.

enums.name: PlayerDeviceTrustLevel
enums.documentation: The trust level of a player's device.

items.name: Pending
items.documentation: Roblox is still checking the device. Every player starts at this level, and some players might stay at it for the whole session.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Roblox can't tell whether the device is trusted, because the player is on an unsupported platform or an error occurred on the Roblox side. The device might or might not be trustworthy.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The device failed the check, or the player is on a platform that can't be verified.

items.name: Standard
items.documentation: The device passed some of the checks, but not all of them.

items.name: Full
items.documentation: The device passed every check.

enums.name: PlayerExitReason
enums.documentation: An enum that specifies the reason for Players.PlayerRemoving signal.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Catch-all for all other disconnect reasons.

items.name: PlatformKick
items.documentation: User was kicked by Roblox systems, such as being blocked while in a Private Server.

items.name: CreatorKick
items.documentation: Creator called Player:Kick()

enums.name: PlayerPlatformActivationStatus
enums.documentation: Describes whether a player is new, active, lapsed, or reactivated on Roblox.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: New
items.documentation: The player signed up for Roblox within the last 60 days.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: The player played on Roblox in the last 60 days and is not New or Reactivated.

items.name: Lapsed
items.documentation: The player has not played on Roblox in the last 60 days.

items.name: Reactivated
items.documentation: The player returned to Roblox within the last 60 days after being Lapsed.

enums.name: PlayerPlatformSpenderStatus
enums.documentation: Describes a player's platform-wide spender status bucket.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: The player is an active platform spender.

items.name: OtherPayer
items.documentation: The player is not an active platform spender, including players who have never spent.

enums.name: PluginConnectionTargetType
enums.documentation: Describes the data model type that the remote end of a PluginConnection runs in.

items.name: Edit
items.documentation: The target data model is an edit-session data model which spawned this test data model.

items.name: Test
items.documentation: The target data model is a test (simulation/playtest) data model spawned from this edit data model.

enums.name: PoseEasingDirection
enums.documentation: Used exclusively by Pose.EasingDirection to specify direction of the EasingStyle curve.

items.name: In
items.documentation: The EasingStyle curve is reversed, with the easing becoming linear as it approaches the next keyframe.

items.name: Out
items.documentation: EasingStyle curves are applied in the forward direction, from the current keyframe to the next.

items.name: InOut
items.documentation: Two easing curves are applied back-to-back with the linear ends of the curves meeting in the middle.

enums.name: PoseEasingStyle
enums.documentation: Specifies the interpolation curve used when blending between keyframe Poses in a KeyframeSequence.

items.name: Linear
items.documentation: Poses interpolate linearly between keyframes.

items.name: Constant
items.documentation: Poses do not interpolate but snap to the keyframe indicated by the PoseEasingDirection.

items.name: Elastic
items.documentation: Pose interpolation overshoots like an elastic curve.

items.name: Cubic
items.documentation: Deprecated - Use PoseEasingStyle.CubicV2. Pose interpolation is a cubic curve between keyframes based on the PoseEasingDirection.

items.name: Bounce
items.documentation: Pose interpolation produces a bounce-like effect between keyframes.

items.name: CubicV2
items.documentation: Pose interpolation is a cubic curve between keyframes based on PoseEasingDirection.

enums.name: PositionAlignmentMode
enums.documentation: The PositionAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachments used in an alignment.

items.name: OneAttachment
items.documentation: Use one attachment.

items.name: TwoAttachment
items.documentation: Use two attachments.

enums.name: PredictionMode
enums.documentation: Enum used with RunService:SetPredictionMode() to define the prediction mode for the instance.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: The engine will automatically decide if this instance should be predicted or not. Currently, only BaseParts near the local player character's Humanoid will be predicted within a dynamic radius that grows and shrinks based on the device's capability to handle the simulation load.

items.name: On
items.documentation: The instance will be predicted. Mismatches in the attributes of this instance between the client and server will cause a rollback and resimulation. If the instance is a BasePart, its physics properties will be predicted ahead of the replicated authoritative server state.

items.name: Off
items.documentation: The instance will not be predicted. Regular network ownership semantics apply.

enums.name: PredictionStatus
enums.documentation: Enum used with RunService:GetPredictionStatus() to check the status of a specific instance.

items.name: Authoritative
items.documentation: This instance is authoritative.

items.name: Predicted
items.documentation: This instance is being predicted.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The instance will not be resimulated; classic simulation rules apply instead.

enums.name: PredictiveStreamingMode
enums.documentation: Used with Workspace.PredictiveStreamingMode to control whether the engine streams instances predictively.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine's current default behavior for predictive streaming.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Enables predictive streaming, pre-fetching content in the direction of player movement to reduce pop-in.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables predictive streaming; content is streamed based on the player's current position radius only.

enums.name: PreferredInput
enums.documentation: This enum is used with UserInputService.PreferredInput to indicate the primary input type a player is likely using.

items.name: KeyboardAndMouse
items.documentation: The player has connected or most recently interacted with a keyboard or mouse.

items.name: Gamepad
items.documentation: The player has connected or most recently interacted with a gamepad.

items.name: Touch
items.documentation: The player's device has touch capability and no other input method is available or was recently interacted with.

items.name: MicroGamepad
items.documentation: The player has connected or most recently interacted with a gamepad without a thumbstick (for example, a TV remote or another limited-input gamepad), and no standard gamepad is currently connected.

enums.name: PreferredTextSize
enums.documentation: This enum is used with GuiService.PreferredTextSize to indicate the player's preferred text size.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: The player prefers default text size.

items.name: Large
items.documentation: The player prefers text size slightly increased beyond default.

items.name: Larger
items.documentation: The player prefers text size moderately increased beyond default.

items.name: Largest
items.documentation: The player prefers text size considerably increased beyond default.

enums.name: PrimalPhysicsSolver
enums.documentation: Controls whether the experimental Primal Physics Solver is enabled.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default physics solver state.

items.name: Experimental
items.documentation: The experimental Primal Physics Solver is enabled.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: The Primal Physics Solver is disabled.

enums.name: PrimitiveType
enums.documentation: Identifies the base primitive shape of a BasePart node within a CSG operation graph.

items.name: Null
items.documentation: Sentinel value indicating no valid primitive shape; used for uninitialized or invalid nodes in a CSG operation graph.

items.name: Ball
items.documentation: A spherical primitive shape, corresponding to the ball/sphere geometry of a Part.

items.name: Cylinder
items.documentation: A cylindrical primitive shape, corresponding to the cylinder geometry of a Part.

items.name: Block
items.documentation: A box primitive shape, corresponding to the standard rectangular block geometry of a Part; the default primitive type for new Part nodes in a CSG operation graph.

items.name: Wedge
items.documentation: A wedge primitive shape, corresponding to the geometry of a WedgePart.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.documentation: A corner wedge primitive shape, corresponding to the geometry of a CornerWedgePart.

enums.name: ProductLocationRestriction
enums.documentation: Specifies the purchase locations permitted for an avatar item.

items.name: AvatarShop
items.documentation: Item is purchasable only in the Marketplace.

items.name: AllowedGames
items.documentation: Item is purchasable in the Marketplace and experiences owned by the item creator.

items.name: AllGames
items.documentation: (Default) Item is purchasable in the Marketplace and all experiences.

enums.name: ProductPurchaseChannel
enums.documentation: Enum which works with MarketplaceService to represent how the user acquired the developer product.

items.name: InExperience
items.documentation: The purchase was made inside of an experience.

items.name: ExperienceDetailsPage
items.documentation: The purchase was made outside of an experience, on the Store tab of the experience details page.

items.name: AdReward
items.documentation: The product was rewarded to the user when they watched a video ad to completion.

items.name: CommerceProduct
items.documentation: The user acquired the product as a benefit of purchasing commerce merchandise from the developer of the experience.

enums.name: ProductPurchaseDecision
enums.documentation: The ProductPurchaseDecisionEnum works with MarketplaceService to indicate the status of the sale of developer products.

items.name: NotProcessedYet
items.documentation: The purchase request has been sent but not yet processed.

items.name: PurchaseGranted
items.documentation: The purchase has been processed and granted to the user who initiated the purchase request.

enums.name: PromptCreateAssetResult
enums.documentation: Describes the result of a AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAssetAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The asset was successfully created and published.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.documentation: The player explicitly declined the asset-creation consent prompt.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: The creation attempt timed out because the player disconnected or left the experience.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.documentation: The asset upload to the Roblox backend failed after validation.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.documentation: The player did not interact with the creation prompt before it expired.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.documentation: The asset creation failed for an unspecified or unexpected reason.

items.name: UGCValidationFailed
items.documentation: The asset failed user-generated content validation checks before upload.

items.name: ModeratedName
items.documentation: The asset name or description was rejected by Roblox moderation.

items.name: PurchaseFailure
items.documentation: The asset could not be created because the player had insufficient Robux.

items.name: TokenInvalid
items.documentation: The creation token provided to the prompt was invalid or could not be verified.

enums.name: PromptCreateAvatarResult
enums.documentation: Result codes returned by AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAsync() indicating whether avatar creation succeeded or why it failed.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The avatar was successfully created and published to the player's account.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.documentation: The player explicitly declined the avatar creation consent prompt.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: The avatar creation consent prompt timed out before the player responded.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.documentation: The avatar assets passed validation but the server-side upload or bundle creation step failed.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.documentation: The player did not interact with the avatar creation consent prompt before it closed.

items.name: InvalidHumanoidDescription
items.documentation: The HumanoidDescription supplied to AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAsync() was invalid and could not be used to create an avatar.

items.name: UGCValidationFailed
items.documentation: The avatar's geometry or content failed Roblox's UGC (User-Generated Content) validation checks.

items.name: ModeratedName
items.documentation: The proposed avatar name or description was rejected by Roblox moderation.

items.name: MaxOutfits
items.documentation: The player has reached the maximum number of outfits allowed on their Roblox account.

items.name: PurchaseFailure
items.documentation: The avatar creation attempt failed because the player did not have sufficient Robux to cover the required purchase.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.documentation: An unexpected or unclassified failure occurred during avatar creation.

items.name: TokenInvalid
items.documentation: The creation token provided to AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAsync() was not valid or did not match the current experience.

enums.name: PromptCreateOutfitResult
enums.documentation: Result codes returned by AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateMakeupAsync() that describe the overall makeup look creation outcome.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: All submitted makeup assets and the makeup look were created successfully.

items.name: PartialSuccess
items.documentation: At least one makeup asset was created, but one or more assets or the final makeup look composition did not succeed.

items.name: CreationFailure
items.documentation: No makeup assets could be created, so the makeup look was not created.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.documentation: The player declined the makeup creation prompt.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: The makeup creation prompt timed out before the player responded.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.documentation: The player did not respond to the makeup creation prompt.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.documentation: An unexpected or unclassified error prevented makeup look creation.

items.name: UGCValidationFailed
items.documentation: The makeup assets or creation tokens failed validation before upload.

enums.name: PromptExperienceDetailsResult
enums.documentation: Indicates how the player dismissed the experience details prompt shown by TeleportService:PromptExperienceDetailsAsync().

items.name: PromptClosed
items.documentation: The player dismissed the experience details prompt without choosing to teleport (value 0).

items.name: TeleportAttempted
items.documentation: The player clicked the Join button in the experience details prompt, initiating a teleport to the advertised experience (value 1).

enums.name: PromptPublishAssetResult
enums.documentation: Deprecated result enum for the OpenPublishResultModal event.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The asset was published successfully.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.documentation: The user explicitly denied the consent prompt required to publish the asset.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: The publish flow timed out, typically because the user disconnected or left the experience during the consent prompt.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.documentation: The asset upload to the Roblox backend failed after consent was granted.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.documentation: The user did not grant or deny the consent prompt before the window expired.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.documentation: The publish failed for an unspecified or unexpected reason.

enums.name: PropertyStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates the validation state of a property as displayed in Roblox Studio's Properties panel.

items.name: Ok
items.documentation: The property value is valid; no status indicator is shown in Studio.

items.name: Warning
items.documentation: The property value has a recoverable issue; Studio displays a warning indicator on the instance.

items.name: Error
items.documentation: The property value is invalid and cannot be resolved; Studio displays an error indicator on the instance.

enums.name: ProximityPromptExclusivity
enums.documentation: Controls how a ProximityPrompt competes with other prompts for screen visibility.

items.name: OnePerButton
items.documentation: One prompt will be shown per input KeyCode.

items.name: OneGlobally
items.documentation: Only one prompt will be shown with this setting.

items.name: AlwaysShow
items.documentation: This prompt will always show when in range and visible.

enums.name: ProximityPromptInputType
enums.documentation: Identifies the input method a player is using when a ProximityPrompt is shown.

items.name: Keyboard
items.documentation: The player is using keyboard and mouse input.

items.name: Gamepad
items.documentation: The player is using a gamepad controller.

items.name: Touch
items.documentation: The player is using a touch screen.

enums.name: ProximityPromptStyle
enums.documentation: Specifies the visual style of a ProximityPrompt.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Built-in Roblox CoreScript prompt UI.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Suppresses the built-in prompt UI so you can render a custom prompt (see ProximityPrompt.Style).

enums.name: PurchaseOption
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of purchase option in a bulk purchase prompt.

items.name: TimedOption
items.documentation: A timed ownership option. The Value field specifies the duration in seconds.

items.name: Permanent
items.documentation: A permanent ownership purchase option.

enums.name: QualityLevel
enums.documentation: Controls the rendering quality of the game.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: The quality level of graphics is determined automatically depending on the client's setting for either game performance or graphic quality.

items.name: Level01
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 1 - the lowest quality level.

items.name: Level02
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 2.

items.name: Level03
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 3.

items.name: Level04
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 4.

items.name: Level05
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 5.

items.name: Level06
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 6.

items.name: Level07
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 7.

items.name: Level08
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 8.

items.name: Level09
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 9.

items.name: Level10
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 10.

items.name: Level11
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 11.

items.name: Level12
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 12.

items.name: Level13
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 13.

items.name: Level14
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 14.

items.name: Level15
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 15.

items.name: Level16
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 16.

items.name: Level17
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 17.

items.name: Level18
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 18.

items.name: Level19
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 19.

items.name: Level20
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 20.

items.name: Level21
items.documentation: Graphic quality level 21, the highest quality level.

enums.name: R15CollisionType
enums.documentation: Collision behavior type for a R15 character.

items.name: OuterBox
items.documentation: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

items.name: InnerBox
items.documentation: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

enums.name: RaycastFilterType
enums.documentation: Used in a RaycastParams object to determine how its FilterDescendantsInstances list will be used.

items.name: Exclude
items.documentation: Every BasePart in the raycast operation will be considered except those that are descendants of objects in the filter list.

items.name: Include
items.documentation: Only BaseParts which are descendants of objects in the filter list will be considered in the raycast operation.

enums.name: ReadCapturesFromGalleryResult
enums.documentation: Describes the outcome of a CaptureService:ReadCapturesFromGalleryAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The read operation completed successfully and capture data has been returned.

items.name: NeedPermission
items.documentation: The read operation failed because the experience has not been granted permission to access the user's capture gallery.

enums.name: ReceiptDecision
enums.documentation: ReceiptDecision works with MarketplaceService to indicate the acknowledgement of receipts.

items.name: NotProcessedYet
items.documentation: The receipt has not been processed yet. Returning this value keeps the receipt unresolved so it will be redelivered to the user's handler later, either during their existing session or the next time they join a server if they have disconnected.

items.name: Processed
items.documentation: The receipt has been processed and all benefits have been granted. The receipt is marked as complete and will not be delivered again.

enums.name: ReceiptType
enums.documentation: ReceiptType is used to work with server-sided receipt processing.

items.name: DeveloperProduct
items.documentation: Used for processing receipts from developer product purchases made with PromptProductPurchase. The receipt includes ProductId, CurrencyType, and CurrencySpent fields. A handler bound for this type processes developer product receipts in place of the legacy ProcessReceipt callback; receipts with no matching bound handler fall through to ProcessReceipt.

items.name: RobuxTransferSender
items.documentation: Used for processing receipts for the user who initiated a Robux transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the sender's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field. Delivered immediately if the transfer settles synchronously. If receiver approval is required, delivered to the server the sender is currently in once the receiver accepts, or on the sender's next session join if they are offline.

items.name: RobuxTransferReceiver
items.documentation: Used for processing receipts for the user who received Robux via a transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the receiver's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field. Delivered to the server the receiver is currently in once the transfer settles, or on their next session join if they are offline.

enums.name: RecommendationActionType
enums.documentation: Describes the type of action a user took on a recommended item, used when logging action events via RecommendationService:LogActionEvent().

items.name: AddReaction
items.documentation: The user added a reaction to the item, such as a "like".

items.name: RemoveReaction
items.documentation: The user removed a reaction from the item.

items.name: Share
items.documentation: The user shared the item.

items.name: Report
items.documentation: The user created an abuse report of the item.

items.name: Comment
items.documentation: The user commented on the item.

items.name: Play
items.documentation: The user joined an experience through the item, or played a mini-game associated with the item.

items.name: Purchase
items.documentation: The user made a purchase from the item.

enums.name: RecommendationImpressionType
enums.documentation: Specifies the outcome of rendering a recommended item, passed to RecommendationService:LogImpressionEvent() to indicate whether the item was shown to the user.

items.name: View
items.documentation: A complete view of the item.

items.name: NotViewable
items.documentation: The item has failed to render.

enums.name: RecommendationItemContentType
enums.documentation: Describes the content type of an item registered with RecommendationService.

items.name: Static
items.documentation: The item is static, such as an image.

items.name: Dynamic
items.documentation: The item is dynamic; for example, it is a video.

items.name: Interactive
items.documentation: The item is interactive, such as a 3D model or a mini-game.

enums.name: RecommendationItemVisibility
enums.documentation: Controls whether a registered recommendation item is publicly discoverable or restricted to private access.

items.name: Private
items.documentation: The recommendation item is not surfaced to other players by the recommendation system.

items.name: Public
items.documentation: The recommendation item is discoverable and may be surfaced to other players by the recommendation system.

enums.name: RecommendationPreferenceTargetType
enums.documentation: Identifies the kind of entity that a preference signal targets when logged via LogPreferenceEvent().

items.name: User
items.documentation: The target is another Roblox user. The targetId is the user key.

items.name: Universe
items.documentation: The target is a universe. The targetId is the universe ID as a string.

items.name: CustomTag
items.documentation: The target is a custom content tag. The targetId is the tag string.

enums.name: RecommendationPreferenceType
enums.documentation: Identifies the type of preference action (follow, unfollow, mute, or unmute) passed to LogPreferenceEvent().

items.name: AddFollow
items.documentation: The user started following the target.

items.name: RemoveFollow
items.documentation: The user stopped following the target.

items.name: AddMute
items.documentation: The user muted the target.

items.name: RemoveMute
items.documentation: The user unmuted a previously muted target.

enums.name: RejectCharacterDeletions
enums.documentation: Controls whether the server rejects client attempts to delete player characters.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default behavior (currently equivalent to Enabled).

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: The server does not reject character deletion requests from clients.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: The server rejects client attempts to delete player characters.

enums.name: RenderFidelity
enums.documentation: Determines the level of detail that solid modeled and mesh parts will be shown in.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Object's level of detail is dynamically controlled by its distance from the camera (see table above).

items.name: Precise
items.documentation: Object is rendered in the highest fidelity regardless of its distance from the camera.

items.name: Performance
items.documentation: Push performance as much as possible, trying to maintain quality if possible, and discarding appearance if that's necessary to reach performance. This means that the performance will always be excellent, but mesh visuals may be affected negatively.

enums.name: RenderingCacheOptimizationMode
enums.documentation: Controls rendering cache optimization behavior.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default rendering cache state.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Rendering cache optimizations are disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Rendering cache optimizations are enabled.

enums.name: RenderPriority
enums.documentation: A list of standard reserved values in BindToRenderStep.

items.name: First
items.documentation: The lowest reserved priority level; callbacks run before all other standard priorities.

items.name: Input
items.documentation: Runs after First; intended for input-processing callbacks.

items.name: Camera
items.documentation: Runs after Input; intended for camera-update callbacks.

items.name: Character
items.documentation: Runs after Camera; intended for character-response callbacks.

items.name: Last
items.documentation: The highest reserved priority level; callbacks run after all other standard priorities.

enums.name: ReplicateInstanceDestroySetting
enums.documentation: Controls how Instance:Destroy() calls are replicated from server to clients.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default instance destroy replication behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Uses legacy instance destroy replication behavior.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Uses improved instance destroy replication behavior.

enums.name: ResamplerMode
enums.documentation: Determines the image filtering used.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Bilinear filtering of the four near pixels in the image.

items.name: Pixelated
items.documentation: Nearest neighbor filtering of the closest pixel in the image.

enums.name: ReservedHighlightId
enums.documentation: Identifies the built-in reserved role assigned to a Highlight via its ReservedId property.

items.name: Standard
items.documentation: Marks a Highlight as a standard, non-reserved instance not tied to any built-in system state.

items.name: Active
items.documentation: Marks a Highlight as the last-selected object in Studio.

items.name: Hover
items.documentation: Marks a Highlight as the hover-state indicator, applied to an object currently under the mouse cursor.

items.name: Selection
items.documentation: Marks a Highlight as the selection-state indicator, applied to a selected object in Studio.

items.name: NegatedPart
items.documentation: Marks a Highlight used for CSG negated-part visualization in Roblox Studio.

enums.name: RestPose
enums.documentation: Determines how the initial joint rest pose is established when importing a rigged 3D model.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the first animation clip found in the source file to define the initial joint rest pose on import.

items.name: RotationsReset
items.documentation: Resets all joint rotations to zero so that the imported rig starts from an identity rest pose.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Uses a specific animation clip, identified by its index in the file, to set the initial joint rest pose on import.

enums.name: ReverbType
enums.documentation: The ReverbType Enum allows you to make audio in your game sound different, depending on what \"area\" the sounds are in.

items.name: NoReverb
items.documentation: No sound reverb. Audio is not changed from default.

items.name: GenericReverb
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to a generic reverb effect.

items.name: PaddedCell
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a padded cell.

items.name: Room
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a room.

items.name: Bathroom
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a bathroom.

items.name: LivingRoom
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a living room.

items.name: StoneRoom
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone room.

items.name: Auditorium
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an auditorium.

items.name: ConcertHall
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a concert hall.

items.name: Cave
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a cave.

items.name: Arena
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an arena.

items.name: Hangar
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hangar.

items.name: CarpettedHallway
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a carpeted hallway.

items.name: Hallway
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hallway.

items.name: StoneCorridor
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone corridor.

items.name: Alley
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an alley.

items.name: Forest
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a forest.

items.name: City
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a city.

items.name: Mountains
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in the mountains.

items.name: Quarry
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a quarry.

items.name: Plain
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is an open plain.

items.name: ParkingLot
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a parking lot.

items.name: SewerPipe
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a sewer pipe.

items.name: UnderWater
items.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is underwater.

enums.name: RibbonTool
enums.documentation: Identifies a Studio ribbon toolbar tool, used with Plugin:GetSelectedRibbonTool() and Plugin:SelectRibbonTool().

items.name: Select
items.documentation: The Select tool, which selects objects in the viewport.

items.name: Scale
items.documentation: The Scale tool, which resizes selected parts along their axes.

items.name: Rotate
items.documentation: The Rotate tool, which rotates selected parts around the three primary axes.

items.name: Move
items.documentation: The Move tool, which translates selected parts along the three primary axes.

items.name: Transform
items.documentation: The Transform tool, which provides combined move, scale, and rotate handles in a single gizmo.

items.name: ColorPicker
items.documentation: The Color tool, which opens the color picker to paint the color of selected parts.

items.name: MaterialPicker
items.documentation: Deprecated ribbon Color/Material picker tool; use Material Manager instead.

items.name: Group
items.documentation: The Group tool, which groups the selected objects into a Model.

items.name: Ungroup
items.documentation: The Ungroup tool, which dissolves a selected Model and promotes its children to the parent container.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Represents no ribbon tool being active.

items.name: PivotEditor
items.documentation: The Edit Pivot tool, which repositions the pivot point of selected parts or models.

enums.name: RollOffMode
enums.documentation: How Sounds parented to a BasePart or Attachment attenuate (fade out) as the distance between the listener and the parent increases.

items.name: Inverse
items.documentation: Volume attenuates from Sound.RollOffMinDistance in an inverse manner, mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world. This is done through Sound.RollOffMinDistance/distance, where distance is the Vector3.Magnitude between the audio source and the audio listener.

items.name: Linear
items.documentation: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear relationship. This is done through (Sound.RollOffMaxDistance/distance)/(Sound.RollOffMaxDistance-Sound.RollOffMinDistance), where distance is the Vector3.Magnitude between the audio source and the audio listener.

items.name: LinearSquare
items.documentation: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear squared relationship. This is done through squaring Linear.

items.name: InverseTapered
items.documentation: A hybrid model which follows the Inverse model when close to Sound.RollOffMinDistance and the LinearSquare model when close to Sound.RollOffMaxDistance. This is done by taking the lesser of Inverse and LinearSquare.

enums.name: RolloutState
enums.documentation: A three-phase rollout state used to opt in or out of engine features.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-wide rollout default, which changes as the feature progresses through its rollout phases.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Opts out of the feature regardless of the engine-wide rollout phase.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Opts in to the feature regardless of the engine-wide rollout phase.

enums.name: RotationOrder
enums.documentation: The order of rotation axes used for Euler angles encoding of rotations.

items.name: XYZ
items.documentation: X, Y, Z order.

items.name: XZY
items.documentation: X, Z, Y order.

items.name: YZX
items.documentation: Y, Z, X order.

items.name: YXZ
items.documentation: Y, X, Z order.

items.name: ZXY
items.documentation: Z, X, Y order.

items.name: ZYX
items.documentation: Z, Y, X order.

enums.name: RotationType
enums.documentation: Controls how a player character's body rotation is determined — relative to the camera direction or relative to the movement direction.

items.name: MovementRelative
items.documentation: The character's body rotation follows the direction of movement.

items.name: CameraRelative
items.documentation: The character's body rotation continuously follows the camera's look direction.

enums.name: RsvpStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates a player's RSVP response to a Roblox experience event.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The player has not yet responded to the event invitation; this is the default RSVP state.

items.name: Going
items.documentation: The player has accepted the event invitation and confirmed they are going.

items.name: NotGoing
items.documentation: The player has declined the event invitation and indicated they are not going.

enums.name: RtlTextSupport
enums.documentation: Controls whether right-to-left text rendering is enabled for the experience.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Enables RTL text support using the engine's default behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Disables RTL text support, forcing all text to render left-to-right.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Explicitly enables RTL text support for right-to-left scripts such as Arabic and Hebrew.

enums.name: RunContext
enums.documentation: Controls the execution context of a Script, determining whether it runs as server, client, plugin, or legacy container-based code.

items.name: Legacy
items.documentation: Runs with legacy container-based behavior that depends on the script type, such as LocalScript or Script.

items.name: Server
items.documentation: Runs on the server.

items.name: Client
items.documentation: Runs on the client.

items.name: Plugin
items.documentation: Runs as a descendant of Plugin instances.

enums.name: RunState
enums.documentation: Specifies the current run state of Roblox Studio's simulation.

items.name: Stopped
items.documentation: The simulation is stopped.

items.name: Running
items.documentation: The simulation is running.

items.name: Paused
items.documentation: The simulation is paused.

enums.name: RuntimeUndoBehavior
enums.documentation: Controls how ChangeHistoryService records and handles undo history during a Studio playtest session.

items.name: Aggregate
items.documentation: Rejects waypoint requests during a run session; all runtime changes accumulate into a single waypoint that is reverted together when the session stops or resets.

items.name: Snapshot
items.documentation: Accepts waypoint requests during a run session and captures a snapshot of each instance's position and velocity at every waypoint boundary so that physics state can be fully restored on undo.

items.name: Hybrid
items.documentation: Accepts waypoint requests during a run session but excludes unsolicited physics changes (position and velocity drift from simulation) from the recorded history.

enums.name: SafeAreaCompatibility
enums.documentation: Describes how descendants of a ScreenGui adapt to screens with cutouts.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Do not apply compatibility transformations to any descendants of the ScreenGui.

items.name: FullscreenExtension
items.documentation: If the total area of any descendant GuiObject within the ScreenGui (including any applied border or UIStroke) covers the device's safe area both horizontally and vertically, its background area will be expanded to cover the fullscreen area. This expansion does not affect the size or position of the descendant's content, except in the case of ImageLabel, ImageButton, or VideoFrame where the image/video is considered part of the background and will be expanded to fullscreen. Note that this option

enums.name: SalesTypeFilter
enums.documentation: Filters catalog search results by sales type.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Returns all items regardless of sales type.

items.name: Collectibles
items.documentation: Returns only collectible items (Limited and Limited Unique).

items.name: Premium
items.documentation: Returns only items with Premium pricing.

items.name: TimedOptions
items.documentation: Returns only items that have timed options available.

enums.name: SandboxedInstanceMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether sandboxed instance mode (script capabilities) is enabled.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Uses the engine-default sandboxed instance state.

items.name: Experimental
items.documentation: Sandboxed instance mode is enabled.

enums.name: SavedQualitySetting
enums.documentation: Represents the user's saved graphics quality preference, stored in UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Graphics quality is determined automatically based on device performance.

items.name: QualityLevel1
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 1 — the lowest explicit quality setting.

items.name: QualityLevel2
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 2.

items.name: QualityLevel3
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 3.

items.name: QualityLevel4
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 4.

items.name: QualityLevel5
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 5.

items.name: QualityLevel6
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 6.

items.name: QualityLevel7
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 7.

items.name: QualityLevel8
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 8.

items.name: QualityLevel9
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 9.

items.name: QualityLevel10
items.documentation: Saved graphics quality level 10 — the highest explicit quality setting.

enums.name: SaveFilter
enums.documentation: Used by DataModel.SavePlace to determine the type of save operation This enum determines which aspects of the current place are saved, based on the following options.

items.name: SaveWorld
items.documentation: Saves only the world-related data.

items.name: SaveGame
items.documentation: Saves only the game-related data.

items.name: SaveAll
items.documentation: Saves all data, including both world and game-related information.

enums.name: ScaleType
enums.documentation: Determines how an image (of a ImageLabel or ImageButton) is scaled.

items.name: Stretch
items.documentation: The image is stretched to fit within the element.

items.name: Slice
items.documentation: 9-Slice scaling: slice the image into 9 regions and apply different scaling rules to each region. The slice boundaries are determined by ImageLabel.SliceCenter or ImageButton.SliceCenter. See UI 9-Slice Design for more information.

items.name: Tile
items.documentation: The image is tiled to fit within the element. For example, if the element is twice the X dimension of the image, the image will appear twice (2 tiles).

items.name: Fit
items.documentation: The image is scaled fit within the element X or Y dimension (whichever fits first).

items.name: Crop
items.documentation: The image is cropped to fit within the element.

enums.name: ScopeCheckResult
enums.documentation: Indicates the outcome of an ExperienceAuthService scope-authorization request.

items.name: ConsentAccepted
items.documentation: The player accepted the authorization prompt and a valid token was issued for the requested scopes.

items.name: InvalidScopes
items.documentation: The requested scopes are not recognized or are not permitted for the calling context.

items.name: Timeout
items.documentation: The scope-check request exceeded the configured timeout period before the player responded.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.documentation: The authorization prompt was dismissed without any explicit player action, such as when the player disconnects or the UI is closed without a response.

items.name: BackendError
items.documentation: The Roblox backend returned an error or unexpected HTTP status when exchanging the consent grant for an authorization token.

items.name: UnexpectedError
items.documentation: An unexpected error occurred that is not covered by a more specific result code.

items.name: InvalidArgument
items.documentation: One or more arguments passed to the scope-check call were invalid, such as an empty scope list, a null player instance, or a player who is no longer in the experience.

items.name: ConsentDenied
items.documentation: The player explicitly declined the authorization prompt.

enums.name: ScreenInsets
enums.documentation: Insets associated with various screen safe areas.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No insets are added to the fullscreen area. This mode may result in UI that is obscured or completely hidden by device notches and cutouts, so you should only use it for a ScreenGui that contains non‑interactive content like background images.

items.name: DeviceSafeInsets
items.documentation: Device safe area insets are added to the fullscreen area. The resulting area is guaranteed to not be occluded by any device screen cutouts such as the camera notch, although no inset is added for Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons. As a result, it's recommended that you use CoreUISafeInsets for a ScreenGui whose contents should remain unobscured by both device cutouts and core screen elements.

items.name: CoreUISafeInsets
items.documentation: Core UI insets are added to the DeviceSafeInsets area, resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons. This mode is recommended for any ScreenGui that contains interactive and/or important UI elements such as buttons and status messages.

items.name: TopbarSafeInsets
items.documentation: Top bar safe area insets are added to the DeviceSafeInsets area, resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the experience controls. Unlike CoreUISafeInsets, this area's position and size is dynamic and is limited to the space available within the top bar area itself, outside of CoreUISafeInsets. See the GuiService.TopbarInset property which represents the absolute size and position of the unobstructed area within the top bar s

enums.name: ScreenOrientation
enums.documentation: The preference of in-game screen orientation on hand-held devices.

items.name: LandscapeLeft
items.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the left side of the screen.

items.name: LandscapeRight
items.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the right side of the screen.

items.name: LandscapeSensor
items.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the left of right side of the screen depending on the device's orientation (the sensor determines which side allows for the game to be displayed right-side-up).

items.name: Portrait
items.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed portrait (vertically) with the bottom of the device on the bottom of the screen.

items.name: Sensor
items.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed depending on the best match to the device's current orientation - either landscape (left/right) or portrait.

enums.name: ScreenshotCaptureResult
enums.documentation: Describes the result of a screenshot capture initiated by CaptureService:TakeScreenshotCaptureAsync().

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The screenshot capture completed successfully.

items.name: OtherError
items.documentation: The screenshot capture failed due to an unspecified error.

items.name: NoDeviceSupport
items.documentation: The device does not support screenshot captures.

items.name: NoSpaceOnDevice
items.documentation: The device does not have enough storage space to save the screenshot capture.

enums.name: ScriptStoppedReason
enums.documentation: Describes why the debugger paused execution.

items.name: Breakpoint
items.documentation: Execution stopped because a user-defined breakpoint was hit.

items.name: Exception
items.documentation: Execution stopped because an exception was thrown (governed by the current DebugBreakModeType).

items.name: Pause
items.documentation: Execution stopped because ScriptDebuggerService:Pause() was called.

items.name: Step
items.documentation: Execution stopped after completing a step operation.

items.name: Entry
items.documentation: Execution stopped at a script's entry point.

enums.name: ScriptVariableScope
enums.documentation: Indicates the scope category of a variable returned by the debugger.

items.name: Local
items.documentation: A local variable declared in the current function scope.

items.name: Upvalue
items.documentation: A variable captured from an enclosing function scope.

items.name: Global
items.documentation: A global variable.

enums.name: ScrollBarInset
enums.documentation: This enum is used with ScrollingFrame.HorizontalScrollBarInset and ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset to indicate whether the canvas should be inset by ScrollBarThickness for the respective scroll bar.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The canvas will never be inset for the respective scroll bar.

items.name: ScrollBar
items.documentation: The canvas will only be inset if the respective scroll bar is showing.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: The canvas will always be inset for the respective scroll bar, regardless of whether that scroll bar is showing.

enums.name: ScrollingDirection
enums.documentation: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.

items.name: X
items.documentation: The canvas can only be scrolled along the X axis.

items.name: Y
items.documentation: The canvas can only be scrolled along the Y axis.

items.name: XY
items.documentation: The canvas can be scrolled along both the X and Y axes.

enums.name: SecurityCapability
enums.documentation: Identifies a specific permission capability that a sandboxed script container may grant or restrict.

items.name: RunClientScript
items.documentation: Indicates that a script container is permitted to execute scripts on the client (LocalScript).

items.name: RunServerScript
items.documentation: Indicates that a script container is permitted to execute scripts on the server (Script).

items.name: AccessOutsideWrite
items.documentation: Grants a script read-write access to instances that live outside its sandboxed container.

items.name: AssetRequire
items.documentation: Deprecated. Use SecurityCapability.LoadUnownedAsset instead.

items.name: LoadString
items.documentation: Allows a script to use the loadstring() Luau built-in to compile and execute a string as code.

items.name: ScriptGlobals
items.documentation: Allows a script to access the shared and _G shared global variable tables.

items.name: CreateInstances
items.documentation: Allows a script to create new Instance objects using Instance.new().

items.name: Basic
items.documentation: Guards access to a broad set of general-purpose engine APIs that do not belong to a more specific capability category.

items.name: Audio
items.documentation: Guards access to audio engine APIs such as Sound, AudioPlayer, and related classes.

items.name: DataStore
items.documentation: Guards access to data store APIs such as DataStoreService and its associated objects.

items.name: Network
items.documentation: Guards access to low-level networking APIs such as HttpService.

items.name: Physics
items.documentation: Guards access to physics engine APIs such as Constraint classes and BasePart physics properties.

items.name: UI
items.documentation: Guards access to UI engine APIs such as ScreenGui, Frame, and other GuiObject classes.

items.name: CSG
items.documentation: Guards access to Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) APIs such as UnionOperation and NegateOperation.

items.name: Chat
items.documentation: Guards access to chat engine APIs such as TextChatService and related chat classes.

items.name: Animation
items.documentation: Guards access to animation engine APIs such as AnimationController and related classes.

items.name: Avatar
items.documentation: Deprecated. Use SecurityCapability.AvatarAppearance instead.

items.name: Input
items.documentation: Guards access to user input APIs such as UserInputService and ContextActionService.

items.name: Environment
items.documentation: Guards access to environment and world-setting APIs such as Lighting and Atmosphere.

items.name: RemoteEvent
items.documentation: Guards access to remote event and function APIs such as RemoteEvent and RemoteFunction.

items.name: LegacySound
items.documentation: Guards access to the legacy Sound and pre-VoiceChatService.UseAudioApi sound stack APIs.

items.name: Players
items.documentation: Guards access to Players service APIs that query or manage connected players.

items.name: CapabilityControl
items.documentation: Guards access to the Instance.Capabilities and Instance.Sandboxed properties that configure script sandboxing.

items.name: Plugin
items.documentation: Mirrors the legacy Plugin permission level, granting access to Studio plugin APIs.

items.name: LocalUser
items.documentation: Mirrors the legacy LocalUser permission level, granting access to IDE-only and Studio-level APIs.

items.name: WritePlayer
items.documentation: Mirrors the legacy WritePlayer permission level, granting the ability to modify player identity properties such as name and UserId.

items.name: RobloxScript
items.documentation: Mirrors the legacy RobloxScript permission level, granting access to CoreScript APIs.

items.name: RobloxEngine
items.documentation: Mirrors the legacy RobloxEngine permission level, granting access to internal engine-level APIs.

items.name: Unassigned
items.documentation: The default capability assigned to API members that have not been explicitly assigned to any other capability category.

items.name: InternalTest
items.documentation: Restricts access to non-sensitive APIs that are intentionally kept internal.

items.name: PluginOrOpenCloud
items.documentation: Restricts access to APIs callable only from Studio plugin or Open Cloud Luau execution sessions.

items.name: Assistant
items.documentation: Restricts access to APIs that may only be called from Studio Assistant execution contexts.

items.name: RemoteCommand
items.documentation: Restricts access to APIs that are executable only from Studio's RemoteCommandService in Team Create sessions.

items.name: AssetRead
items.documentation: Guards access to APIs that read or query asset metadata from the Roblox catalog.

items.name: AssetManagement
items.documentation: Guards access to asset management APIs such as ContentProvider:PreloadAsync() and encryption-key registration.

items.name: DynamicGeneration
items.documentation: Guards access to procedural and AI-driven content generation APIs such as EditableMesh and AvatarCreationService.

items.name: PlatformAvatarEditing
items.documentation: Guards access to platform-level avatar editing APIs provided by AvatarEditorService.

items.name: AssetCreateUpdate
items.documentation: Guards access to APIs that create or update published Roblox assets.

items.name: Capture
items.documentation: Guards access to CaptureService APIs that take screenshots and record video.

items.name: SensitiveInput
items.documentation: Guards access to sensitive user input APIs such as those that can read raw keyboard or mouse data beyond normal game input.

items.name: Monetization
items.documentation: Guards access to in-experience purchase and monetization APIs such as MarketplaceService.

items.name: LoadOwnedAsset
items.documentation: Allows a script to load assets that are owned by the experience's creator using InsertService or LuaGlobals.require().

items.name: Social
items.documentation: Guards access to social APIs such as SocialService, FriendPages, and ExperienceInviteOptions.

items.name: ServerCommunication
items.documentation: Guards access to server-to-server messaging APIs such as MessagingService.

items.name: Logging
items.documentation: Guards access to LogService and logging-related APIs.

items.name: PromptExternalPurchase
items.documentation: Guards access to APIs that initiate external (non-Roblox) purchase prompts.

items.name: Groups
items.documentation: Guards access to group-related APIs such as GroupService.

items.name: Teleport
items.documentation: Guards access to teleportation APIs such as TeleportService, TeleportOptions, and TeleportAsyncResult.

items.name: Consequences
items.documentation: Guards access to moderation and player-consequence APIs such as Players:BanAsync() and ModerationService.

items.name: Material
items.documentation: Guards access to MaterialService, MaterialVariant, and custom material APIs.

items.name: AvatarBehavior
items.documentation: Guards access to APIs that control avatar locomotion and behavior at runtime.

items.name: AvatarAppearance
items.documentation: Guards access to APIs that read or modify avatar appearance, such as HumanoidDescription.

items.name: LoadUnownedAsset
items.documentation: Allows a script to LuaGlobals.require() asset IDs or call InsertService:LoadAsset() for assets not owned by the creator.

enums.name: SelectionBehavior
enums.documentation: Customization options for gamepad selection when GuiBase2d.SelectionGroup is true.

items.name: Escape
items.documentation: Prioritizes GuiObjects within the same SelectionGroup but allows the selection to move to other outside GuiObjects if no suitable button is found.

items.name: Stop
items.documentation: Constrains gamepad selection to the SelectionGroup.

enums.name: SelectionRenderMode
enums.documentation: Controls how selected objects are highlighted in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Outlines
items.documentation: Renders selected objects using an outline drawn along each object's edges.

items.name: BoundingBoxes
items.documentation: Renders selected objects using a bounding box drawn around each object's extents.

items.name: Both
items.documentation: Renders selected objects with both outlines and bounding boxes simultaneously.

enums.name: SelfViewPosition
enums.documentation: Defines the screen location of the current player's self view.

items.name: LastPosition
items.documentation: The position of the self view when it was last closed.

items.name: TopLeft
items.documentation: Top-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and left edges.

items.name: TopRight
items.documentation: Top-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and right edges.

items.name: BottomLeft
items.documentation: Bottom-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and left edges.

items.name: BottomRight
items.documentation: Bottom-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and right edges.

enums.name: SensorMode
enums.documentation: Specifies whether a ControllerPartSensor targets floor or ladder geometry, and which detection algorithm to use.

items.name: Floor
items.documentation: Detects floor surfaces below the part using the modern detection algorithm; the default value of ControllerPartSensor.SensorMode.

items.name: Ladder
items.documentation: Detects ladder surfaces adjacent to the part using the modern piercing-based detection algorithm.

items.name: ClassicFloor
items.documentation: Detects floor surfaces below the part using the legacy raycast-based algorithm.

items.name: ClassicLadder
items.documentation: Detects ladder surfaces adjacent to the part using the legacy ladder detection algorithm.

enums.name: SensorUpdateType
enums.documentation: Controls when a sensor recalculates its output properties.

items.name: OnRead
items.documentation: The sensor lazily recalculates its output the next time an output property is read and the output is marked dirty.

items.name: Manual
items.documentation: The sensor never automatically recalculates its output; scripts are responsible for driving output updates.

enums.name: ServiceVisibility
enums.documentation: Controls when a service is displayed in the Explorer window in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Always
items.documentation: The service is always visible in the Explorer window.

items.name: Off
items.documentation: The service is hidden from the Explorer window by default, but can still be added via the Insert Service menu.

items.name: WithChildren
items.documentation: The service is visible in the Explorer window only when it has children; it can still be added via the Insert Service menu.

enums.name: Severity
enums.documentation: Classifies the severity level of a Luau LSP diagnostic reported by a Script Analysis callback.

items.name: Error
items.documentation: Reports a critical error that indicates a definite problem in the script.

items.name: Warning
items.documentation: Reports a potential problem that can cause incorrect behavior but does not prevent the script from running.

items.name: Information
items.documentation: Conveys informational context about the script without indicating a problem.

items.name: Hint
items.documentation: Provides a subtle suggestion, such as a style improvement or an unused-variable notice.

enums.name: ShowAdResult
enums.documentation: Result codes returned by AdService:ShowRewardedVideoAdAsync() indicating whether a rewarded video ad completed successfully or why it did not.

items.name: ShowCompleted
items.documentation: The ad was successfully shown to completion.

items.name: AdNotReady
items.documentation: You are trying to show a full-screen ad before the ad has fully loaded. You might have failed to properly fetch the ad, or the ad might have expired.

items.name: AdAlreadyShowing
items.documentation: You are trying to show a full-screen ad while another full-screen ad is already playing.

items.name: InternalError
items.documentation: An unspecified internal error occurred. Try showing the ad again.

items.name: ShowInterrupted
items.documentation: The ad view of the user has been interrupted. The user might have closed the ad view or left the experience, and should not receive a reward.

items.name: InsufficientMemory
items.documentation: The device does not have sufficient video memory available to display the ad.

enums.name: SignalBehavior
enums.documentation: Determines when the engine resumes event handlers.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default behavior; currently equivalent to Immediate but this will eventually change to Deferred.

items.name: Immediate
items.documentation: Event handlers are resumed immediately when the event occurs.

items.name: Deferred
items.documentation: All events are deferred and their handlers resumed at specific resumptions points each frame.

items.name: AncestryDeferred
items.documentation: Equivalent to Deferred but only for events triggered by changes in ancestry.

enums.name: SizeConstraint
enums.documentation: Used to constrain the scale of a GUI object.

items.name: RelativeXY
items.documentation: The scale of X and Y are independent.

items.name: RelativeXX
items.documentation: The scale of X is shared with Y.

items.name: RelativeYY
items.documentation: The scale of Y is shared with X.

enums.name: SlimTintMode
enums.documentation: Determines the color-coding mode used by the SLIM debug tint overlay in the Developer Console.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No tint is applied. Meshes render with their normal appearance.

items.name: LevelOfDetail
items.documentation: Colors each mesh by its current level of detail. Blue is the coarsest, red the finest, and every rank in between maps to a fixed color. A given color always means the same LOD rank across every mesh, with the exception that each mesh's own highest available LOD is always shown red.

items.name: DataModelState
items.documentation: Colors SLIM models by whether their DataModel instances are streamed in or out. Green indicates streamed in (full DataModel present); yellow indicates streamed out (a placeholder). Both are still rendered via SLIM.

items.name: TranscoderStatus
items.documentation: Colors each SLIM model by its SlimTranscoderStatus. Follow the link to see which color maps to each status.

enums.name: SlimTranscoderStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the backend transcoding state of a SLIM model, from upload through transcoding to success or failure.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: The transcoding status has not yet been determined. This is the initial state before the model has been queried. Shown as yellow in the debug tint overlay.

items.name: Transcoding
items.documentation: SLIM transcoding is currently in progress on the backend. The model is expected to transition to Succeeded or Failed once transcoding completes. Shown as blue in the debug tint overlay.

items.name: Succeeded
items.documentation: Transcoding completed successfully and the SLIM assets are available for streaming. Shown as green in the debug tint overlay.

items.name: Failed
items.documentation: Transcoding did not complete successfully. Shown as red in the debug tint overlay.

enums.name: SolverConvergenceMetricType
enums.documentation: Specifies the metric used to identify the least-converged constraint when visualizing physics solver convergence.

items.name: IterationBased
items.documentation: Identifies the least-converged constraint using the estimated force change from an additional, non-applied solver iteration.

items.name: AlgorithmAgnostic
items.documentation: Identifies the least-converged constraint using a residual-based convergence metric supported across solver algorithms.

enums.name: SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether and at what granularity the physics solver's convergence quality is overlaid as a debug visualization in Studio.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: No solver convergence visualization is rendered; the default state.

items.name: PerIsland
items.documentation: Renders a single convergence metric label at the center of each simulation island displaying the velocity-stage and position-stage maxima, which may come from different constraints.

items.name: PerEdge
items.documentation: Renders convergence metrics as text labels on each aggregated body-pair edge between assembly root bodies.

enums.name: SortDirection
enums.documentation: Controls whether results are ordered from lowest to highest or from highest to lowest.

items.name: Ascending
items.documentation: Orders results from lowest to highest value, or from oldest to newest entry.

items.name: Descending
items.documentation: Orders results from highest to lowest value, or from newest to oldest entry.

enums.name: SortOrder
enums.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.SortOrder to order the elements in the layout.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Elements are ordered by the function passed to UIGridStyleLayout:SetCustomSortFunction().

items.name: LayoutOrder
items.documentation: Elements are ordered by GuiObject.LayoutOrder in ascending order; for example 0 will be placed before 1.

enums.name: StartCorner
enums.documentation: Used by UIGridLayout.StartCorner to decide where the first element is placed.

items.name: TopLeft
items.documentation: Grid starts in top left corner.

items.name: TopRight
items.documentation: Grid starts in top right corner.

items.name: BottomLeft
items.documentation: Grid starts in bottom left corner.

items.name: BottomRight

items.documentation: Adds an "X" pattern across the surface.

items.documentation: Adds square studs across the surface.

items.documentation: Adds square holes across the surface where studs would be.

items.documentation: Adds a yellow hinge to the surface. Parts touching it stick to the surface, allowing for rotations using physics. This should not be used for future work and existing instances should be replaced with a HingeConstraint.

items.name: Motor
items.documentation: Functioned identically to a hinge with the addition of a grey ring.

items.name: SteppingMotor
items.documentation: Functioned identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in the past, but that functionality is non-existent.
