enums.documentation: Indicates the outcome of a Team Create place-upload attempt, as reported by the TeamCreateErrorStatus event on TeamCreatePublishService.

items.name: PlaceSizeTooLarge
items.documentation: The serialized place size has exceeded the hard upload limit and the save was aborted.

items.name: PlaceSizeApproachingLimit
items.documentation: The serialized place size has reached or exceeded the public warning threshold but is still below the hard upload limit.

items.name: PlaceUploadFailing
items.documentation: Repeated upload attempts have failed due to HTTP or network errors, and the consecutive-failure count has reached the configured warning threshold.

items.name: NoError
items.documentation: The place serialized and uploaded successfully with no size-limit issues detected.

enums.name: Technology
enums.documentation: Enum used by Lighting.Technology to represent the different lighting systems available for rendering the 3D world.

items.name: Voxel
items.documentation: Uses a 4×4×4 voxel map for light and shadow calculation.

items.name: Compatibility
items.documentation: Simulates the removed legacy technology and is now deprecated. To achieve a similar look, use Voxel Lighting and add a ColorGradingEffect post‑processing effect set to the Retro preset.

items.name: ShadowMap
items.documentation: Features shadow mapping that produces more realistic and crisp shadows from sunlight or directional light sources.

items.name: Future
items.documentation: Features the most advanced technology for high-fidelity lighting and shadows.

enums.name: TeleportMethod
enums.documentation: Identifies which TeleportService API method initiated a teleport.

items.name: TeleportToSpawnByName
items.documentation: Teleport was initiated by TeleportService:TeleportToSpawnByName(), which sends a player to a named SpawnLocation in a place.

items.name: TeleportToPlaceInstance
items.documentation: Teleport was initiated by TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(), which sends a player to a specific running server instance identified by its instanceId.

items.name: TeleportToPrivateServer
items.documentation: Teleport was initiated by TeleportService:TeleportToPrivateServer(), which sends players to a reserved server using an access code.

items.name: TeleportPartyAsync
items.documentation: Teleport was initiated by TeleportService:TeleportPartyAsync(), which sends a group of players to a place together.

items.name: TeleportToVIPServer
items.documentation: Teleport was initiated to a VIP (creator-owned private) server; the engine upgrades the method tag to this value when VIP server credentials are present at teleport time.

items.name: TeleportToInstanceBack
items.documentation: Teleport was initiated by back-navigation, returning a player to a specific prior place instance.

items.name: TeleportUnknown
items.documentation: Fallback value used when the teleport method cannot be determined.

enums.name: TeleportResult
enums.documentation: Describes the result of a teleport.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The teleport was successful.

items.name: Failure
items.documentation: The teleport failed for an unknown reason.

items.name: GameNotFound
items.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to could not be found.

items.name: GameEnded
items.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to has ended.

items.name: GameFull
items.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to is full.

items.name: Unauthorized
items.documentation: The player is not authorized to complete this teleport.

items.name: Flooded
items.documentation: Too many teleport requests have been made recently.

items.name: IsTeleporting
items.documentation: The player is currently being teleported.

enums.name: TeleportState
enums.documentation: Determines the current teleportation state of a player.

items.name: RequestedFromServer
items.documentation: The server has requested that the client teleport.

items.name: Started
items.documentation: The client has started attempting to teleport.

items.name: WaitingForServer
items.documentation: The client is waiting for the server to respond to the teleport request.

items.name: Failed
items.documentation: The teleport failed.

items.name: InProgress
items.documentation: The teleport is currently in progress. The player usually disconnects and teleports to the destination after this.

enums.name: TeleportType
enums.documentation: Determines the type of teleport destination for a TeleportService teleport call.

items.name: ToPlace
items.documentation: The teleport destination is a place (no specific instance).

items.name: ToInstance
items.documentation: The teleport destination is an instance of a place.

items.name: ToReservedServer
items.documentation: The destination of the teleport is a reserved server (a place instance that is reserved for a select group of players).

items.name: ToVIPServer
items.documentation: The teleport destination is a VIP (player-owned private) server instance.

items.name: ToInstanceBack
items.documentation: The teleport destination is a previously-visited place instance (back navigation).

enums.name: TerrainAcquisitionMethod
enums.documentation: Describes how terrain in a place was originally created or last substantially modified.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No terrain is present, or terrain acquisition method has not been recorded.

items.name: Legacy
items.documentation: Terrain was deserialized from a place file that predates acquisition-method tracking.

items.name: Template
items.documentation: Terrain was loaded from a Studio place template.

items.name: Generate
items.documentation: Terrain was created using the Studio terrain generator.

items.name: Import
items.documentation: Terrain was created by importing a heightmap or colormap image via the Studio terrain importer.

items.name: Convert
items.documentation: Terrain was created by converting legacy smooth terrain from an older place format.

items.name: EditAddTool
items.documentation: Terrain was created or last modified using the Studio terrain editor's Add tool.

items.name: EditSeaLevelTool
items.documentation: Terrain was created or last modified using the Studio terrain editor's Sea Level tool.

items.name: EditReplaceTool
items.documentation: Terrain was created or last modified using the Studio terrain editor's Replace tool.

items.name: RegionFillTool
items.documentation: Terrain was created or last modified using the Studio terrain editor's Fill region tool.

items.name: RegionPasteTool
items.documentation: Terrain was created or last modified by pasting a previously copied terrain region in the Studio terrain editor.

items.name: Other
items.documentation: Terrain was created or modified by an untracked method, such as a third-party plugin.

enums.name: TerrainFace
enums.documentation: Identifies which face direction of a terrain voxel a TerrainDetail object overrides.

items.name: Top
items.documentation: The top (+Y) face of a terrain voxel.

items.name: Side
items.documentation: The horizontal (side) faces of a terrain voxel, perpendicular to the Y axis.

items.name: Bottom
items.documentation: The bottom (-Y) face of a terrain voxel.

enums.name: TextChatMessageStatus
enums.documentation: Indicates the status of a TextChatMessage.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Generic failed status for any other TextChannel:SendAsync() failures.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: Message has no issues.

items.name: Sending
items.documentation: Message is sending.

items.name: TextFilterFailed
items.documentation: Text filter failed to process the message.

items.name: Floodchecked
items.documentation: Message is from a user sending messages too frequently.

items.name: InvalidPrivacySettings
items.documentation: Message can't be sent because of the user's chat privacy settings.

items.name: InvalidTextChannelPermissions
items.documentation: Message's TextSource is either not in the intended TextChannel or TextSource.CanSend is false.

items.name: MessageTooLong
items.documentation: Message is too long.

items.name: ModerationTimeout
items.documentation: Message can't be sent because the user has an active moderation timeout on chat.

enums.name: TextDirection
enums.documentation: Controls the base text rendering direction for TextLabel, TextButton, and TextBox instances.

items.name: Auto
items.documentation: Automatically determines text direction from the first strong directional character using the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm.

items.name: LeftToRight
items.documentation: Forces the paragraph base direction to left-to-right regardless of the text content.

items.name: RightToLeft
items.documentation: Forces the paragraph base direction to right-to-left regardless of the text content.

enums.name: TextFilterContext
enums.documentation: Indicates whether text submitted to TextService:FilterStringAsync() or TextService:FilterAndTranslateStringAsync() is intended for a public or private audience, controlling the strictness of the text filtering backend.

items.name: PublicChat
items.documentation: Indicates the string will be visible to all players or a broad public audience, applying the strictest level of text filtering.

items.name: PrivateChat
items.documentation: Indicates the string is part of a private conversation between specific users, applying filtering appropriate for one-to-one or small-group exchanges.

enums.name: TextTruncate
enums.documentation: Controls the truncation of text when using the TextTruncate property.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Text is not truncated.

items.name: AtEnd
items.documentation: Text is truncated at the end of the text; extra graphemes that cannot fit into the space are replaced with .... Word boundaries are respected if possible. For example, if the control is between -> and <- like so: ->Long text is truncated at the en<-d of the last complete word The text will be: Long text is truncated at the...

items.name: SplitWord
items.documentation: If the end of the line occurs in the middle of a word, the text is truncated inside of that word. Extra graphemes that cannot fit into the space are replaced with .... For example, if the control is between -> and <- like so: ->Long text is truncated at the en<-d of the last complete word The text will be: Long text is truncated at the en...

enums.name: TextureMode
enums.documentation: Describes how the texture of a Trail or Beam behaves.

items.name: Stretch
items.documentation: For a Trail, the texture will stretch out based on the lifetime of the trail, and shrink inwards if the trail's attachments stop moving. For a Beam, the texture will repeat TextureLength times across the beam's overall length. See here for details.

items.name: Wrap
items.documentation: For a Trail, the texture will be tiled as the length of the trail changes, but the textures will remain stationary relative to their attachments. For a Beam, the texture repetitions will equal the beam's overall length (in studs) divided by its TextureLength. See here for details.

items.name: Static
items.documentation: For a Trail, the texture will be rolled out as the attachments move, and they will remain in place until their lifetime is met. This setting is ideal for trail textures that should appear "stamped" where rendered, such as paw prints or tire tracks. This value is not supported for Beam and therefore behaves identically to Wrap.

enums.name: TextureQueryType
enums.documentation: Used to get memory information about textures.

items.name: NonHumanoid
items.documentation: Texture memory for objects other than Humanoid.

items.name: NonHumanoidOrphaned
items.documentation: Unreferenced texture memory for objects other than Humanoid.

items.name: Humanoid
items.documentation: Texture memory for Humanoid.

items.name: HumanoidOrphaned
items.documentation: Unreferenced texture memory for Humanoid.

enums.name: TextXAlignment
enums.documentation: Determines horizontal alignment of text.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: Alignment starts at the left side of the GUI object.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: Alignment starts at the right side of the GUI object.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally left and right.

enums.name: TextYAlignment
enums.documentation: Determines vertical alignment of text.

items.name: Top
items.documentation: Alignment starts at the top of the GUI object.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally toward the top and bottom.

items.name: Bottom
items.documentation: Alignment starts at the bottom of the GUI object.

enums.name: ThreadPoolConfig
enums.documentation: Thread pooling scheme for the task scheduler.

items.name: Auto
items.documentation: Let task scheduler make a decision internally.

items.name: Threads1
items.documentation: Utilize 1 worker thread, ignore the physical CPU core count.

items.name: Threads2
items.documentation: Utilize 2 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

items.name: Threads3
items.documentation: Utilize 3 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

items.name: Threads4
items.documentation: Utilize 4 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

items.name: Threads8
items.documentation: Utilize 8 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

items.name: Threads16
items.documentation: Utilize 16 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

items.name: PerCore1
items.documentation: Utilize 1 worker thread per available physical CPU core.

items.name: PerCore2
items.documentation: Utilize 2 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

items.name: PerCore3
items.documentation: Utilize 3 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

items.name: PerCore4
items.documentation: Utilize 4 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

enums.name: ThrottlingPriority
enums.documentation: Amount of throttling to apply.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Standard throttling.

items.name: ElevatedOnServer
items.documentation: Less throttling if on the server.

items.name: Extreme
items.documentation: No throttling, absolutely no exceptions.

enums.name: ThumbnailSize
enums.documentation: Describes the pixel resolution of a user thumbnail returned by Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync().

items.name: Size48x48
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 48 pixels x 48 pixels.

items.name: Size180x180
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 180 pixels x 180 pixels.

items.name: Size420x420
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 420 pixels x 420 pixels.

items.name: Size60x60
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 60 pixels x 60 pixels.

items.name: Size100x100
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 100 pixels x 100 pixels.

items.name: Size150x150
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 150 pixels x 150 pixels.

items.name: Size352x352
items.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 352 pixels x 352 pixels.

enums.name: ThumbnailType
enums.documentation: Describes the type of user thumbnail returned by Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync().

items.name: HeadShot
items.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows just the headshot (head and up) of the user's avatar.

items.name: AvatarBust
items.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows the bust (chest up) of the user's avatar.

items.name: AvatarThumbnail
items.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows the entire body of the user's avatar.

enums.name: TickCountSampleMethod
enums.documentation: Controls the precision and performance trade-off used when sampling the current time.

items.name: Fast
items.documentation: Compute time using a faster, but less precise method.

items.name: Benchmark
items.documentation: Dynamically decide between using Fast and Precise depending on the value of DebugSettings.TickCountPreciseOverride.

items.name: Precise
items.documentation: Compute time using a precise method.

enums.name: TonemapperPreset
enums.documentation: Controls which tone-mapping algorithm ColorGradingEffect applies to the rendered scene.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Sets the tone mapper to use the post‑2019 Roblox appearance which provides vivid colors and high contrasts.

items.name: Retro
items.documentation: Sets the tone mapper to imitate the pre‑2019 Roblox appearance. Colors look less saturated and there is less contrast between them.

enums.name: TopBottom
enums.documentation: Sets where the object is on the side of its parent.

items.name: Top
items.documentation: The object is above its parent.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: The object is centered around the center of its parent.

items.name: Bottom
items.documentation: The object is below its parent.

enums.name: TouchCameraMovementMode
enums.documentation: Changes the touch camera movement mode currently in-use by the client using a TouchEnabled device.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

items.name: Classic
items.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

items.name: Follow
items.documentation: Camera moves with the subject and rotates to keep the subject in the center.

items.name: Orbital
items.documentation: The camera locks at a certain angle. Once it's set, players can rotate the camera, but it will always maintain a consistent angle to the ground.

enums.name: TouchMovementMode
enums.documentation: The movement mode used by a client with a TouchEnabled device.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default movement controller.

items.name: Thumbstick
items.documentation: Change the movement controller to the classic thumbstick.

items.name: DPad
items.documentation: Change the movement controller to the DPad.

items.name: Thumbpad
items.documentation: Change the movement controller to the thumbpad.

items.name: ClickToMove
items.documentation: Change the movement controller to click to move.

items.name: DynamicThumbstick
items.documentation: Change the movement controller to the dynamic thumbstick.

enums.name: TrackerError
enums.documentation: Status and error codes reported by the face-tracking subsystem through the TrackerError events on RTAnimationTracker and FaceAnimatorService.

items.name: Ok
items.documentation: No error; the tracker is operating normally.

items.name: NoService
items.documentation: A required engine service was unavailable when the tracker attempted to connect.

items.name: InitFailed
items.documentation: The tracker failed to create or initialize its tracking session.

items.name: NoVideo
items.documentation: Video input is unavailable because no camera device was found or the camera was disconnected.

items.name: VideoError
items.documentation: A generic video error occurred during face-tracking camera input processing.

items.name: VideoNoPermission
items.documentation: The user denied camera permission required for video-based face tracking.

items.name: VideoUnsupported
items.documentation: Video-based face tracking is not supported on this device or platform.

items.name: NoAudio
items.documentation: Audio input is unavailable because SoundService could not be found or connected.

items.name: AudioError
items.documentation: A generic audio error occurred during face-tracking audio input processing.

items.name: AudioNoPermission
items.documentation: The user denied microphone permission required for audio-based face tracking.

items.name: UnsupportedDevice
items.documentation: The current device or platform does not support face tracking.

enums.name: TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode
enums.documentation: Controls how the face-tracking pipeline extrapolates animation data between camera frames on the TrackerLodController.

items.name: ForceDisabled
items.documentation: Disables all extrapolation so that facial animation updates only when a new camera frame is processed.

items.name: ExtrapolateFacsAndPose
items.documentation: Extrapolates both FACS blend-shape values and head-pose data between camera frames.

items.name: ExtrapolateFacsOnly
items.documentation: Extrapolates only FACS blend-shape values between camera frames, leaving head-pose data unchanged.

items.name: Auto
items.documentation: Lets the TrackerLodController automatically select the extrapolation strategy based on current performance conditions.

enums.name: TrackerFaceTrackingStatus
enums.documentation: Describes the current state of face tracking for the device camera used by FaceAnimatorService.

items.name: FaceTrackingSuccess
items.documentation: Face tracking is active and a face is being tracked successfully.

items.name: FaceTrackingNoFaceFound
items.documentation: The tracker is running but no face has been detected in the camera feed.

items.name: FaceTrackingUnknown
items.documentation: The face tracking state is indeterminate or could not be mapped to a known status.

items.name: FaceTrackingLost
items.documentation: Face tracking was previously active but the face has been lost from the camera feed.

items.name: FaceTrackingHasTrackingError
items.documentation: Face tracking is active but has encountered an error that prevents reliable pose estimation.

items.name: FaceTrackingIsOccluded
items.documentation: A face is detected but is partially or fully occluded, reducing tracking reliability.

items.name: FaceTrackingUninitialized
items.documentation: Face tracking has not yet been initialized; this is the default state before the tracker starts.

enums.name: TrackerLodFlagMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether a real-time face-tracker feature (audio or video) is forced on, forced off, or left to the automatic LOD system.

items.name: ForceFalse
items.documentation: Forces the associated tracker feature disabled, regardless of the current LOD state.

items.name: ForceTrue
items.documentation: Forces the associated tracker feature enabled, regardless of the current LOD state.

items.name: Auto
items.documentation: Defers the enabled/disabled decision to the automatic LOD system.

enums.name: TrackerLodValueMode
enums.documentation: Controls how the video LOD level is selected for the face-tracking pipeline in TrackerLodController.

items.name: Force0
items.documentation: Forces the face-tracking video pipeline to LOD level 0, the faster but less accurate processing mode.

items.name: Force1
items.documentation: Forces the face-tracking video pipeline to LOD level 1, the more accurate but more resource-intensive processing mode.

items.name: Auto
items.documentation: The LOD controller selects the video LOD level automatically based on real-time performance metrics.

enums.name: TrackerMode
enums.documentation: Describes the combination of input sources an RTAnimationTracker is currently using to drive animation.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No tracking inference is active; the tracker is idle or has not successfully started.

items.name: Audio
items.documentation: Only audio-to-curve (lipsync) inference is active; no camera-based facial tracking is running.

items.name: Video
items.documentation: Only video-to-curve facial tracking is active; audio-based lipsync inference is not running.

items.name: AudioVideo
items.documentation: Both audio-to-curve lipsync inference and video-to-curve facial tracking are active simultaneously.

enums.name: TrackerPromptEvent
enums.documentation: Indicates the type of prompt fired by the face tracker when a runtime condition requires user attention.

items.name: LODCameraRecommendDisable
items.documentation: The LOD controller has determined that device performance is insufficient to sustain camera-based face tracking and recommends disabling camera input.

enums.name: TrackerType
enums.documentation: Specifies the type of motion tracking that an RTAnimationTracker performs.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No tracking type is selected; the tracking engine does not initialize, and attempting to start tracking with this type set raises TrackerError.UnsupportedDevice.

items.name: Face
items.documentation: Enables face tracking from a connected video device (and optionally audio) to produce FACS blendshape weights and head-orientation data each step.

items.name: UpperBody
items.documentation: Reserved for upper-body motion tracking. Setting this type raises TrackerError.UnsupportedDevice on initialization.

enums.name: TriStateBoolean
enums.documentation: A three-state boolean enumeration used by PolicyService to represent a value that is explicitly True, explicitly False, or not yet resolved (Unknown).

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Indicates the condition has not yet been determined or resolved; the default value.

items.name: True
items.documentation: Indicates the condition is explicitly true.

items.name: False
items.documentation: Indicates the condition is explicitly false.

enums.name: TweenStatus
enums.documentation: The completion status of a GuiObject tween function.

items.name: Canceled
items.documentation: The tween was cancelled before completion.

items.name: Completed
items.documentation: The Tween has successfully completed.

enums.name: UICaptureMode
enums.documentation: Used to determine what UI elements should be captured with CaptureService.

items.name: All
items.documentation: Capture all UI elements.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Capture no UI elements.

enums.name: UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior
enums.documentation: Used with UIDragDetector to determine bounding behavior of the dragged UI object when UIDragDetector.BoundingUI is set.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Mimics EntireObject behavior for a UI object that's entirely contained by the BoundingUI, or else HitPoint for a UI object that's partially outside the BoundingUI.

items.name: EntireObject
items.documentation: Bounds the entire dragged UI object within the BoundingUI.

items.name: HitPoint
items.documentation: Bounds the dragged UI only by the exact hit/grab point and its respective position after translation/rotation.

enums.name: UIDragDetectorDragRelativity
enums.documentation: Used with DragDetector to set the paradigm which defines the relativity of inputs/outputs from a custom drag function.

items.name: Absolute
items.documentation: Designates the input and return values as the absolute target position/rotation in the space defined by DragSpace.

items.name: Relative
items.documentation: Designates the input and return values as the change from the current position/rotation in the space defined by DragSpace.

enums.name: UIDragDetectorDragSpace
enums.documentation: Used with DragDetector to set the paradigm which defines the space of inputs/outputs from a custom drag function.

items.name: Parent
items.documentation: Designates the input and return values' space as the local space of the detector's parent GuiObject.

items.name: LayerCollector
items.documentation: Designates the input and return values' space as that of the LayerCollector.

items.name: Reference
items.documentation: Designates the input and return values' space as that of the ReferenceUIInstance. For DragRelativity and DragUDim2 purposes, the (0, 0) origin is the absolute center position of the ReferenceUIInstance. If ReferenceUIInstance is not nil, this will behave the same as Parent.

enums.name: UIDragDetectorDragStyle
enums.documentation: Used with UIDragDetector as the paradigm to generate proposed motion, given a stream of input position vectors.

items.name: TranslatePlane
items.documentation: 2D motion in the plane of the LayerCollector.

items.name: TranslateLine
items.documentation: 1D motion along the detector's DragAxis.

items.name: Rotate
items.documentation: By default, rotation about the absolute center position of the detector's parent GuiObject. If ReferenceUIInstance is set, rotation happens about that instance's absolute center position.

items.name: Scriptable
items.documentation: Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through SetDragStyleFunction().

enums.name: UIDragDetectorResponseStyle
enums.documentation: Describes how the clicked GuiObject will be treated once the desired motion has been calculated.

items.name: Offset
items.documentation: Move by the Offset values of the detector's parent's GuiObject.Position value.

items.name: Scale
items.documentation: Move by the Scale values of the detector's parent's GuiObject.Position value.

items.name: CustomOffset
items.documentation: The UI element will not move at all, but the Offset values of the detector's DragUDim2 will still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

items.name: CustomScale
items.documentation: The UI element will not move at all, but the Scale values of the detector's DragUDim2 will still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

enums.name: UIDragSpeedAxisMapping
enums.documentation: Used with UIDragDetector.UIDragSpeedAxisMapping to determine the X/Y dimension dragging speeds.

items.name: XY
items.documentation: Default setting for a detector's UIDragSpeedAxisMapping where the X and Y axis speeds are based off the X and Y Scale/Offset values respectively.

items.name: XX
items.documentation: Both the X and Y axis speeds are based off the X axis for Scale, while the Offset values still apply to their respective axis.

items.name: YY
items.documentation: Both the X and Y axis speeds are based off the Y axis for Scale, while the Offset values still apply to their respective axis.

enums.name: UIFlexAlignment
enums.documentation: In a UIListLayout flex layout, specifies how to distribute extra space in the parent container.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No flex behavior; siblings maintain their defined width or height.

items.name: Fill
items.documentation: Siblings resize to fill the entire parent container, overriding their defined width or height.

items.name: SpaceAround
items.documentation: Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added on both sides of each sibling.

items.name: SpaceBetween
items.documentation: Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added between siblings, but no additional space is added around siblings.

items.name: SpaceEvenly
items.documentation: Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added both between and around siblings.

enums.name: UIFlexMode
enums.documentation: Used with UIFlexItem.FlexMode to define how the parent GuiObject grows or shrinks.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The parent GuiObject is unaffected and neither shrinks nor grows.

items.name: Grow
items.documentation: Sets an effective 1:0 grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject. Objects set to Grow never shrink below their basis size, so overflow may occur if the container becomes smaller than the flex line's combined basis size.

items.name: Shrink
items.documentation: Sets an effective 0:1 grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject. Objects set to Shrink never grow above their basis size, so underflow may occur if the container becomes larger than the flex line's combined basis size.

items.name: Fill
items.documentation: Sets an effective 1:1 grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject. This setting ensures the flex line always fills the container, even if the container size changes.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Enables the GrowRatio and ShrinkRatio properties for the UIFlexItem, allowing for relative growth or shrinking of the parent GuiObject in a ratio compared to other flex objects also under control of a UIFlexItem.

enums.name: UITheme
enums.documentation: Deprecated Studio UI color theme (Light or Dark).

items.name: Light
items.documentation: The light Studio UI color theme. Deprecated; has no effect.

items.name: Dark
items.documentation: The dark Studio UI color theme. Deprecated; has no effect.

enums.name: UploadCaptureResult
enums.documentation: Describes the outcome of a CaptureService:UploadCaptureAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: The capture was successfully uploaded and registered as an asset.

items.name: NeedPermission
items.documentation: The experience has not been granted developer gallery read and upload permission, so the capture cannot be uploaded.

items.name: CaptureModerated
items.documentation: The capture was rejected by Roblox content moderation and cannot be uploaded.

items.name: CaptureNotInGallery
items.documentation: The capture no longer exists in the user's gallery and cannot be uploaded.

items.name: IneligibleCapture
items.documentation: The capture is not eligible for upload to this experience, either because it is a permanent system capture or the experience permissions grant was rejected.

items.name: UploadQuotaReached
items.documentation: The user has reached their daily capture upload quota and the upload was not completed.

items.name: UploadPending
items.documentation: The upload is still in progress and the asset has not yet been assigned an ID; poll CaptureService:CheckUploadCaptureStatusAsync() again to check for completion.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.documentation: The upload completed but a backend processing error occurred, so the capture was not saved as an asset.

enums.name: UserAcquisitionSource
enums.documentation: Describes how a player first found the current experience.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: PendingAttribution
items.documentation: The player started playing recently, and their acquisition source is not available yet.

items.name: HomeRecommendation
items.documentation: The player first joined from a recommendation on the Home page.

items.name: ContinueToPlay
items.documentation: The player first joined from the Continue section.

items.name: Curation
items.documentation: The player first joined from content curated by Roblox, such as featured experiences or events.

items.name: Friends
items.documentation: The player first joined through a friend.

items.name: Search
items.documentation: The player first joined from search results.

items.name: Teleport
items.documentation: The player first joined by teleporting from another experience.

items.name: Ads
items.documentation: The player first joined from an ad, such as a sponsored ad, search ad, or portal ad.

items.name: HomeOther
items.documentation: The player first joined from a part of the Roblox app other than Home recommendations, such as Charts or Favorites.

items.name: Other
items.documentation: The player first joined from another source, such as a share link, chat, or a notification.

enums.name: UserCFrame
enums.documentation: Determines what body part is being tracked by a VR device, and what its CFrame actually is.

items.name: Head
items.documentation: The CFrame of the user's head.

items.name: LeftHand
items.documentation: The CFrame of the user's left hand.

items.name: RightHand
items.documentation: The CFrame of the user's right hand.

items.name: Floor
items.documentation: The CFrame of the center of the floor.

enums.name: UserInputState
enums.documentation: This enum describes the state of an input that is currently or was recently performed.

items.name: Begin
items.documentation: Occurs when an InputObject starts to interact with the experience. For example, a mouse button down, a key down, or when the player begins touching the screen.

items.name: Change
items.documentation: Occurs each frame an InputObject has already begun interacting with the experience and part of its state is changing. For example, movement of the mouse position, a gamepad thumbstick movement, an analog gamepad trigger button change, or screen touch point change.

items.name: End
items.documentation: Occurs when an InputObject finishes interacting with the experience. For example, a mouse button up, a key up, or when the player stops touching the screen.

items.name: Cancel
items.documentation: A special circumstance state that indicates this input is no longer relevant, particularly with ContextActionService. For example, binding two action-handling functions will cause the first to Cancel if an input was already in-progress when the second was bound.

items.name: None
items.documentation: A state that should never be seen in an experience; essentially just marks the end of the enum.

enums.name: UserInputType
enums.documentation: Describes the type of a user input event.

items.name: MouseButton1
items.documentation: The left mouse button.

items.name: MouseButton2
items.documentation: The right mouse button.

items.name: MouseButton3
items.documentation: The middle mouse button.

items.name: MouseWheel
items.documentation: The mouse wheel.

items.name: MouseMovement
items.documentation: Movement of the mouse. Fires changed events each time the player's cursor position changes and when the move enters/leaves the game window.

items.name: Touch
items.documentation: A tap on the screen from a mobile device.

items.name: Keyboard
items.documentation: Key press on a keyboard.

items.name: Focus
items.documentation: The client regaining focus of the Roblox window.

items.name: Accelerometer
items.documentation: The accelerometer of a mobile device.

items.name: Gyro
items.documentation: The Gyroscope of a mobile device.

items.name: Gamepad1
items.documentation: Input from the 1st plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad2
items.documentation: Input from the 2nd plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad3
items.documentation: Input from the 3rd plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad4
items.documentation: Input from the 4th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad5
items.documentation: Input from the 5th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad6
items.documentation: Input from the 6th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad7
items.documentation: Input from the 7th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad8
items.documentation: Input from the 8th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: TextInput
items.documentation: Input of Text into a text-based GuiObject. Normally this is only a TextBox.

items.name: InputMethod
items.documentation: Text input from an input method editor (IME). InputObjects with this type aren't currently fired.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Unknown UserInputType.

enums.name: UserNewReturningStatus
enums.documentation: Describes whether a player is new to the current experience or has played it before.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: New
items.documentation: The player is playing the experience for the first time.

items.name: Returning
items.documentation: The player has played the experience before.

enums.name: VelocityConstraintMode
enums.documentation: The velocity constraint mode property controls how the linear velocity of the attachment(s) is constrained.

items.name: Line
items.documentation: The velocity component in the direction of the line is constrained to the specified value. The line direction is based on the RelativeTo property: - Attachment0 - The line direction is the primary axis of Attachment0. - Attachment1 - The line direction is the primary axis of Attachment1. - World - The line direction must be specified.

items.name: Plane
items.documentation: The velocity components in the plane are constrained to the specified values. The plane tangents are based on the RelativeTo property: - Attachment0 - The plane tangents are the two axes of Attachment0. - Attachment1 - The plane tangents are the two axes of Attachment1. - World - The two plane tangents must be specified

items.name: Vector
items.documentation: The velocity components must be equal to the vector components specified. The coordinate system of the vector is based on the RelativeTo property: - Attachment0 - The vector components are in the coordinate system defined by the axes of Attachment0. - Attachment1 - The vector components are in the coordinate system defined by the axes of Attachment1. - World - The coordinate system is in the world and the vector components must be specified.

enums.name: VerifiedLevel
enums.documentation: Specifies the level of player verification required by Player:IsVerified().

items.name: Low
items.documentation: Requires the player to meet the low verification level or higher. This is the default value for Player:IsVerified().

items.name: High
items.documentation: Requires the player to meet the high verification level.

enums.name: VerticalAlignment
enums.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.VerticalAlignment to align the layout vertically within its parent.

items.name: Center
items.documentation: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the Y axis.

items.name: Top
items.documentation: Grid is aligned to the top edge of its parent.

items.name: Bottom
items.documentation: Grid is aligned to the bottom edge of its parent.

enums.name: VerticalScrollBarPosition
enums.documentation: This enum is used for ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarPosition to indicate vertical scroll bar positioning.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: Right side of the ScrollingFrame.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: Left side of the ScrollingFrame.

enums.name: VibrationMotor
enums.documentation: Describes various types of haptic motor sizes and locations.

items.name: Large
items.documentation: Large motor.

items.name: Small
items.documentation: Small motor.

items.name: LeftTrigger
items.documentation: Left trigger motor.

items.name: RightTrigger
items.documentation: Right trigger motor.

items.name: LeftHand
items.documentation: Left hand motor for VR devices.

items.name: RightHand
items.documentation: Right hand motor for VR devices.

enums.name: VideoCaptureResult
enums.documentation: Indicates whether a video capture session ended successfully or the reason it was interrupted.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: Video capture ended normally without any errors.

items.name: OtherError
items.documentation: Video capture stopped due to an unspecified internal error.

items.name: ScreenSizeChanged
items.documentation: Video capture was interrupted because the screen dimensions changed while recording was in progress.

items.name: TimeLimitReached
items.documentation: Video capture was stopped automatically because the maximum allowed recording duration was reached.

enums.name: VideoCaptureStartedResult
enums.documentation: Describes the outcome of a video capture start request made through CaptureService.

items.name: Success
items.documentation: Video capture started successfully.

items.name: OtherError
items.documentation: Video capture failed due to an unspecified internal error.

items.name: CapturingAlready
items.documentation: A video capture session is already in progress and a new one cannot be started.

items.name: NoDeviceSupport
items.documentation: The device does not have the required capture capabilities.

items.name: NoSpaceOnDevice
items.documentation: The device does not have sufficient storage space available to begin capturing video.

enums.name: VideoDeviceCaptureQuality
enums.documentation: Specifies the capture resolution and frame rate used by a VideoDeviceInput when reading from a camera device.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The default capture quality.

items.name: Low
items.documentation: Captures at a reduced quality to lower resource usage on constrained or mobile platforms.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: Captures at a balanced quality suitable for most use cases.

items.name: High
items.documentation: Captures at the highest available quality.

enums.name: VideoError
enums.documentation: Indicates the result of a video operation in the engine's video subsystem.

items.name: Ok
items.documentation: The video operation completed successfully without error.

items.name: Eof
items.documentation: The end of the video stream or file has been reached.

items.name: EAgain
items.documentation: No data is available at this moment; the caller should retry the operation.

items.name: BadParameter
items.documentation: An invalid or out-of-range parameter was supplied to the video operation.

items.name: AllocFailed
items.documentation: A memory allocation required for the video operation failed.

items.name: CodecInitFailed
items.documentation: The video codec failed to initialize.

items.name: CodecCloseFailed
items.documentation: The video codec failed to shut down cleanly.

items.name: DecodeFailed
items.documentation: The video decoder failed to decode a frame from the stream.

items.name: ParsingFailed
items.documentation: Parsing the video stream or container format failed.

items.name: Unsupported
items.documentation: The requested video operation or format is not supported on this platform.

items.name: Generic
items.documentation: A generic or unclassified error occurred in the video subsystem.

items.name: DownloadFailed
items.documentation: The video asset could not be downloaded.

items.name: StreamNotFound
items.documentation: The requested video stream could not be found.

items.name: EncodeFailed
items.documentation: The video encoder failed to encode a frame.

items.name: CreateFailed
items.documentation: Creating a required video resource or object failed.

items.name: NoPermission
items.documentation: The video operation was denied because the required permission, such as camera access, has not been granted.

items.name: NoService
items.documentation: The required video service is unavailable on this device or platform.

items.name: ReleaseFailed
items.documentation: Releasing a video resource failed.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: An unknown or unrecognized error occurred; this value covers errors that have no specific classification in this enum.

enums.name: VideoSampleSize
enums.documentation: The size of textures produced by VideoSampler.

items.name: Small
items.documentation: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly a quarter of the screen.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly half the screen.

items.name: Large
items.documentation: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly three quarters of the screen.

items.name: Full
items.documentation: Use when the video sample is displayed full screen.

enums.name: ViewMode
enums.documentation: Controls which debug rendering visualization overlay is displayed in the Studio viewport via RenderSettings.ViewMode.

items.name: None
items.documentation: Disables the debug rendering visualization overlay; the default value of RenderSettings.ViewMode.

items.name: GeometryComplexity
items.documentation: Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting geometric complexity across rendered surfaces.

items.name: Transparent
items.documentation: Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting surfaces rendered with transparency.

items.name: Decal
items.documentation: Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting surfaces rendered with decals.

enums.name: VirtualCursorMode
enums.documentation: Enables Virtual Cursor mode within an experience.

items.name: Default
items.documentation: The Virtual Cursor is in the default state.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: The Virtual Cursor is disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: The Virtual Cursor is enabled.

enums.name: VirtualInputMode
enums.documentation: Describes the current operational state of a VirtualInputManager.

items.name: None
items.documentation: The VirtualInputManager is idle and neither recording nor playing back input.

items.name: Recording
items.documentation: The VirtualInputManager is actively capturing input events into a sequence.

items.name: Playing
items.documentation: The VirtualInputManager is replaying a previously recorded input sequence.

enums.name: VoiceChatDistanceAttenuationType
enums.documentation: Enum used for preset distance attenuation curve options in the default voice chat setup.

items.name: Inverse
items.documentation: Represents a distance attenuation curve that follows the inverse-squared law. This is identical to the default distance attenuation of an AudioEmitter instance.

items.name: Legacy
items.documentation: Represents a linear-squared distance attenuation curve with a minimum distance of 7 and a maximum distance of 80. This is identical to the distance attenuation used in the internal-only default voice setup that does not use AudioDeviceInput and AudioEmitter objects.

enums.name: VoiceChatState
enums.documentation: Describes the connection state of a local player's voice chat session.

items.name: Idle
items.documentation: The player is not connected to voice chat and no join attempt is in progress.

items.name: Joining
items.documentation: A voice chat join attempt is in progress for the first time.

items.name: JoiningRetry
items.documentation: A voice chat join is being retried after a previous attempt did not succeed.

items.name: Joined
items.documentation: The player has successfully joined the voice chat session and is actively connected.

items.name: Leaving
items.documentation: The player is in the process of disconnecting from the voice chat session.

items.name: Ended
items.documentation: The voice chat session has ended normally.

items.name: Failed
items.documentation: The voice chat session ended due to an error, such as a failure to join or a mid-session error.

enums.name: VoiceControlPath
enums.documentation: Identifies which leg of a voice chat control-plane operation is being reported.

items.name: Publish
items.documentation: Represents the outbound audio path, through which a client sends local microphone audio to the room.

items.name: Subscribe
items.documentation: Represents the inbound audio path, through which a client receives remote participants' audio streams.

items.name: Join
items.documentation: Represents the room-join path, through which a client establishes membership in a voice room.

enums.name: VolumetricAudio
enums.documentation: Controls how the engine renders volumetric audio effects.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: Volumetric audio is disabled; sound emanates from a single point.

items.name: Automatic
items.documentation: Currently equivalent to VolumetricAudio.Disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.documentation: Volumetric audio is enabled; sound emanates from the object's volume.

enums.name: VRComfortSetting
enums.documentation: Named presets for VR comfort assists such as vignette, smooth rotation, and third-person follow camera.

items.name: Comfort
items.documentation: Most restrictive comfort preset: enables vignette, disables smooth rotation, and disables the third-person follow camera.

items.name: Normal
items.documentation: Default balanced preset: enables vignette and third-person follow camera while keeping smooth rotation disabled.

items.name: Expert
items.documentation: Least restrictive comfort preset: disables vignette and enables both smooth rotation and the third-person follow camera.

items.name: Custom
items.documentation: Lets vignette, smooth rotation, and third-person follow camera be configured independently rather than as a fixed preset.

enums.name: VRControllerModelMode
enums.documentation: Controls whether and how the player's VR hand controller models are rendered in an experience.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: The player's VR hand controller models are not rendered.

items.name: Transparent
items.documentation: The player's VR hand controller models are rendered with transparency.

enums.name: VRLaserPointerMode
enums.documentation: Specifies the display mode of the VR laser pointer used to interact with the user interface.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: The laser pointer is hidden and no pointer is rendered for any VR hand.

items.name: Pointer
items.documentation: A single laser pointer is shown for the primary VR hand; this is the default value of VRService.LaserPointer.

items.name: DualPointer
items.documentation: A laser pointer is shown for each VR hand simultaneously.

enums.name: VRScaling
enums.documentation: Controls whether VRService automatically adjusts the perceived scale of the world in VR to match the player's avatar size.

items.name: World
items.documentation: Adjusts Camera.HeadScale so that the world in VR is seen from the avatar's perspective.

items.name: Off
items.documentation: Disables VR automatic scaling; set Camera.HeadScale manually if needed.

enums.name: VRSessionState
enums.documentation: The lifecycle state of the active VR session, as reported by the VRSessionState property of VRService.

items.name: Undefined
items.documentation: The VR session state is unknown or has not yet been established; the default value of VRSessionState.

items.name: Idle
items.documentation: The VR headset is connected and ready but is not yet presenting frames to the user.

items.name: Visible
items.documentation: The VR session is rendering frames visible to the user but does not yet have XR input focus; haptic feedback is available.

items.name: Focused
items.documentation: The VR session has full XR input focus and is rendering visible frames; haptic feedback is available.

items.name: Stopping
items.documentation: The VR session is in the process of stopping and will transition to an inactive state.

enums.name: VRTouchpad
enums.documentation: Used to universally identify a VR touchpad that is used by either the left, or right hand.

items.name: Left
items.documentation: Left hand touchpad.

items.name: Right
items.documentation: Right hand touchpad.

enums.name: VRTouchpadMode
enums.documentation: Used to identify the behavior of a specified VR touchpad.

items.name: Touch
items.documentation: The touchpad is treated as ButtonB if it is the left touchpad, or ButtonA if it is the right touchpad.

items.name: VirtualThumbstick
items.documentation: The touchpad will function as a gamepad joystick.

items.name: ABXY
items.documentation: The touchpad will function as a means of inputting the standard ABXY gamepad input, dividing it up into 4 diagonal pie slices.

enums.name: WaterDirection
enums.documentation: This Enum was once used to set the direction of Terrain water.

items.name: NegX
items.documentation: The negative X-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: X
items.documentation: The positive X-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: NegY
items.documentation: The negative Y-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: Y
items.documentation: The positive Y-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: NegZ
items.documentation: The negative Z-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: Z
items.documentation: The positive Z-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

enums.name: WaterForce
enums.documentation: The WaterForce Enum is used to work with Terrain water cells.

items.name: None
items.documentation: No flow force on a legacy voxel terrain water cell; the water is still.

items.name: Small
items.documentation: A low flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: Medium
items.documentation: A moderate flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell, between WaterForce.Small and WaterForce.Strong.

items.name: Strong
items.documentation: A high flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell, one step below WaterForce.Max.

items.name: Max
items.documentation: The maximum flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell.

enums.name: WebStreamClientState
enums.documentation: WebStreamClientState indicates the current state of a WebStreamClient object.

items.name: Connecting
items.documentation: The client has sent a request to connect with the server and is waiting for a response.

items.name: Open
items.documentation: The client is connected to the server, allowing for data to be streamed between the server and client.

items.name: Error
items.documentation: An unrecoverable error has occured while setting up the connection orduring the connection lifetime, cutting off the stream.

items.name: Closed
items.documentation: The connection has run to completion without issues, either closed naturally by the server or manually by the user.

enums.name: WebStreamClientType
enums.documentation: Specifies what type of streaming to use when creating a WebStreamClient.

items.name: SSE
items.documentation: Traditional Server-Sent Events (SSE) client. Requires text/event-stream to be returned in the Content-Type header. Messages in the stream will follow the event stream format.

items.name: RawStream
items.documentation: General purpose HTTP streaming client. It can connect to any server that provides streaming data transfer (e.g. chunked encoding). It provides no guarantees about the stream format.

items.name: WebSocket
items.documentation: WebSocket client that provides a bidirectional communication channel over a TCP connection.

enums.name: WeldConstraintPreserve
enums.documentation: Controls which WeldConstraints are included in the recommendation table returned by GeometryService:CalculateConstraintsToPreserve().

items.name: All
items.documentation: All WeldConstraints will be returned in the recommended table.

items.name: None
items.documentation: WeldConstraints will be ignored and not returned in the recommended table.

items.name: Touching
items.documentation: Only WeldConstraints that connect touching parts in the performed operation will be returned in the recommended table.

enums.name: WhenUserFirstPlayed
enums.documentation: Describes when a player first played the current experience, represented as a bucket.

items.name: Unknown
items.documentation: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Days0To30
items.documentation: The player first played the experience within the last 30 days.

items.name: Days31To90
items.documentation: The player first played the experience between 31 and 90 days ago.

items.name: Days91To180
items.documentation: The player first played the experience between 91 and 180 days ago.

items.name: Days181To365
items.documentation: The player first played the experience between 181 and 365 days ago.

items.name: Days366Plus
items.documentation: The player first played the experience more than 365 days ago.

enums.name: WhisperChatPrivacyMode
enums.documentation: Describes which other players a player allows to initiate a whisper (direct) chat with them in an experience.

items.name: AllUsers
items.documentation: The player allows any other player in the experience to initiate a whisper chat with them.

items.name: NoOne
items.documentation: The player does not allow any other player to initiate a whisper chat with them.

enums.name: WrapLayerAutoSkin
enums.documentation: Controls how automatic bone weight transfer from the body is applied to a WrapLayer accessory's mesh.

items.name: Disabled
items.documentation: No automatic skinning transfer is applied; the accessory uses its authored skinning data as-is, and an unskinned mesh will not deform with the character.

items.name: EnabledPreserve
items.documentation: Applies automatic skinning transfer only when the mesh has no existing skinning data; otherwise the authored weights are kept.

items.name: EnabledOverride
items.documentation: Unconditionally overrides all skinning weights by running the cage-based skinning transfer algorithm, regardless of whether the mesh was originally skinned.

enums.name: WrapLayerDebugMode
enums.documentation: The Studio-only property for quickly visualizing and debugging meshes with inner cage and outer cages.

items.name: None
items.documentation: This debug rendering mode does nothing. This is the default value.

items.name: BoundCage
items.documentation: This debug mode visualizes corresponding cage mesh vertices bound to an underlying WrapTarget. In order to find corresponding vertices between different cages, the Wrap Deformer algorithm uses UV matching. As long as your WrapLayer cage mesh share the same UV layout as WrapTarget, its vertices will be marked as "bound".

items.name: LayerCage
items.documentation: This debug mode shows the resulting layer mesh as a whole. The deformer will use vertex locations from the previous layer for all unbound vertices.

items.name: BoundCageAndLinks
items.documentation: The same as BoundCage but also visualizes how bound vertices were moved. You can use this mode to identify where they belong on a previous layer and where they are located on the current layer.

items.name: Reference
items.documentation: This debug mode shows the original inner cage mesh as it was created.

items.name: Rbf
items.documentation: This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate the wrap deformer's expected behavior by looking at this state. All renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere" along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

items.name: OuterCage
items.documentation: This debug mode shows the original outer cage mesh as it was created.

items.name: ReferenceMeshAfterMorph
items.documentation: Renders the layer's outer cage after the morph step that aligns it to the previous layer's outer cage surface, prior to HSR processing.

items.name: HSROuterDetail
items.documentation: Interactive mode that highlights the render-mesh triangle under the cursor and draws the corresponding outer cage vertices on the layer above using HSR association data.

items.name: HSROuter
items.documentation: Highlights outer cage vertices that HSR associates with visible render-mesh faces.

items.name: HSRInner
items.documentation: Highlights inner cage vertices that Hidden Surface Removal (HSR) classifies as occluded by the clothing layer above, drawn at the previous layer's outer-cage positions.

items.name: HSRInnerReverse
items.documentation: Highlights inner cage vertices that HSR classifies as visible (not occluded), the complement of WrapLayerDebugMode.HSRInner.

items.name: LayerCageFittedToBase
items.documentation: Renders the layer's outer cage at positions from fitting it to the base body mesh (rest pose), shown as spheres and wireframe edges.

items.name: LayerCageFittedToPrev
items.documentation: Renders the layer's outer cage at positions from fitting it to the previous layer's deformed shape, shown as spheres and wireframe edges.

items.name: PreWrapDeformerOuterCage
items.documentation: Draws each outer cage vertex that moved during deformation as a sphere at its pre-deformation position connected by a line to its post-deformation position.

items.name: SkinningTransfer
items.documentation: Visualizes per-vertex skinning weight transfer for the layer mesh, drawing lines from each mesh vertex to its influencing skeleton joints.

enums.name: WrapTargetDebugMode
enums.documentation: The Studio-only property for quickly visualizing and debugging meshes with only outer cages.

items.name: None
items.documentation: This debug rendering mode does nothing, and this is the default value.

items.name: TargetCageOriginal
items.documentation: This debug mode shows the original cage mesh as it was created.

items.name: TargetCageCompressed
items.documentation: This debug mode shows corresponding cage mesh compressed by clothing layers above it. This debug mode is intended to validate that the compression algorithm and corresponding cages work as intended.

items.name: TargetCageInterface
items.documentation: This debug mode shows the resulting cage mesh for the corresponding Wrap Instance. This debug mode is intended to validate that the final deformed cage looks as intended.

items.name: TargetLayerCageOriginal
items.documentation: The same as TargetCageOriginal but affects all WrapTargets that belong to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

items.name: TargetLayerCageCompressed
items.documentation: The same as TargetCageCompressed but affects all WrapTargets that belong to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

items.name: TargetLayerInterface
items.documentation: The same as TargetCageInterface but affects all WrapTargets that belong to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

items.name: Rbf
items.documentation: This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate the wrap deformer expected behavior by looking at this state. All renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere" along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

items.name: OuterCageDetail
items.documentation: Visualizes outer cage vertices and related cage faces when hovering a mesh triangle in Studio.

items.name: PreWrapDeformerCage
items.documentation: Renders the outer cage as wireframe with vertex markers in its pre-deformation state.

enums.name: ZIndexBehavior
enums.documentation: Used by LayerCollector.ZIndexBehavior to control how the GuiObject.ZIndex property behaves for descendants.

items.name: Global
items.documentation: The ZIndex property overrides the default value computed from the depth in the hierarchy.

items.name: Sibling
items.documentation: The ZIndex property controls the order in which the GuiObject renders relative to its siblings.

classes.name: Accessory
classes.documentation: An item that a Character can wear.

properties.name: AccessoryType
properties.documentation: Specifies the AccessoryType of the Accessory. Is AccessoryType.Unknown unless you equip the Accessory through the player spawning process or Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(). If available on the Marketplace, you can set AccessoryType to categorize the Accessory item (for example, "Hat" or "Face").

classes.name: AccessoryDescription
classes.documentation: Describes the appearance of an Accessory for the HumanoidDescription.

properties.name: AccessoryType
properties.documentation: The AccessoryType of the Accessory referred to by this description.

properties.name: AssetId

properties.name: Instance
properties.documentation: A reference to the Instance that should be applied when applying this AccessoryDescription. This property can be used instead of AssetId to apply accessories without uploading them to the platform.

properties.name: IsLayered
properties.documentation: Whether the Accessory is layered or rigid. This is intended to be read-only. It will be corrected after calling Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() if this property doesn't match the actual Accessory contents.

properties.name: Order
properties.documentation: The WrapLayer.Order value when applying the Accessory, if it is layered.

properties.name: Position
properties.documentation: The accessory adjustment position offset. Only applies if the Accessory is rigid.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.documentation: The accessory adjustment rotation offset. Only applies if the Accessory is rigid.

properties.name: Scale
properties.documentation: The accessory adjustment scale. Only applies if the Accessory is rigid.

properties.name: Puffiness
properties.documentation: The WrapLayer.Puffiness value when applying the Accessory, if it is layered.

methods.documentation: Returns the applied Accessory if this AccessoryDescription is the child of an applied HumanoidDescription parented to a Humanoid. Throws an error if this AccessoryDescription is not a child of a HumanoidDescription that has been applied to a Humanoid, or if no matching applied instance is found. *Security: None · Thread Safety: Unsafe · Capabilities: AvatarAppearance*

classes.name: Actor
classes.documentation: An Actor is a container for code that can be safely split into its own thread.

methods.name: BindToMessage
methods.documentation: This method is used to bind a Luau callback to a message with the specified topic. When a message is sent (using SendMessage()) to the topic specified the provided callback will be called in a _serial_ execution context. Multiple Luau callbacks may be bound to a single actor and even to a single message topic. Note: Only the scripts which are descendants of an Actor may bind to its messages. *Security: None · Thread Safety: Safe · Capabilities: Basic* from receiving messages. Bind To Message Demonstrates Actor:BindToMessage().

methods.name: BindToMessageParallel
methods.documentation: This method is used to bind a Luau callback to a message with the specified topic. When a message is sent (using SendMessage()) to the topic specified the provided callback will be called in a _parallel_ execution context. Multiple Luau callbacks may be bound to a single actor and even to a single message topic. Note: Only the scripts which are descendants of an Actor may bind to its messages. *Security: None · Thread Safety: Safe · Capabilities: Basic* from receiving messages. Bind To Message Parallel Demonstrates Actor:BindToMessageParallel().

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.documentation: Sends a message to an Actor. Messages are sent asynchronously, so the sender will not block or yield when calling the SendMessage() method. Since a single Actor may receive different kinds of messages, a topic parameter is used to distinguish between various kinds of messages. See BindToMessage() for details on receiving a message sent using SendMessage(). Note that message arguments are passed by copy across Luau VM boundaries, not by reference. Sending large tables incurs a full copy on each call. Functions are bound to a specific VM and cannot be passed in messages. *Security: None · Thread Safety: Safe · Capabilities: Basic*

classes.name: AdGui
classes.documentation: A surface-based GUI that displays immersive ads on a face of a Part in the 3D world.

properties.name: AdShape
properties.documentation: Determines the shape of the ad rendered by the AdGui, including the creative's aspect ratio on the part surface. Defaults to HorizontalRectangle, which is the only served shape aside from the sentinel Undefined.

properties.name: EnableVideoAds
properties.documentation: The property enables the AdGui to serve video ads.

properties.name: FallbackImage
properties.documentation: A creator-supplied image that the AdGui displays when it has no served ad to render. Defaults to an empty content string; while empty, the AdGui renders a default Roblox fallback image instead.

properties.name: FallbackImageContent
properties.documentation: A Content-typed property that holds the fallback image the AdGui displays when no served ad is available. It is the content-typed backing for AdGui.FallbackImage (a legacy TextureId string); writing to either property updates the same underlying storage. Unlike FallbackImage, this property accepts asset URIs and references to EditableImage objects. When empty, the AdGui renders a default Roblox fallback image instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.documentation: A read-only property that reports whether the AdGui is actively displaying a served ad. It's Active when the AdGui is rendering ad content, and Inactive otherwise.

classes.name: AdPortal
classes.documentation: A portal that teleports players to a sponsored experience as part of immersive ads.

properties.name: PortalInvalidReason
properties.documentation: Holds a human-readable explanation of why the AdPortal is not in a valid, servable state. When the portal passes validation the value is an empty string; when validation fails it is populated with the specific reason reported by the portal's validator, such as an unsuitable parent or a misconfigured child AdGui. This property is read-only and defaults to an empty string (""). It is intended for surfacing configuration problems to creators in Studio.

properties.name: Status
properties.documentation: Reports the portal's current AdUnitStatus. The value is AdUnitStatus.Active only when the portal has passed validation and has been served an ad with a valid destination place; in every other case it is AdUnitStatus.Inactive. A newly created portal reports AdUnitStatus.Inactive, because its destination place is unset (0) until the ad service fills the portal with an ad — the portal cannot become AdUnitStatus.Active, and therefore cannot teleport, until that happens. This property is read-only.

methods.documentation: This method may only be called from a Script with RunContext.Client. Note that you should call this method as close as possible to the moment you plan to show the ad. For example, if you have a "Watch video ad to get a reward" button in a shop menu, only call this method when the user opens the shop menu. This approach improves performance by preventing ads from unnecessarily being held in memory, and it benefits CPM (cost-per-thousand impressions) and earnings by optimizing the ad fill rate. *Yields · Security: None · Thread Safety: Unsafe · Capabilities: Monetization* { AdAvailabilityResult: Enum.AdAvailabilityResult }.

Call this method and confirm that result.IsEligible is true before you display any of the campaign's ad integration assets or register their disclosure buttons with RegisterDisclosureButton. All ad integration assets should remain hidden until the Player is confirmed eligible. When called from the client, the player argument defaults to the LocalPlayer. When called from the server, player is required. The call raises an error if the supplied campaignId exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: RegisterAdOpportunityAsync

The instance must be a GuiButton that is a descendant of a ScreenGui under PlayerGui. When a user clicks it, they can see who is paying for the ad. See ad integrations for guidance on what the disclosures should look like and when they should be visible. Note: you must verify that the LocalPlayer is eligible to see the associated ad integration campaign by calling GetCampaignEligibilityAsync and verifying that result.IsEligible is true before attempting to register a disclosure button for it. If you do not wait, or the LocalPlayer is not eligible to see the associated campaign, then RegisterDisclosureButton
